sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vā idaṃ trayeṇa vedenājayad yad asyedaṃ jitaṃ tat |
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वा इदं त्रयेण वेदेनाजयद् यद् अस्येदं जितं तत् ।
text: Prajapati verily conquered this [universe] by means of the threefold knowledge (Veda): that [namely] which was conquered of him.
text_mt: Prajāpati indeed conquered this [universe] by means of the threefold veda—that conquest of his which was won here.

sanskrit_iast: sa aikṣatetthaṃ ced vā anye devā anena vedena yakṣyanta imāṃ vāva te jitiṃ jeṣyanti yeyam mama hanta trayasya vedasya rasam ādadā iti |
meaning: स ऐक्षतेत्थं चेद् वा अन्ये देवा अनेन वेदेन यक्ष्यन्त इमां वाव ते जितिं जेष्यन्ति येयम् मम हन्त त्रयस्य वेदस्य रसम् आददा इति ।
text_mt:
He thought: 'If other gods will sacrifice with this veda, they will surely win this conquest that is mine.
Come, let me take the essence of the threefold veda.'

sanskrit_iast: sa bhūr ity eva rgvedasya rasam ādatta seyam pṛthivy abhavat tasya yo rasaḥ prāṇedat so 'gnir abhavad rasasya rasaḥ |
meaning: स भूर् इत्य् एव र्ग्वेदस्य रसम् आदत्त सेयम् पृथिव्य् अभवत् तस्य यो रसः प्राणेदत् सो ऽग्निर् अभवद् रसस्य रसः ।
text: He considered: " If the olher gods shall sacrifice thus by means of this knowledge (Veda), verily they will conquer this conquest which is mine here. Come now, let me take the sap of the threefold knowledge (Veda)." a. Saying bhus, he took the sap of the Rigveda. That became this earth. The sap of it which streamed forth became Agni (fire), the sap of the sap.
text_mt:
With [the utterance] 'bhūḥ' indeed he took the essence of the Ṛgveda.
That became this earth.
The essence of that which breathed forth became Agni, the essence of the essence.

sanskrit_iast: bhuva ity eva yajurvedasya rasam ādatta tad idam antarikṣam abhavat tasya yo rasaḥ prāṇedat sa vāyur abhavad rasasya rasaḥ |
meaning: भुव इत्य् एव यजुर्वेदस्य रसम् आदत्त तद् इदम् अन्तरिक्षम् अभवत् तस्य यो रसः प्राणेदत् स वायुर् अभवद् रसस्य रसः ।
text: Saying bhuvas, he took the sap of the Yajurveda. That became this atmosphere. The sap of it which streamed forth became Vayu (wind), the sap of the sap.
text_mt:
With [the utterance] 'bhuvaḥ' indeed he took the essence of the Yajurveda.
That became this intermediate space.
The essence of that which breathed forth became Vāyu, the essence of the essence.

sanskrit_iast: svar ity eva sāmavedasya rasam ādatta so 'sau dyaur abhavat tasya yo rasaḥ prāṇedat sa ādityo 'bhavad rasasya rasaḥ |
meaning: स्वर् इत्य् एव सामवेदस्य रसम् आदत्त सो ऽसौ द्यौर् अभवत् तस्य यो रसः प्राणेदत् स आदित्यो ऽभवद् रसस्य रसः ।
text: Saying svar, he took the sap of the Samaveda. That became yonder sky. The sap of it which streamed forth became Aditya (sun), the sap of the sap.
text_mt:
With [the utterance] 'svaḥ' indeed he took the essence of the Sāmaveda.
That became that heaven.
The essence of that which breathed forth became Āditya, the essence of the essence.

sanskrit_iast: athaikasyaivākṣarasya rasaṃ nāśaknod ādātum om ity etasyaiva |
meaning: अथैकस्यैवाक्षरस्य रसं नाशक्नोद् आदातुम् ओम् इत्य् एतस्यैव ।
text: Now of one syllable he was not able to take the sap: of om, just of that.
text_mt: Then of one syllable alone he could not take the essence: of 'om' alone.

sanskrit_iast: seyaṃ vāg abhavat om eva nāmaiṣā tasyā u prāṇa eva rasaḥ |
meaning: सेयं वाग् अभवत् ओम् एव नामैषा तस्या उ प्राण एव रसः ।
text: That became this speech. This [speech] is namely o»v. Of it breath is the sap.
text_mt:
That became this speech.
Its name indeed is om.
And its essence is breath alone.

sanskrit_iast: tāny etāny aṣṭau aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī gāyatraṃ sāma brahma u gāyatrī tad u brahmābhisampadyate aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavas teno paśavyam | prathame 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तान्य् एतान्य् अष्टौ अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री गायत्रं साम ब्रह्म उ गायत्री तद् उ ब्रह्माभिसम्पद्यते अष्टाशफाः पशवस् तेनो पशव्यम् । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: These same are eight. Of eight syllables is the gāyatrī. The sāman is in the gāyatrī-metre and the gāyatrī is the brahman; and thus it becomes the brahman. Eight-hoofed are the domestic animals, and therefore it belongs to the domestic animals.
text_mt:
These make eight.
Eight-syllabled is the gāyatrī.
The gāyatra is the sāman, and the gāyatrī is brahman.
Thus it attains brahman.
Eight-hoofed are cattle; therefore it is conducive to cattle.
First khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sa yad om iti so 'gnir vāg iti pṛthivy om iti vāyur vāg ity antarikṣam om ity ādityo vāg iti dyaur om iti prāṇo vāg ity eva vāk |
meaning: स यद् ओम् इति सो ऽग्निर् वाग् इति पृथिव्य् ओम् इति वायुर् वाग् इत्य् अन्तरिक्षम् ओम् इत्य् आदित्यो वाग् इति द्यौर् ओम् इति प्राणो वाग् इत्य् एव वाक् ।
text: Om is Agni (tire), speech is the earth; om is Vayu (wind), speech is the atmosphere; om is Aditya (sun), speech is the sky: om is breath, speech is just speech.
text_mt: In that it is 'om', that is Agni; 'vāk', that is the earth; 'om', that is Vāyu; 'vāk', that is the intermediate space; 'om', that is Āditya; 'vāk', that is heaven; 'om', that is breath; 'vāk', that is speech itself.

sanskrit_iast: sa ya evaṃ vidvān udgāyaty om ity evāgnim ādāya pṛthivyām pratiṣṭhāpayaty om ity eva vāyum ādāyāntarikṣe pratiṣṭhāpayaty om ity evādityam ādāya divi pratiṣṭhāpayaty om ity eva prāṇam ādāya vāci pratiṣṭhāpayati |
meaning: स य एवं विद्वान् उद्गायत्य् ओम् इत्य् एवाग्निम् आदाय पृथिव्याम् प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् ओम् इत्य् एव वायुम् आदायान्तरिक्षे प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् ओम् इत्य् एवादित्यम् आदाय दिवि प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् ओम् इत्य् एव प्राणम् आदाय वाचि प्रतिष्ठापयति ।
text: He who knowing thus sings the udgītha saying om, he takes Agni (fire) and causes him to stand firm on the earth; saying om, he takes Vayu (wind) and causes him to stand firm in the atmosphere; saying om, he takes Aditya (sun) and causes him to stand firm in the sky; saying om, he takes breath and causes it to stand firm in speech,
text_mt: He who sings the udgītha knowing thus, taking Agni with 'om', establishes him in the earth; taking Vāyu with 'om', establishes him in the intermediate space; taking Āditya with 'om', establishes him in heaven; taking breath with 'om', establishes him in speech.

sanskrit_iast: tad dhaitac chailanā gāyatraṃ gāyanty ovā3c ovā3c ovā3c hum bhā ovā iti |
meaning: तद् धैतच् छैलना गायत्रं गायन्त्य् ओवा3च् ओवा3च् ओवा3च् हुम् भा ओवा इति ।
text: Now the Śailanas sing the gāyatra {-sāman) thus: ovdSo ovdSc ovdSc hum bhd ovd.
text_mt: Now the Śailanas sing this gāyatra thus: 'ovā3c ovā3c ovā3c hum bhā ovā'.

sanskrit_iast: tad u ha tat parāṅ ivānāyuṣyam iva tad vāyoś cāpāṃ cānu vartma geyam |
meaning: तद् उ ह तत् पराङ् इवानायुष्यम् इव तद् वायोश् चापां चानु वर्त्म गेयम् ।
text: Truly, this is thrown away {pardn), as it were; not productive of long life, as it were. It should be sung in accordance with the course of wind and waters,
text_mt:
Now that is turned away, as it were, not leading to a full lifespan, as it were.
It should be sung following the path of the wind and the waters.

sanskrit_iast: yad vai vāyuḥ parāṅ eva paveta kṣīyeta sa purastād vāti sa dakṣiṇatas sa paścāt sa uttaratas sa upariṣṭāt sa sarvā diśo 'nusaṃvāti |
meaning: यद् वै वायुः पराङ् एव पवेत क्षीयेत स पुरस्ताद् वाति स दक्षिणतस् स पश्चात् स उत्तरतस् स उपरिष्टात् स सर्वा दिशो ऽनुसंवाति ।
text: Truly, if the wind should blow only straight away (pardn), it would be exhausted. It blows from the front (east), from the right (south), from the back (west), from the left (north), from above, it blows from all quarters together,
text_mt:
If Vāyu were to blow only straight away, [he] would perish.
He blows from the east, he from the south, he from the west, he from the north, he from above; he blows around in all directions.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad āhur idānīṃ vā ayam ito 'vāsīd athetthād vātīti sa yad reṣmāṇaṃ janamāno niveṣṭamāno vāti kṣayād eva bibhyat |
meaning: तद् एतद् आहुर् इदानीं वा अयम् इतो ऽवासीद् अथेत्थाद् वातीति स यद् रेष्माणं जनमानो निवेष्टमानो वाति क्षयाद् एव बिभ्यत् ।
text: This they saj'-: " At this very moment it hath blown in this direction, now it bloweth thus." When it blows begetting a whirlwind, winding itself in [it does so] just fearing exhaustion,
text_mt:
Regarding this, they say: 'Just now he was blowing from here; now he blows from there.'
When he blows producing a whirlwind, twisting about, it is out of fear of perishing.

sanskrit_iast: yad u ha vā āpaḥ parācīr eva prasṛtās syanderan kṣīyeraṃs tāḥ yad aṅkāṃsi kurvāṇā niveṣṭamānā āvartān sṛjamānā yanti kṣayād eva bibhyatīḥ tad etad vāyoś caivāpāṃ cānu vartma geyam | prathame 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: यद् उ ह वा आपः पराचीर् एव प्रसृतास् स्यन्देरन् क्षीयेरंस् ताः यद् अङ्कांसि कुर्वाणा निवेष्टमाना आवर्तान् सृजमाना यन्ति क्षयाद् एव बिभ्यतीः तद् एतद् वायोश् चैवापां चानु वर्त्म गेयम् । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: And if the waters should flow streaming straight away (paraolr) only, they would be exhausted. When they proceed making bends, winding themselves in, producing eddies, [they do so] just fearing exhaustion. 8. Therefore that [Śsāman] should be sung according to the course of the wind and waters.
text_mt:
And if the waters were to flow only straight away, they would perish.
When they flow making bends, twisting about, creating whirlpools, it is out of fear of perishing.
Therefore it should be sung following the path of the wind and the waters.
Second khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: ovā ovā ovā hum bhā ovā iti karoty eva etābhyāṃ sarvam āyur eti |
meaning: ओवा ओवा ओवा हुम् भा ओवा इति करोत्य् एव एताभ्यां सर्वम् आयुर् एति ।
text: He utters ova ovd ovd htim, bhd ovd. By means of these two [divinities] he arrives at complete age.
text_mt:
He indeed makes [the sounds]: 'ovā ovā ovā hum bhā ovā'.
By these two, he attains a full lifespan.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathā vṛkṣam ākramaṇair ākramamāṇa iyād evam evaite dve-dve devate saṃdhāyemāṃl lokān rohann eti |
meaning: स यथा वृक्षम् आक्रमणैर् आक्रममाण इयाद् एवम् एवैते द्वे-द्वे देवते संधायेमांल् लोकान् रोहन्न् एति ।
text: As one would keep climbing up a tree by steps, even so uniting these divinities pairwise he keeps ascending these worlds.
text_mt: Just as one would ascend a tree by climbing-steps, just so, joining these deities two by two, he goes mounting these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: eka u eva mṛtyur anvety aśanayaiva |
meaning: एक उ एव मृत्युर् अन्वेत्य् अशनयैव ।
text: Death alone goes after, viz. hunger.
text_mt: And one death alone pursues: hunger alone.

sanskrit_iast: atha hiṅkaroti candramā vai hiṅkāro 'nnam u vai candramāḥ annenāśanayāṃ ghnanti |
meaning: अथ हिङ्करोति चन्द्रमा वै हिङ्कारो ऽन्नम् उ वै चन्द्रमाः अन्नेनाशनयां घ्नन्ति ।
text: Then he utters him. The hinkdra is the moon, and the moon is food. Through food they slay hunger,
text_mt:
Then he makes the hiṅkāra.
The Moon indeed is the hiṅkāra, and food indeed is the Moon.
By food they slay hunger.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ-tām aśanayām annena hatvom ity etam evādityaṃ samayātimucyate etad eva divaś chidram |
meaning: तां-ताम् अशनयाम् अन्नेन हत्वोम् इत्य् एतम् एवादित्यं समयातिमुच्यते एतद् एव दिवश् छिद्रम् ।
text: Having slain through food this hunger and that, saying om., he escapes through the midst of this sun. That is the fissure of the sky.
text_mt:
Having slain that very hunger with food, he is released straight through Āditya with 'om'.
This alone is the aperture of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: yathā khaṃ vānasas syād rathasya vaivam etad divaś chidram tad raśmibhis saṃchannaṃ dṛśyate |
meaning: यथा खं वानसस् स्याद् रथस्य वैवम् एतद् दिवश् छिद्रम् तद् रश्मिभिस् संछन्नं दृश्यते ।
text: As is the [axle-] hole of a cart or of a chariot, even so is this fissure of the sky. That appears all covered by rays.
text_mt:
Just as there might be the opening of a cart or of a chariot, just so is this aperture of heaven.
It is seen covered with rays.

sanskrit_iast: yad gāyatrasyordhvaṃ hiṅkārāt tad amṛtam tad ātmānaṃ dadhyād atho yajamānam atha yad itarat sāmordhvaṃ tasya pratihārāt |
meaning: यद् गायत्रस्योर्ध्वं हिङ्कारात् तद् अमृतम् तद् आत्मानं दध्याद् अथो यजमानम् अथ यद् इतरत् सामोर्ध्वं तस्य प्रतिहारात् ।
text: What of the gāyatra {-sdmari] is beyond the hinkdra, that is immortal. There he should place himself as well as the sacrificer. And the rest of the sdm,an is beyond its pratihāra.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathādbhir āpas saṃsṛjyeran yathāgnināgnis saṃsṛjyeta yathā kṣīre kṣīram āsicyād evam evaitad akṣaram etābhir devatābhis saṃsṛjyate | prathame 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स यथाद्भिर् आपस् संसृज्येरन् यथाग्निनाग्निस् संसृज्येत यथा क्षीरे क्षीरम् आसिच्याद् एवम् एवैतद् अक्षरम् एताभिर् देवताभिस् संसृज्यते । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः ।
text: As waters might be united with waters, as fire might be united with fire, as one would pour milk into milk, even so this syllable is united with these divinities.
text_mt:
Just as waters would blend with waters, as fire would blend with fire, as one would pour milk into milk, just so this syllable blends with these deities.
Third khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vā etaṃ hiṅkāraṃ him bhā iti hiṅkurvanti śrīr vai bhāḥ asau vā ādityo bhā iti |
meaning: तं वा एतं हिङ्कारं हिम् भा इति हिङ्कुर्वन्ति श्रीर् वै भाः असौ वा आदित्यो भा इति ।
text: They utter this same hinkdra as him bhd. Fortune is bhd,s (splendor); yonder sun is bhds.
text_mt:
They indeed make this hiṅkāra as 'him bhā'.
Prosperity indeed is radiance (bhāḥ).
That Āditya indeed is radiance.

sanskrit_iast: etaṃ ha vā etaṃ nyaṅgam anu garbha iti yad bha iti strīṇām prajananaṃ nigacchati tasmāt tato brāhmaṇa ṛṣikalpo jāyate 'tivyādhī rājanyaś śūraḥ |
meaning: एतं ह वा एतं न्यङ्गम् अनु गर्भ इति यद् भ इति स्त्रीणाम् प्रजननं निगच्छति तस्मात् ततो ब्राह्मण ऋषिकल्पो जायते ऽतिव्याधी राजन्यश् शूरः ।
text: According to this same sign is [the word] garbha (foetus). In that he, saying bha, approaches the secret parts of women, therefore thence is born a Brahman like a rsi, a piercing kingly hero.
text_mt:
Following this very inserted syllable, the embryo [comes into being].
When it reaches the generative organ of women with 'bha', from that is born a brāhmaṇa equal to a ṛṣi, or a nobleman who is an archer and a hero.

sanskrit_iast: etaṃ ha vā etaṃ nyaṅgam anu vṛṣabha iti yad bha iti nigacchati tasmāt tataḥ puṇyo balīvardo duhānā dhenur ukṣā daśavājī jāyante |
meaning: एतं ह वा एतं न्यङ्गम् अनु वृषभ इति यद् भ इति निगच्छति तस्मात् ततः पुण्यो बलीवर्दो दुहाना धेनुर् उक्षा दशवाजी जायन्ते ।
text: According to this same sign is [the word] vrsabha (bull). In that he approaches saying bha, therefore thence a [sacrificially] pure bull, a milking cow, an ox possessing tenfold strength (?) are born.
text_mt:
Following this very inserted syllable, the bull [comes into being].
When it reaches [the cow] with 'bha', from that are born an excellent draft-ox, a milking cow, a bull, or a stallion that mates ten times.

sanskrit_iast: etaṃ ha vā etaṃ nyaṅgam anu gardabha iti yad bha iti nigacchati tasmāt sa pāpīyāñ chreyasīṣu carati tasmād asya pāpīyasaś śreyo jāyate 'śvataro vāśvatarī vā |
meaning: एतं ह वा एतं न्यङ्गम् अनु गर्दभ इति यद् भ इति निगच्छति तस्मात् स पापीयाञ् छ्रेयसीषु चरति तस्माद् अस्य पापीयसश् श्रेयो जायते ऽश्वतरो वाश्वतरी वा ।
text: According to this same sign is [the word] gardabha (ass). In that he approaches saying bha, therefore he (the ass) being inferior covers those [mares] which are superior; therefore of this inferior one something better is born, either a mule or a she-mule.
text_mt:
Following this very inserted syllable, the donkey [comes into being].
When it reaches [the female] with 'bha', therefore he, being baser, goes upon superior females; therefore from him, the baser one, superior offspring is born: a he-mule or a she-mule.

sanskrit_iast: etaṃ ha vā etaṃ nyaṅgam anu kubhra iti yad bha iti nigacchati tasmāt so 'nāryas sann api rājñaḥ prāpnoti |
meaning: एतं ह वा एतं न्यङ्गम् अनु कुभ्र इति यद् भ इति निगच्छति तस्मात् सो ऽनार्यस् सन्न् अपि राज्ञः प्राप्नोति ।
text: According to this same sign is [the word) kubhra. In that he approaches saying bha, therefore he, even though he be not an Arya, obtains kings (?).
text_mt:
Following this very inserted syllable, the hunchback [comes into being].
When it reaches with 'bha', therefore he, though of non-noble stock, reaches kings.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ haitam eke hiṅkāraṃ him bhā ovā iti bahirdheva hiṅkurvanti bahirdheva vai śrīḥ śrīr vai sāmno hiṅkāra iti |
meaning: तं हैतम् एके हिङ्कारं हिम् भा ओवा इति बहिर्धेव हिङ्कुर्वन्ति बहिर्धेव वै श्रीः श्रीर् वै साम्नो हिङ्कार इति ।
text: This same hiiikdra some utter him bhd ova—outside as it were. Truly outside is fortune; fortune indeed is the syllable Mm of the sāman.

sanskrit_iast: sa ya enaṃ tatra brūyād bahirdhā nvā ayaṃ śriyam adhita pāpīyān bhaviṣyati sa yadā vai mriyate 'thāgnau prāsto bhavati kṣipre bata mariṣyaty agnāv enam prāsiṣyantī ti tathā haiva syāt |
meaning: स य एनं तत्र ब्रूयाद् बहिर्धा न्वा अयं श्रियम् अधित पापीयान् भविष्यति स यदा वै म्रियते ऽथाग्नौ प्रास्तो भवति क्षिप्रे बत मरिष्यत्य् अग्नाव् एनम् प्रासिष्यन्ती ति तथा हैव स्यात् ।
text: If upon this one should say of him: " Truly he hath now put fortune outside, he will become worse; Truly, when he dies, he is thrown into the fire; quickly, alas, he will die, they will throw him into the fire—" even so it would come to pass.
text_mt:
If someone were to say of him there: 'This one has indeed placed prosperity outside; he will become poorer.
When he dies, then he is cast into the fire.
Alas, he will soon die; they will cast him into the fire'—it would indeed be so.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād u haitaṃ hiṅkāraṃ hiṃ vo ity antar ivaivātmann arjayet tathā ha na bahirdhā śriyaṃ kurute sarvam āyur eti | prathame 'nuvāke caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तस्माद् उ हैतं हिङ्कारं हिं वो इत्य् अन्तर् इवैवात्मन्न् अर्जयेत् तथा ह न बहिर्धा श्रियं कुरुते सर्वम् आयुर् एति । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके चतुर्थः खण्डः ।
text: And therefore one should put that hinkdra, viz. him vo, inside of one's self, as it were. Thus, indeed, he does not put fortune outside, he attains complete age.
text_mt:
Therefore, he should procure this hiṅkāra within the self, as it were, with 'hiṃ vo'.
Thus he does not put prosperity outside; he attains a full lifespan.
Fourth khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sā haiṣā khalā devatāpasedhantī tiṣṭhati idaṃ vai tvam atra pāpam akar ṇehaiṣyasi yo vai puṇyakṛt syāt sa iheyād iti |
meaning: सा हैषा खला देवतापसेधन्ती तिष्ठति इदं वै त्वम् अत्र पापम् अकर् णेहैष्यसि यो वै पुण्यकृत् स्यात् स इहेयाद् इति ।
text: This same base divinity stands driving away; "This evil thou hast done here; thou shalt not come here. Verily he who is doer of good deeds, he may come here."
text_mt:
That harsh deity stands warding off [the departing soul]:
'You did this evil deed here; you shall not come here. Only one who is a doer of good deeds may come here.'

sanskrit_iast: sa brūyād apaśyo vai tvaṃ tad yad ahaṃ tad akaravaṃ tad vai mā tvaṃ nākārayiṣyas tvaṃ vai tasya kartāsīti |
meaning: स ब्रूयाद् अपश्यो वै त्वं तद् यद् अहं तद् अकरवं तद् वै मा त्वं नाकारयिष्यस् त्वं वै तस्य कर्तासीति ।
text: Let him say: " Thou sawest what I thus did; thou wonldst not make me do this; thou art doer of it."
text_mt: He should say: 'You indeed saw what I did; you would not have made me do it [otherwise]; you indeed are the doer of it.'

sanskrit_iast: sā ha veda satyam māheti satyaṃ haiṣā devatā sā ha tasya neśe yad enam apasedhet satyam upaiva hvayate |
meaning: सा ह वेद सत्यम् माहेति सत्यं हैषा देवता सा ह तस्य नेशे यद् एनम् अपसेधेत् सत्यम् उपैव ह्वयते ।
text: That [divinity] knows: "He tells me truth." This divinity is truth. It is not competent_to drive him away; he just calls upon truth.
text_mt:
That [deity] knows: 'He speaks the truth to me.'
For that deity is truth.
She has no power to ward him off; she even invites the truth.

sanskrit_iast: atha hovācaikṣvāko vā vārṣṇo 'nuvaktā vā sātyakīrta utaiṣā khalā devatāpaseddhum eva dhriyate 'syai diśaḥ |
meaning: अथ होवाचैक्ष्वाको वा वार्ष्णो ऽनुवक्ता वा सात्यकीर्त उतैषा खला देवतापसेद्धुम् एव ध्रियते ऽस्यै दिशः ।
text: Now either Aiksvaka Varsna or Anuvaktar Satyakirta said: " And this base divinity begins to drive away from this quarter.
text_mt: Then said Aikṣvāka or Vārṣṇa the reciter, or Sātyakīrta: 'And this harsh deity is resolved to ward off from this quarter.'

sanskrit_iast: divo 'ntaḥ tad ime dyāvāpṛthivī saṃśliṣyataḥ yāvatī vai vedis tāvatīyam pṛthivī tad yatraitac cātvālaṃ khātaṃ tat samprati sa diva ākāśaḥ |
meaning: दिवो ऽन्तः तद् इमे द्यावापृथिवी संश्लिष्यतः यावती वै वेदिस् तावतीयम् पृथिवी तद् यत्रैतच् चात्वालं खातं तत् सम्प्रति स दिव आकाशः ।
text: [There] is the end of the sky; there heaven and earth embrace. So great as the sacrificial hearth is, so great is this earth; and where that ditch (for the northern altar) is dug, precisely there is that space of the sky.
text_mt:
[That] is the end of heaven.
There these two, heaven and earth, meet.
As large as the sacrificial altar ground is, so large is this earth.
Now where this cātvāla pit is dug, that directly corresponds to the open space of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: tad bahiṣpavamāne stūyamāne manasodgṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: तद् बहिष्पवमाने स्तूयमाने मनसोद्गृह्णीयात् ।
text: Thus, when the bahispavamdna is being sung, he should take up [the cup] with the mind.
text_mt: When the bahiṣpavamāna is being praised, one should take hold of that with the mind.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathocchrāyam pratiyasya prapadyetaivam evaitayā devatayedam amṛtam abhiparyeti yatrāyam idaṃ tapatīti |
meaning: स यथोच्छ्रायम् प्रतियस्य प्रपद्येतैवम् एवैतया देवतयेदम् अमृतम् अभिपर्येति यत्रायम् इदं तपतीति ।
text: As one would approach an elevation, toiling toward [it], even thus by means of this divinity one compasses this immortality, where this one here burns,
text_mt: Just as one would enter [a height] by resting against an ascent, just so, by means of this deity, he passes around this immortal [realm] where this [sun] burns here.

sanskrit_iast: atha hovāca | prathame 'nuvāke pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: अथ होवाच । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके पञ्चमः खण्डः ।
text: Moreover —
text_mt:
Then he said—
Fifth khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: gobalo vārṣṇaḥ ka etam ādityam arhati samayaitum dūrād vā eṣa etat tapati nyaṅ tena vā etam pūrveṇa sāmapathas tad eva manasāhṛtyopariṣṭād etasyaitasminn amṛte nidadhyād iti |
meaning: गोबलो वार्ष्णः क एतम् आदित्यम् अर्हति समयैतुम् दूराद् वा एष एतत् तपति न्यङ् तेन वा एतम् पूर्वेण सामपथस् तद् एव मनसाहृत्योपरिष्टाद् एतस्यैतस्मिन्न् अमृते निदध्याद् इति ।
text: — Gobala Varsna said: "Who is able to go through the midst of this sun? Verily from afar he thus burns downward. On that account, verily, the sama;i-path is before him (?); seizing [him] thus with the mind he should place him above this one in this immortality.
text_mt: — Gobala Vārṣṇa [said]: 'Who is capable of going through this Āditya? From afar, indeed, he shines thus downwards. Through this former path of the sāman, having grasped it with the mind, one should place it above this in that immortal.'

sanskrit_iast: tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanis samayaivaitad enaṃ kas tad veda yady etā āpo vā abhito yad vāyuṃ vā eṣa upahvayate raśmīn vā eṣa tad etasmai vyūhatīti |
meaning: तद् उ होवाच शाट्यायनिस् समयैवैतद् एनं कस् तद् वेद यद्य् एता आपो वा अभितो यद् वायुं वा एष उपह्वयते रश्मीन् वा एष तद् एतस्मै व्यूहतीति ।
text: Further Qatyayani said: "' Thus through the midst of him,' who knows that? Truly when he either calls upon these waters round about, or when upon the wind, he then parts the rays for him."
text_mt: Then Śāṭyāyani said: 'Just through this [Āditya] it is. Who knows that? If these waters are around, or when he invokes Vāyu, he then scatters his rays for him.'

sanskrit_iast: atha hovācolukyo jānaśruteyo yatra vā eṣa etat tapaty etad evāmṛtam etac ced vai prāpnoti tato mṛtyunā pāpmanā vyāvartate |
meaning: अथ होवाचोलुक्यो जानश्रुतेयो यत्र वा एष एतत् तपत्य् एतद् एवामृतम् एतच् चेद् वै प्राप्नोति ततो मृत्युना पाप्मना व्यावर्तते ।
text: Further Ulukya Janajruteya said: " Truly, where this one burns thus, there is this immortality. If one obtains this, he thereupon separates himself from death, from evil.
text_mt: Then Ulukya Jānaśruteya said: 'Where he shines thus, that alone is the immortal. If one reaches this, from that he turns away from death, from evil.'

sanskrit_iast: kas tad veda yat pareṇādityam antarikṣam idam anālayanam avareṇa |
meaning: कस् तद् वेद यत् परेणादित्यम् अन्तरिक्षम् इदम् अनालयनम् अवरेण ।
text: Who knows that which is beyond the sun, beneath this abodeless atmosphere?
text_mt: 'Who knows that which is beyond Āditya? This intermediate space below has no resting-place.'

sanskrit_iast: athaitad evāmṛtam etad eva māṃ yūyam prāpayiṣyatha etad evāhaṃ nātimanya iti |
meaning: अथैतद् एवामृतम् एतद् एव मां यूयम् प्रापयिष्यथ एतद् एवाहं नातिमन्य इति ।
text: And just this is immortality. This you will cause me to obtain. This I do not despise." 6. = i. 1. s.
text_mt: 'Now this alone is the immortal. To this alone shall you bring me. This alone I do not despise.'

sanskrit_iast: tāny etāny aṣṭau aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī gāyatraṃ sāma brahma u gāyatrī tad u brahmābhisampadyate aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavas teno paśavyam | prathame 'nuvāke ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तान्य् एतान्य् अष्टौ अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री गायत्रं साम ब्रह्म उ गायत्री तद् उ ब्रह्माभिसम्पद्यते अष्टाशफाः पशवस् तेनो पशव्यम् । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके षष्ठः खण्डः ।
text_mt:
These eight are they. The gāyatrī has eight syllables. The gāyatra is the sāman, and the gāyatrī is brahman. Thus it becomes brahman. Cattle have eight hooves; thereby it is connected with cattle.
Sixth khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: tā etā aṣṭau devatāḥ etāvad idaṃ sarvam te karoti |
meaning: ता एता अष्टौ देवताः एतावद् इदं सर्वम् ते करोति ।
text: These are these eight divinities. So great is the universe. They [ ] does.
text_mt: These are the eight deities. This whole [universe] is so much. […] makes for them.

sanskrit_iast: sa naiṣu lokeṣu pāpmane bhrātṛvyāyāvakāśaṃ kuryāt manasainaṃ nirbhajet |
meaning: स नैषु लोकेषु पाप्मने भ्रातृव्यायावकाशं कुर्यात् मनसैनं निर्भजेत् ।
text: He should not give an opportunity in these worlds to his hateful rival. He should exclude him with his mind.
text_mt: He should not leave any room in these worlds for an evil rival. With the mind he should exclude him.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad ṛcābhyanūcyate catvāri vāk parimitā padāni tāni vidur brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadantī ti |
meaning: तद् एतद् ऋचाभ्यनूच्यते चत्वारि वाक् परिमिता पदानि तानि विदुर् ब्राह्मणा ये मनीषिणः गुहा त्रीणि निहिता नेङ्गयन्ति तुरीयं वाचो मनुष्या वदन्ती ति ।
text: That same is referred to in a re: " Speech is four measured quarters; Brahmans who are wise know these; three, deposited in secret, do not stir; one quarter of speech men speak."
text_mt:
About this it is said in a ṛc:
'Speech has been measured into four quarters; the wise brāhmaṇas know them.
Three, hidden in secret, do not stir; the fourth [quarter] of speech human beings speak.'

sanskrit_iast: tad yāni tāni guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayantītīma eva te lokāḥ |
meaning: तद् यानि तानि गुहा त्रीणि निहिता नेङ्गयन्तीतीम एव ते लोकाः ।
text: Now these ' three [quarters] deposited in secret which do not stir,' they are these worlds.
text_mt: As to those three which, 'hidden in secret, do not stir,' these worlds indeed are they.

sanskrit_iast: turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadantīti caturbhāgo ha vai turīyaṃ vācaḥ sarvayāsya vācā sarvair ebhir lokais sarveṇāsya kṛtam bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: तुरीयं वाचो मनुष्या वदन्तीति चतुर्भागो ह वै तुरीयं वाचः सर्वयास्य वाचा सर्वैर् एभिर् लोकैस् सर्वेणास्य कृतम् भवति य एवं वेद ।
text: ' One quarter of speech men speak.' A fourth part indeed is this quarter of speech. Of him who knows thus it (?) is done by all speech, by all these worlds, by the all.
text_mt: 'The fourth [quarter] of speech human beings speak'—the fourth part of speech is indeed a quarter. Everything is accomplished for him with all speech, with all these worlds, with all, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathāśmānam ākhaṇam ṛtvā loṣṭo vidhvaṃsata evam eva sa vidhvaṃsate ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati | prathame 'nuvāke saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ prathamo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: स यथाश्मानम् आखणम् ऋत्वा लोष्टो विध्वंसत एवम् एव स विध्वंसते य एवं विद्वांसम् उपवदति । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके सप्तमः खण्डः प्रथमो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: As a clod of earth colliding with a stone as target breaks to pieces, even so he breaks to pieces who speaks ill of one knowing thus.
text_mt:
Just as a lump of earth striking a solid stone is shattered, so indeed is he shattered who reviles one who knows thus.
Seventh khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.
The first anuvāka is completed.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vā idaṃ trayeṇa vedenājayad yad asyedaṃ jitaṃ tat |
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वा इदं त्रयेण वेदेनाजयद् यद् अस्येदं जितं तत् ।
text_mt: Prajāpati indeed conquered with the threefold Veda this [world] that is here conquered by him.

sanskrit_iast: sa aikṣatetthaṃ ced vā anye devā anena vedena yakṣyanta imāṃ vāva te jitiṃ jeṣyanti ye 'yam mama |
meaning: स ऐक्षतेत्थं चेद् वा अन्ये देवा अनेन वेदेन यक्ष्यन्त इमां वाव ते जितिं जेष्यन्ति ये ऽयम् मम ।
text_mt: He considered: 'If other gods sacrifice with this Veda in this manner, they will win this very conquest which is mine.'

sanskrit_iast: hantemaṃ trayaṃ vedam pīḷayānīti |
meaning: हन्तेमं त्रयं वेदम् पीऌअयानीति ।
text: Come now, I will press this threefold knowledge (Veda)."
text_mt: 'Come, let me squeeze this threefold Veda.'

sanskrit_iast: sa imaṃ trayaṃ vedam apīḷayat tasya pīḷayann ekam evākṣaraṃ nāśaknot pīḷayitum om iti yad etat |
meaning: स इमं त्रयं वेदम् अपीऌअयत् तस्य पीऌअयन्न् एकम् एवाक्षरं नाशक्नोत् पीऌअयितुम् ओम् इति यद् एतत् ।
text: He pressed this threefold knowledge (Veda). Pressing, he could not press one syllable of it, viz. om.
text_mt: He squeezed this threefold Veda. While squeezing it, one syllable alone he could not squeeze: this one, namely om.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa u ha vāva sarasaḥ sarasā ha vā evaṃvidas trayī vidyā bhavati |
meaning: एष उ ह वाव सरसः सरसा ह वा एवंविदस् त्रयी विद्या भवति ।
text: And that, indeed, is full of sap. Full of sap is the threefold knowledge of him who knows thus.
text_mt: This indeed is full of essence. Full of essence indeed becomes the threefold knowledge of one who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: sa imaṃ rasam pīḷayitvāpanidhāyordhvo 'dravat |
meaning: स इमं रसम् पीऌअयित्वापनिधायोर्ध्वो ऽद्रवत् ।
text: He, having pressed this sap, putting it aside, ran upward.
text_mt: Having squeezed this essence [and] put it aside, he ran upward.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ dravantaṃ catvāro devānām anvapaśyann indraś candro rudras samudraḥ tasmād ete śreṣṭhā devānām ete hy enam anvapaśyan |
meaning: तं द्रवन्तं चत्वारो देवानाम् अन्वपश्यन्न् इन्द्रश् चन्द्रो रुद्रस् समुद्रः तस्माद् एते श्रेष्ठा देवानाम् एते ह्य् एनम् अन्वपश्यन् ।
text: Him running four of the gods looked after, Indra, Candra, Rudra, Samudi-a. Therefore these are the best of the gods. For they looked after him.
text_mt: As he was running, four among the gods saw him: Indra, Moon, Rudra, [and] the Ocean. Therefore these are the best of the gods, for they saw him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yo 'yaṃ rasa āsīt tad eva tapo 'bhavat |
meaning: स यो ऽयं रस आसीत् तद् एव तपो ऽभवत् ।
text: What this sap was, that became penance (tojoas).
text_mt: This essence which there was, that became austerity (tapas).

sanskrit_iast: ta imaṃ rasaṃ devā anvaikṣanta te 'bhyapaśyant sa tapo vā abhūd iti |
meaning: त इमं रसं देवा अन्वैक्षन्त ते ऽभ्यपश्यन्त् स तपो वा अभूद् इति ।
text: These gods looked after this sap. They became aware: " Verily this [sap] hath become penance."
text_mt: The gods looked after this essence. They perceived: 'It has become austerity.'

sanskrit_iast: imam u vai trayaṃ vedam marīmṛśitvā tasminn etad evākṣaram apīḷitam avindann om iti yad etat |
meaning: इमम् उ वै त्रयं वेदम् मरीमृशित्वा तस्मिन्न् एतद् एवाक्षरम् अपीऌइतम् अविन्दन्न् ओम् इति यद् एतत् ।
text: They, feeling this threefold knowledge (Veda) all over, found in it that same unpressed syllable, viz. om.
text_mt: Having thoroughly examined this threefold Veda, they found in it this very unsqueezed syllable: this one, namely om.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa u ha vāva sarasaḥ tenainam prāyuvan yathā madhunā lājān prayuyād evam |
meaning: एष उ ह वाव सरसः तेनैनम् प्रायुवन् यथा मधुना लाजान् प्रयुयाद् एवम् ।
text: And that, indeed, is full ef sap. They mixed it with that, just so as one might mix beans with honey.
text_mt: This indeed is full of essence. With it they mixed it, just as one would mix parched grain with honey.

sanskrit_iast: te 'bhyatapyanta teṣāṃ tapyamānānām āpyāyata vedaḥ te 'nena ca tapasāpīnena ca vedena tām u eva jitim ajayan yām prajāpatir ajayat ta ete sarva eva prajāpatimātrā ayā3m ayā3m iti |
meaning: ते ऽभ्यतप्यन्त तेषां तप्यमानानाम् आप्यायत वेदः ते ऽनेन च तपसापीनेन च वेदेन ताम् उ एव जितिम् अजयन् याम् प्रजापतिर् अजयत् त एते सर्व एव प्रजापतिमात्रा अया3म् अया3म् इति ।
text: They brooded over [it] (did penance). Of them brooding over [it] knowledge (the Veda) was filled up. And by means of this heat (penance) and the filled up Veda they conquered that conquest which Prajapati [had] conquered. All these are just commensurate with Prajapati, [of whom one may doubt:] "Is it this one? Is it this one?"
text_mt: They performed austerity. As they were performing austerity, the Veda swelled. With this austerity and with the swollen Veda, they won that very conquest which Prajāpati had won. All these [gods] were of the same measure as Prajāpati, [saying]: 'This is I! This is I!'

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt tapyamānasya bhūyasī kīrtir bhavati bhūyo yaśaḥ sa ya etad evaṃ vedaivam evāpīnena vedena yajate yado yājayaty evam evāpīnena vedena yājayati |
meaning: तस्मात् तप्यमानस्य भूयसी कीर्तिर् भवति भूयो यशः स य एतद् एवं वेदैवम् एवापीनेन वेदेन यजते यदो याजयत्य् एवम् एवापीनेन वेदेन याजयति ।
text: Therefore greater becomes the renown, greater the glory of one who does penance. He who knows this thus sacrifices for himself by means of the filled-up Veda; and when he sacrifices for anyone else he thus sacrifices for him by means of the filled-up Veda.
text_mt: Therefore greater fame comes to one who performs austerity, greater glory. He who knows this thus sacrifices with a swollen Veda in this very way. If he officiates for another, he officiates with a swollen Veda in this very way.

sanskrit_iast: tasya haitasya naiva kā canārtir asti ya evaṃ veda sa ya evainam upavadati sa ārtim ṛcchati | dvitīye 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तस्य हैतस्य नैव का चनार्तिर् अस्ति य एवं वेद स य एवैनम् उपवदति स आर्तिम् ऋच्छति । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: For him who knows thus there is no misfortune at all. He who speaks ill of him, he meets with misfortune.
text_mt:
There is no distress whatsoever for him who knows thus. Whosoever reviles him meets with distress.
First khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad ovā ovā iti gīyate kvātrarg bhavati kva sāmeti |
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् ओवा ओवा इति गीयते क्वात्रर्ग् भवति क्व सामेति ।
text: This they say: "If one sings ovd ovd, what becomes of the re, what of the sāman?"
text_mt: Now they say: 'When it is sung as *ovā ovā*, where is the ṛc here, where the sāman?'

sanskrit_iast: om iti vai sāma vāg ity ṛk om iti mano vāg iti vāk om iti prāṇo vāg ity eva vāk om itīndro vāg iti sarve devāḥ tad etad indram eva sarve devā anuyanti |
meaning: ओम् इति वै साम वाग् इत्य् ऋक् ओम् इति मनो वाग् इति वाक् ओम् इति प्राणो वाग् इत्य् एव वाक् ओम् इतीन्द्रो वाग् इति सर्वे देवाः तद् एतद् इन्द्रम् एव सर्वे देवा अनुयन्ति ।
text: Om is the sāman, speech is the re; otn is the mind, speech is speech; om, is breath, speech is just speech; om is Indra, speech is all the gods. Thus all the gods go after Indra.
text_mt: Om is the sāman, speech is the ṛc. Om is the mind, speech is speech. Om is the breath, speech is speech. Om is Indra, speech is all the gods. Thus all the gods follow Indra alone.

sanskrit_iast: om ity etad evākṣaram etena vai saṃsave parasyendraṃ vṛñjīta etena ha vai tad bako dālbhya ājakeśinām indraṃ vavarja om ity etenaivānināya |
meaning: ओम् इत्य् एतद् एवाक्षरम् एतेन वै संसवे परस्येन्द्रं वृञ्जीत एतेन ह वै तद् बको दाल्भ्य आजकेशिनाम् इन्द्रं ववर्ज ओम् इत्य् एतेनैवानिनाय ।
text: Om is this syllable; by it at a simultaneous soma-sacrifice one would force Indra away from his rival. Truly by means of it Baka Dalbhya forced Indra away from the Ajakejins; just by means of this om he led [him] to himself. 4 = 1. 1. 8.
text_mt: Om is this very syllable. By means of it one should appropriate the Indra of another at a concurrent soma-pressing (saṃsava). By means of it, Baka Dālbhya appropriated the Indra of the Ājakeśins; with this very [syllable] om he led him away.

sanskrit_iast: tāny etāny aṣṭau aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī gāyatraṃ sāma brahma u gāyatrī tad u brahmābhisampadyate aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavas teno paśavyam |
meaning: तान्य् एतान्य् अष्टौ अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री गायत्रं साम ब्रह्म उ गायत्री तद् उ ब्रह्माभिसम्पद्यते अष्टाशफाः पशवस् तेनो पशव्यम् ।
text_mt: These eight are they. The gāyatrī has eight syllables. The gāyatra is the sāman, and the gāyatrī is brahman. Thus it becomes brahman. Cattle have eight hooves; thereby it is connected with cattle.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaitāni nāmānīndraḥ karmākṣitir amṛtaṃ vyomānto vācaḥ bahur bhūyas sarvaṃ sarvasmād uttaraṃ jyotiḥ ṛtaṃ satyaṃ vijñānaṃ vivācanam aprativācyam pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ sarvā vāk sarvam idam api dhenuḥ pinvate parāg arvāk | dvitīye 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तस्यैतानि नामानीन्द्रः कर्माक्षितिर् अमृतं व्योमान्तो वाचः बहुर् भूयस् सर्वं सर्वस्माद् उत्तरं ज्योतिः ऋतं सत्यं विज्ञानं विवाचनम् अप्रतिवाच्यम् पूर्वं सर्वं सर्वा वाक् सर्वम् इदम् अपि धेनुः पिन्वते पराग् अर्वाक् । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: These are its names: Indra, action, imperishableness, the immortal, end of the firmament of speech (?); the manifold, the numerous, the all, the light higher than the all; righteousness, truth, distinction, decision which is not to be contradicted; the ancient all, all speech. This all also, [like] a cow, fattens thitherward, hitherward.
text_mt:
These are its names: Indra, action, imperishability, immortal, sky's end of speech, manifold, greater, all, higher than all, light, cosmic order (ṛta), truth, discernment, pronouncement, unanswerable, first, all, all speech; this whole milch cow swells outward and inward.
Second khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sā pṛthaksalilaṃ kāmadughākṣiti prāṇasaṃhitaṃ cakṣuśśrotraṃ vākprabhūtam manasā vyāptaṃ hṛdayāgram brāhmaṇabhaktam annaśubhaṃ varṣapavitraṃ gobhagam pṛthivyuparaṃ tapastanu varuṇapariyatanam indraśreṣṭhaṃ sahasrākṣaram ayutadhāram amṛtaṃ duhānā sarvān imāṃl lokān abhivikṣaratīti |
meaning: सा पृथक्सलिलं कामदुघाक्षिति प्राणसंहितं चक्षुश्श्रोत्रं वाक्प्रभूतम् मनसा व्याप्तं हृदयाग्रम् ब्राह्मणभक्तम् अन्नशुभं वर्षपवित्रं गोभगम् पृथिव्युपरं तपस्तनु वरुणपरियतनम् इन्द्रश्रेष्ठं सहस्राक्षरम् अयुतधारम् अमृतं दुहाना सर्वान् इमांल् लोकान् अभिविक्षरतीति ।
text: She that milks immortality possessing individual oceans (?), possessing wish-granting imperishableness, connected with breath, possessing sight and hearing, superior by speech, permeated by the mind, having the heart as its point, apportioned to the Brahmans, pleasant through food, having the rain as means of purification (?), cow-protecting, higher than the earth, having penance as a body, having Varuna as an enclosure, having.Indra as leader, possessing a thousand syllables, possessing ten thousand streams, flows in all directions unto all these worlds,
text_mt: Yielding separate waters, yielding desires, imperishable, united with breath, sight and hearing, rich in speech, pervaded by the mind, heart-pointed, apportioned to brāhmaṇas, bright with food, purified by rain, possessing cattle, with earth as its base, having austerity as body, enclosing Varuṇa, having Indra as the highest, with a thousand syllables, yielding ten thousand streams, milking out the immortal, it flows across all these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: tad etat satyam akṣaraṃ yad om iti tasminn āpaḥ pratiṣṭhitā apsu pṛthivī pṛthivyām ime lokāḥ |
meaning: तद् एतत् सत्यम् अक्षरं यद् ओम् इति तस्मिन्न् आपः प्रतिष्ठिता अप्सु पृथिवी पृथिव्याम् इमे लोकाः ।
text: Om is this same true syllable. In it the waters are firmly set, in the waters the earth, in the earth these worlds,
text_mt: This true syllable is om. In it the waters are established, the earth in the waters, these worlds in the earth.

sanskrit_iast: yathā sūcyā palāśāni saṃtṛṇṇāni syur evam etenākṣareṇeme lokās saṃtṛṇṇāḥ |
meaning: यथा सूच्या पलाशानि संतृण्णानि स्युर् एवम् एतेनाक्षरेणेमे लोकास् संतृण्णाः ।
text: As leaves might be stuck together with a pin, so these worlds are stuck together by this syllable.
text_mt: Just as leaves would be pierced together with a needle, so are these worlds pierced together with this syllable.

sanskrit_iast: tad idam imān atividhya daśadhā kṣarati śatadhā sahasradhāyutadhā prayutadhā rbudadhā nyarbudadhā nikharvadhā padmam akṣitir vyomāntaḥ |
meaning: तद् इदम् इमान् अतिविध्य दशधा क्षरति शतधा सहस्रधायुतधा प्रयुतधा र्बुदधा न्यर्बुदधा निखर्वधा पद्मम् अक्षितिर् व्योमान्तः ।
text: That same having pierced thorn flows tenfold, hundredfold, thousandfold, ten thousandfold, hundred thousandfold, millionfold, ten millionfold, hundred millionfold, billionfold, ten billionfold, hundred billionfold, thousand billionfold.
text_mt: Piercing through these [worlds], it flows tenfold, a hundredfold, a thousandfold, ten-thousandfold, a hundred-thousandfold, a millionfold, ten-millionfold, a hundred-millionfold, ten-billionfold, a hundred-billionfold, a trillionfold, imperishability, the end of the sky.

sanskrit_iast: yathaugho viṣyandamānaḥ paraḥ-parovarīyān bhavaty evam evaitad akṣaram paraḥ-parovarīyo bhavati |
meaning: यथौघो विष्यन्दमानः परः-परोवरीयान् भवत्य् एवम् एवैतद् अक्षरम् परः-परोवरीयो भवति ।
text_mt: Just as a flood overflowing becomes wider and wider, so indeed this syllable becomes wider and wider.

sanskrit_iast: te haite lokā ūrdhvā eva śritāḥ ima evaṃ trayodaśamāsāḥ |
meaning: ते हैते लोका ऊर्ध्वा एव श्रिताः इम एवं त्रयोदशमासाः ।
text: As a flood flowing in different directions [proceeding] farther and farther becomes broader, even so this syllable [proceeding] farther ard farther becomes broader. «. These same worlds are lying [piled] upward [one above the other]. They thus are of thirteen months.
text_mt: These worlds are supported upright. These are thus the thirteen months.

sanskrit_iast: sa ya evaṃ vidvān udgāyati sa evam evaitāṃl lokān ativahati om ity etenākṣareṇāmum ādityam mukha ādhatte eṣa ha vā etad akṣaram |
meaning: स य एवं विद्वान् उद्गायति स एवम् एवैतांल् लोकान् अतिवहति ओम् इत्य् एतेनाक्षरेणामुम् आदित्यम् मुख आधत्ते एष ह वा एतद् अक्षरम् ।
text: He who knowing thus sings the udgītha, he carries [the sacrificer] beyond these worlds. By means of this syllable om he places yonder sun in his mouth. Verily it (the sun) is this syllable.
text_mt: He who, knowing thus, sings as udgātṛ, carries these worlds beyond in this very way. With this syllable om, he places that Āditya in his mouth; for this [Āditya] is that syllable.

sanskrit_iast: tasya sarvam āptam bhavati sarvaṃ jitaṃ na hāsya kaś cana kāmo 'nāpto bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: तस्य सर्वम् आप्तम् भवति सर्वं जितं न हास्य कश् चन कामो ऽनाप्तो भवति य एवं वेद ।
text: Whoso knows thus, by him all is obtained, all conquered, of him no desire whatsoever is unfulfilled.
text_mt: Everything is obtained by him, everything is won; no desire whatsoever remains unobtained for him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: tad dha pṛthur vainyo divyān vrātyān papraccha sthūṇāṃ divastambhanīṃ sūryam āhur antarikṣe sūryaḥ pṛthivīpratiṣṭhaḥ apsu bhūmīś śiśyire bhūribhārāḥ kiṃ svin mahīr adhitiṣṭhanty āpa iti |
meaning: तद् ध पृथुर् वैन्यो दिव्यान् व्रात्यान् पप्रच्छ स्थूणां दिवस्तम्भनीं सूर्यम् आहुर् अन्तरिक्षे सूर्यः पृथिवीप्रतिष्ठः अप्सु भूमीश् शिश्यिरे भूरिभाराः किं स्विन् महीर् अधितिष्ठन्त्य् आप इति ।
text: Now Prtliu Vainya asked the divine mendicants: "They call the sun (surya) a sky-supporting post; in the atmosphere is the sun having the earth as a support; in the waters the much-bearing earths lie; on what, pray, do the great waters rest?"
text_mt:
Regarding this, Pṛthu Vainya asked the divine Vrātyas:
‘They say the sun is the pillar prop of heaven; the sun in the intermediate space is supported on the earth.
The lands, bearing heavy loads, lie on the waters. On what, pray, do the great waters rest?’

sanskrit_iast: te ha pratyūcus sthūṇām eva divastambhanīṃ sūryam āhur antarikṣe sūryaḥ pṛthivīpratiṣṭhaḥ apsu bhūmīś śiśyire bhūribhārās satyam mahīr adhitiṣṭhanty āpa iti |
meaning: ते ह प्रत्यूचुस् स्थूणाम् एव दिवस्तम्भनीं सूर्यम् आहुर् अन्तरिक्षे सूर्यः पृथिवीप्रतिष्ठः अप्सु भूमीश् शिश्यिरे भूरिभारास् सत्यम् महीर् अधितिष्ठन्त्य् आप इति ।
text: They answered: "They do call the sun a sky-supporting post; in the atmosphere is the sun having the earth as a support; in the waters the muchbearing earths lie; on truth the great waters rest."
text_mt:
They replied to him:
‘They say the sun indeed is the pillar prop of heaven; the sun in the intermediate space is supported on the earth.
The lands, bearing heavy loads, lie on the waters. The great waters rest on truth.’

sanskrit_iast: om ity etad evākṣaraṃ satyam tad etad āpo 'dhitiṣṭhanti | dvitīye 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ dvitīyo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: ओम् इत्य् एतद् एवाक्षरं सत्यम् तद् एतद् आपो ऽधितिष्ठन्ति । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः द्वितीयो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: This syllable om is truth. Thereon, then, the waters rest.
text_mt:
Truth is this very syllable, “om”.
It is upon this that the waters rest.
Third khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.
The second anuvāka is completed.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā enaṃ sṛṣṭā annakāśinīr abhitas samantam paryaviśan |
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ता एनं सृष्टा अन्नकाशिनीर् अभितस् समन्तम् पर्यविशन् ।
text: Prajapati created creatures. They being created beleaguered him completely on all sides, yearning for food (?).
text_mt:
Prajāpati created creatures.
Once created, eager for food, they sat around him on all sides.

sanskrit_iast: tā abravīt kiṃkāmās stheti annādyakāmā ity abruvan |
meaning: ता अब्रवीत् किंकामास् स्थेति अन्नाद्यकामा इत्य् अब्रुवन् ।
text: He said to them: " What is your desire?" " We are desirous of food-eating," they said.
text_mt:
He said to them, ‘What do you desire?’
‘We desire food,’ they said.

sanskrit_iast: so 'bravīd ekaṃ vai vedam annādyam asṛkṣi sāmaiva tad vaḥ prayacchānīti tan naḥ prayacchety abruvan |
meaning: सो ऽब्रवीद् एकं वै वेदम् अन्नाद्यम् असृक्षि सामैव तद् वः प्रयच्छानीति तन् नः प्रयच्छेत्य् अब्रुवन् ।
text: He said: " Truly, one Veda have I created for food-eating, viz, the sāman; that I will furnish to you." The^' said: " Furnish that to us."
text_mt:
He said, ‘Indeed, I have created one Veda as food, the sāman alone.
Let me give that to you.’
‘Give that to us,’ they said.

sanskrit_iast: so 'bravīd imān vai paśūn bhūyiṣṭham upajīvāmaḥ ebhyaḥ prathamam pradāsyāmīti |
meaning: सो ऽब्रवीद् इमान् वै पशून् भूयिष्ठम् उपजीवामः एभ्यः प्रथमम् प्रदास्यामीति ।
text: He said: " We live mostly on these domestic animals. To them I will give first."
text_mt:
He said, ‘We depend for life mostly on these beasts;
to them I will give first.’

sanskrit_iast: tebhyo hiṅkāram prāyacchat tasmāt paśavo hiṅkarikrato vijijñāsamānā iva caranti |
meaning: तेभ्यो हिङ्कारम् प्रायच्छत् तस्मात् पशवो हिङ्करिक्रतो विजिज्ञासमाना इव चरन्ति ।
text: He gave them the hinkdra. Therefore domestic animals go about continually uttering him,, desirous of knowing [each other], as it were.
text_mt:
To them he gave the hiṅkāra.
Therefore beasts go about making the sound “hiṅ”, as if seeking to understand.

sanskrit_iast: prastāvam manuṣyebhyaḥ tasmād u te stuvata ivedam me bhaviṣyaty ado me bhaviṣyatīti |
meaning: प्रस्तावम् मनुष्येभ्यः तस्माद् उ ते स्तुवत इवेदम् मे भविष्यत्य् अदो मे भविष्यतीति ।
text: Tlie prastāva [he gave] to men. And therefore they praise themselves {^Śstu), as it were, [saying]: " This will be mine, that will be mine."
text_mt:
The prastāva [he gave] to human beings.
Therefore they go about as if praising, [saying,] ‘This will be mine; that will be mine.’

sanskrit_iast: ādiṃ vayobhyaḥ tasmāt tāny ādadānāny upāpapātam iva caranti |
meaning: आदिं वयोभ्यः तस्मात् तान्य् आददानान्य् उपापपातम् इव चरन्ति ।
text: The ddi [he gave] to the birds. Therefore they move about taking themselves (y'«?a-|-«), flying up and down, as it were.
text_mt:
The ādi [he gave] to the birds.
Therefore they go about as if swooping down, taking [food].

sanskrit_iast: udgīthaṃ devebhyo 'mṛtam tasmāt te 'mṛtāḥ |
meaning: उद्गीथं देवेभ्यो ऽमृतम् तस्मात् ते ऽमृताः ।
text: The udgītha [he gave] to the gods, being immortal. Therefore they are immortal.
text_mt:
The udgītha, [which is] immortal, [he gave] to the gods.
Therefore they are immortal.

sanskrit_iast: pratihāram āraṇyebhyaḥ paśubhyaḥ tasmāt te pratihṛtās tantasyamānā iva caranti | tṛtīye 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: प्रतिहारम् आरण्येभ्यः पशुभ्यः तस्मात् ते प्रतिहृतास् तन्तस्यमाना इव चरन्ति । तृतीये ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: The pratihāra [he gave] to the beasts of the forest. Therefore they, being kept back, move shaking (?) as it were.
text_mt:
The pratihāra [he gave] to wild beasts.
Therefore they go about struck back, as if constantly terrified.
First khaṇḍa in the third anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: upadravaṃ gandharvāpsarobhyaḥ tasmāt ta upadravaṃ gṛhṇanta iva caranti |
meaning: उपद्रवं गन्धर्वाप्सरोभ्यः तस्मात् त उपद्रवं गृह्णन्त इव चरन्ति ।
text: The upadrava [he gave] to the Gandharvas and Apsarases. Therefore they move taking hold as it were of the upadrava (?).
text_mt:
The upadrava [he gave] to the gandharvas and apsarases.
Therefore they go about as if seizing upon haste.

sanskrit_iast: nidhanam pitṛbhyaḥ tasmād u te nidhanasaṃsthāḥ |
meaning: निधनम् पितृभ्यः तस्माद् उ ते निधनसंस्थाः ।
text: The nidhana [he gave] to the Fathers. And therefore they are resting on the nidhana.
text_mt: The nidhana [he gave] to the ancestors; therefore they have their conclusion in the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: tad yad ebhyas tat sāma prāyacchad etam evaibhyas tad ādityam prāyacchat |
meaning: तद् यद् एभ्यस् तत् साम प्रायच्छद् एतम् एवैभ्यस् तद् आदित्यम् प्रायच्छत् ।
text: In that he gave them this sāman, thereby he gave them this sun.
text_mt: Now when he gave them that sāman, he gave them that very sun.

sanskrit_iast: sa yad anuditas sa hiṅkāro 'rdhoditaḥ prastāva āsaṃgavam ādir mādhyandina udgītho 'parāhṇaḥ pratihāro yad upāstamayaṃ lohitāyati sa upadravo 'stamita eva nidhanam |
meaning: स यद् अनुदितस् स हिङ्कारो ऽर्धोदितः प्रस्ताव आसंगवम् आदिर् माध्यन्दिन उद्गीथो ऽपराह्णः प्रतिहारो यद् उपास्तमयं लोहितायति स उपद्रवो ऽस्तमित एव निधनम् ।
text: When it is not yet risen it is the hinkdra; when half risen it is the prastāva; at the time when the cows are driven together it is the ddi; noon is the udgītha; the afternoon is XkiQ pratihāra; when it turns red toward sunset it is the upadrava; having gone to setting it is the nidhana.
text_mt: When it has not yet risen, that is the hiṅkāra; half-risen, it is the prastāva; at gathering time, it is the ādi; midday is the udgītha; afternoon is the pratihāra; when it turns red towards setting, that is the upadrava; when it has set, it is the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa sarvair lokais samaḥ tad yad eṣa sarvair lokais samas tasmād eṣa eva sāma sa ha vai sāmavit sa sāma veda ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: स एष सर्वैर् लोकैस् समः तद् यद् एष सर्वैर् लोकैस् समस् तस्माद् एष एव साम स ह वै सामवित् स साम वेद य एवं वेद ।
text: This (sun) is the same (sam,a) with all the worlds, therefore it is the sāman. Truly he is sāman-Śnovring, he knows the sāman, who knows thus.
text_mt:
That very [sun] is equal to all worlds.
Because it is equal to all worlds, therefore it is indeed the sāman.
He is indeed a knower of the sāman, he knows the sāman, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvan dūre vā idam asmat tatredaṃ kuru yatropajīvāmeti |
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन् दूरे वा इदम् अस्मत् तत्रेदं कुरु यत्रोपजीवामेति ।
text: They said: " Verily, this is far away from us; make it there where we may live on [it]."
text_mt:
They said, ‘This is indeed far away from us.
Place this where we may live upon it.’

sanskrit_iast: tad ṛtūn abhyatyanayat sa vasantam eva hiṅkāram akarod grīṣmam prastāvaṃ varṣām udgīthaṃ śaradam pratihāraṃ hemantaṃ nidhanam māsārdhamāsāv eva saptamāv akarot |
meaning: तद् ऋतून् अभ्यत्यनयत् स वसन्तम् एव हिङ्कारम् अकरोद् ग्रीष्मम् प्रस्तावं वर्षाम् उद्गीथं शरदम् प्रतिहारं हेमन्तं निधनम् मासार्धमासाव् एव सप्तमाव् अकरोत् ।
text: Then he transferred it to the seasons. He made the spring the hinkdra, the summer the prastāva, the rainy season the udgītha, the fall the pratihāra, the winter the nidhana. Both months and half-months he made as sixth and seventh,
text_mt:
He led it over to the seasons.
He made spring the hiṅkāra, summer the prastāva, the rains the udgītha, autumn the pratihāra, and winter the nidhana.
The months and half-months he made the seventh [part].

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvan nedīyo nvāvaitarhi tatraiva kuru yatropajīvāmeti |
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन् नेदीयो न्वावैतर्हि तत्रैव कुरु यत्रोपजीवामेति ।
text: They said: " Verily, it is nearer now; [but] make it there where we may live on [it]."
text_mt:
They said, ‘Now it is nearer, indeed.
Place it right where we may live upon it.’

sanskrit_iast: tat parjanyam abhyatyanayat sa purovātam eva hiṅkāram akarot | tṛtīye 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तत् पर्जन्यम् अभ्यत्यनयत् स पुरोवातम् एव हिङ्कारम् अकरोत् । तृतीये ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: Then he transferred it to Parjanya. He made the preceding wind the hinkdra,—
text_mt:
He led it over to Parjanya.
He made the wind from the east the hiṅkāra.
Second khaṇḍa in the third anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: jīmūtān prastāvaṃ stanayitnum udgīthaṃ vidyutam pratihāraṃ vṛṣṭiṃ nidhanam yad vṛṣṭāt prajāś cauṣadhayaś ca jāyante te saptamyāv akarot |
meaning: जीमूतान् प्रस्तावं स्तनयित्नुम् उद्गीथं विद्युतम् प्रतिहारं वृष्टिं निधनम् यद् वृष्टात् प्रजाश् चौषधयश् च जायन्ते ते सप्तम्याव् अकरोत् ।
text: The thunder-clouds the prastāva, the thunder the udgītha, the lightning the pratihāra, the rain the nidhana; what creatures and herbs are born from rain, those he made as sixth and seventh,
text_mt:
[He made] thunderclouds the prastāva, thunder the udgītha, lightning the pratihāra, rain the nidhana.
The creatures and plants that are born from what has rained, those two he made the seventh [part].

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvan nedīyo nvāvaitarhi tatraiva kuru yatropajīvāmeti |
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन् नेदीयो न्वावैतर्हि तत्रैव कुरु यत्रोपजीवामेति ।
text: They said: " Verily, it is nearer now, [but] make it there where we may live on [it]."
text_mt:
They said, ‘Now it is nearer, indeed.
Place it right where we may live upon it.’

sanskrit_iast: tad yajñam abhyatyanayat sa yajūṃṣy eva hiṅkāram akarod ṛcaḥ prastāvaṃ sāmāny udgīthaṃ stomam pratihāraṃ chando nidhanam svāhākāravaṣaṭkārāv eva saptamāv akarot |
meaning: तद् यज्ञम् अभ्यत्यनयत् स यजूंष्य् एव हिङ्कारम् अकरोद् ऋचः प्रस्तावं सामान्य् उद्गीथं स्तोमम् प्रतिहारं छन्दो निधनम् स्वाहाकारवषट्काराव् एव सप्तमाव् अकरोत् ।
text: Then he transferred it to the sacrifice. He made the yajuses the hinkara, the ṛc's the chandas the nidhana; the exclamations svdhd and vasat he made as sixth and seventh.
text_mt:
He led it over to the sacrifice.
He made the yajus formulas the hiṅkāra, the ṛk verses the prastāva, the sāmans the udgītha, the stoma the pratihāra, and metre the nidhana.
The exclamation svāhā and the exclamation vaṣaṭ he made the seventh [part].

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvan nedīyo nvāvaitarhi tatraiva kuru yatropajīvāmeti |
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन् नेदीयो न्वावैतर्हि तत्रैव कुरु यत्रोपजीवामेति ।
text: They said: "Verily, it is nearer now, [but] ]nake it there where we may live on [it]."
text_mt:
They said, ‘Now it is nearer, indeed.
Place it right where we may live upon it.’

sanskrit_iast: tat puruṣam abhyatyanayat sa mana eva hiṅkāram akarod vācam prastāvam prāṇam udgīthaṃ cakṣuḥ pratihāraṃ śrotraṃ nidhanam retaś caiva prajāṃ ca saptamāv akarot |
meaning: तत् पुरुषम् अभ्यत्यनयत् स मन एव हिङ्कारम् अकरोद् वाचम् प्रस्तावम् प्राणम् उद्गीथं चक्षुः प्रतिहारं श्रोत्रं निधनम् रेतश् चैव प्रजां च सप्तमाव् अकरोत् ।
text: He transferred it to man. He made the mind the hinkdra, speech the prastāva, breath the ndgitha, sight the pratlhdra, hearing the nidhana; seed and offspring he made as sixth and seventh.
text_mt:
He led it over to man.
He made the mind the hiṅkāra, speech the prastāva, breath the udgītha, the eye the pratihāra, and the ear the nidhana.
Semen and offspring he made the seventh [part].

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvann atra vā enat tad akar yatropajīviṣyāma iti |
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन्न् अत्र वा एनत् तद् अकर् यत्रोपजीविष्याम इति ।
text: They said: " Now thou hast made it here, where we shall live on [it]".
text_mt: They said, ‘You have indeed placed it right here where we shall live upon it.’

sanskrit_iast: sa vidyād aham eva sāmāsmi mayy etā devatā iti | tṛtīye 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स विद्याद् अहम् एव सामास्मि मय्य् एता देवता इति । तृतीये ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः ।
text: He should know: " I am the sdma?i, in me are these divinities."
text_mt:
One should know: ‘I myself am the sāman; these deities are in me.’
Third khaṇḍa in the third anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: na ha dūredevatas syāt yāvad dha vā ātmanā devān upāste tāvad asmai devā bhavanti |
meaning: न ह दूरेदेवतस् स्यात् यावद् ध वा आत्मना देवान् उपास्ते तावद् अस्मै देवा भवन्ति ।
text: He should not be one having the divinities far away. Truly to what extent he worships the gods with the self, to that extent the gods exist for him.
text_mt:
One should not have deities far away.
For to whatever extent one meditates on the gods within oneself, to that extent the gods become [available] to him.

sanskrit_iast: atha ya etad evaṃ vedāham eva sāmāsmi mayy etās sarvā devatā ity evaṃ hāsminn etās sarvā devatā bhavanti |
meaning: अथ य एतद् एवं वेदाहम् एव सामास्मि मय्य् एतास् सर्वा देवता इत्य् एवं हास्मिन्न् एतास् सर्वा देवता भवन्ति ।
text: And who knows this thus: " I am the sāman, in me are all these divinities," truly thus in him all these divinities exist,
text_mt: Now he who knows this thus: ‘I myself am the sāman; all these deities are in me,’ in this manner all these deities come to be in him.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad devaśrut sāma sarvā ha vai devatāś śṛṇvanty evaṃvidam puṇyāya sādhave tā enam puṇyam eva sādhu kārayanti |
meaning: तद् एतद् देवश्रुत् साम सर्वा ह वै देवताश् शृण्वन्त्य् एवंविदम् पुण्याय साधवे ता एनम् पुण्यम् एव साधु कारयन्ति ।
text: That is the deva^rut sāman; for all the divinities give ear to one knowing thus for what is pure, for what is good. They make him do what is pure, what is good.

sanskrit_iast: sa ha smāha sucittaś śailano yo yajñakāmo mām eva sa vṛṇītām tata evainaṃ yajña upanaṃsyati evaṃvidaṃ hy udgāyantaṃ sarvā devatā anusaṃtṛpyanti tā asmai tṛptās tathā kariṣyanti yathainaṃ yajña upanaṃsyatīti | tṛtīye 'nuvāke caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ tṛtīyo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: स ह स्माह सुचित्तश् शैलनो यो यज्ञकामो माम् एव स वृणीताम् तत एवैनं यज्ञ उपनंस्यति एवंविदं ह्य् उद्गायन्तं सर्वा देवता अनुसंतृप्यन्ति ता अस्मै तृप्तास् तथा करिष्यन्ति यथैनं यज्ञ उपनंस्यतीति । तृतीये ऽनुवाके चतुर्थः खण्डः तृतीयो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: Now Sucitta Śsilana used to say: " Whoso wisheth to sacrifice, let him choose me; then the sacrifice will become his. For with one who knowing tlius singeth the ndgitha all the divinities are pleased together. They being pleased will so act for him that the sacrifice shall become his."

sanskrit_iast: devā vai svargaṃ lokam aipsan taṃ na śayānā nāsīnā na tiṣṭhanto na dhāvanto naiva kena cana karmaṇāpnuvan |
meaning: देवा वै स्वर्गं लोकम् ऐप्सन् तं न शयाना नासीना न तिष्ठन्तो न धावन्तो नैव केन चन कर्मणाप्नुवन् ।
text: The gods desired to obtain the heavenly world. Neither lying nor sitting nor standing nor running nor by any [other] action whatsoever did they obtain it.
text_mt:
The gods indeed desired to obtain the heavenly world.
They did not obtain it while lying down, nor while sitting, nor while standing, nor while running, nor indeed by any action whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast: te devāḥ prajāpatim upādhāvan svargaṃ vai lokam aipsiṣma taṃ na śayānā nāsīnā na tiṣṭhanto na dhāvanto naiva kena cana karmaṇāpāma tathā no 'nuśādhi yathā svargaṃ lokam āpnuyāmeti |
meaning: ते देवाः प्रजापतिम् उपाधावन् स्वर्गं वै लोकम् ऐप्सिष्म तं न शयाना नासीना न तिष्ठन्तो न धावन्तो नैव केन चन कर्मणापाम तथा नो ऽनुशाधि यथा स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुयामेति ।
text: These gods ran unto Prajapati [saying]: " We have desired to obtain the heavenly world. Neither lying nor sitting nor standing nor running nor by any [other] action whatsoever have we obtained it. Instruct us so that we may obtain the heavenly world."
text_mt:
Those gods ran up to Prajāpati: ‘We have desired to obtain the heavenly world.
We have not obtained it while lying down, nor while sitting, nor while standing, nor while running, nor indeed by any action whatsoever.
Instruct us in such a way that we may obtain the heavenly world.’

sanskrit_iast: tān abravīt sāmnānṛcena svargaṃ lokam prayāteti te sāmnānṛcena svargaṃ lokam prāyan |
meaning: तान् अब्रवीत् साम्नानृचेन स्वर्गं लोकम् प्रयातेति ते साम्नानृचेन स्वर्गं लोकम् प्रायन् ।
text: He said to them: " Approach the heavenly world by means of a rcless sāman." They approached the heavenly world by means of a re-less sāman.
text_mt:
He said to them, ‘Go forth to the heavenly world by means of the sāman without the ṛk.’
They went forth to the heavenly world by means of the sāman without the ṛk.

sanskrit_iast: pra vā ime sāmnāgur iti tasmāt prasāma tasmād u prasāmy annam atti |
meaning: प्र वा इमे साम्नागुर् इति तस्मात् प्रसाम तस्माद् उ प्रसाम्य् अन्नम् अत्ति ।
text: "Truly, these have gone forth (jpra) by means of the sdmanP Hence [the word] frasdma, and hence one eats food imperfectly (?prasa)vi«).
text_mt:
[Thinking,] ‘These [gods] have indeed gone forth with the sāman,’
therefore it is [called] prasāma; and therefore one eats food [reaching] into the sāman.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai svargaṃ lokam āyan ta etāny ṛkpadāni śarīrāṇi dhūnvanta āyan te svargaṃ lokam ajayan |
meaning: देवा वै स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् त एतान्य् ऋक्पदानि शरीराणि धून्वन्त आयन् ते स्वर्गं लोकम् अजयन् ।
text: Verily, the gods went to the heavenly world. They kept shaking off their bodies, the rcparts. They conquered the heavenly world.
text_mt:
The gods indeed went to the heavenly world.
They went shaking off these bodies, the quarters of the ṛk verses.
They conquered the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: tāny ā divaḥ prakīrṇāny aśeran athemāni prajāpatir ṛkpadāni śarīrāṇi saṃcityābhyarcat yad abhyarcat tā evarco 'bhavan | caturthe 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तान्य् आ दिवः प्रकीर्णान्य् अशेरन् अथेमानि प्रजापतिर् ऋक्पदानि शरीराणि संचित्याभ्यर्चत् यद् अभ्यर्चत् ता एवर्चो ऽभवन् । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: These [bodies] lay strewn up to the sky. Then Prajapati, collecting these bodies, the fc-parts, honored (y'fc) them. Because he honored them, they became rc^s.
text_mt:
Scattered as far as heaven, they lay.
Then Prajāpati, having collected these bodies, the quarters of the ṛk verses, praised over them.
Because he praised over them, they became ṛk verses.
First khaṇḍa in the fourth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: saivarg abhavad iyam eva śrīḥ ato devā abhavan |
meaning: सैवर्ग् अभवद् इयम् एव श्रीः अतो देवा अभवन् ।
text: That one became the re, this one [became] fortune. Thence the gods prevailed,
text_mt:
That became the ṛk, this very prosperity.
From that the gods arose.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣām imām asurāś śriyam avindanta tad evāsuram abhavat |
meaning: अथैषाम् इमाम् असुराश् श्रियम् अविन्दन्त तद् एवासुरम् अभवत् ।
text: Now the Asuras acquired for themselves this fortune of theirs. Thereupon the cause of the Asuras prevailed,
text_mt:
Then the asuras found this prosperity of theirs.
That indeed became asuric.

sanskrit_iast: te devā abruvan yā vai naś śrīr abhūd avidanta tām asurāḥ kathaṃ nv eṣām imāṃ śriyam punar eva jāyemeti |
meaning: ते देवा अब्रुवन् या वै नश् श्रीर् अभूद् अविदन्त ताम् असुराः कथं न्व् एषाम् इमां श्रियम् पुनर् एव जायेमेति ।
text: These gods said: " Truly, what hath been our fortune, that the Asuras have acquired for themselves. How then may we win back this fortune of theirs?"
text_mt:
Those gods said: ‘The prosperity that was ours, the asuras have found.
How then may we win back this prosperity of theirs?’

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvann ṛcy eva sāma gāyāmeti te punaḥ pratyādrutyarci sāmāgāyan tenāsmāl lokād asurān anudanta |
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन्न् ऋच्य् एव साम गायामेति ते पुनः प्रत्याद्रुत्यर्चि सामागायन् तेनास्माल् लोकाद् असुरान् अनुदन्त ।
text: They said: "Let us sing the sāman in the re." They in turn, running up toward [the Asuras], sang the sāman in the re. Thereby they pushed the Asuras from this world.

sanskrit_iast: tad vai mādhyandine ca savane tṛtīyasavane ca narco 'parādho 'sti sa yat te ṛci gāyati tenāsmāl lokād dviṣantam bhrātṛvyaṃ nudate atha yad amṛte devatāsu prātassavanaṃ gāyati tena svargaṃ lokam eti |
meaning: तद् वै माध्यन्दिने च सवने तृतीयसवने च नर्चो ऽपराधो ऽस्ति स यत् ते ऋचि गायति तेनास्माल् लोकाद् द्विषन्तम् भ्रातृव्यं नुदते अथ यद् अमृते देवतासु प्रातस्सवनं गायति तेन स्वर्गं लोकम् एति ।
text: Thus indeed at the noonlibation and at the evening-libation there is no offense from the re. He who sings these two [libationsj in the re thereby pushes his hostile rival away from this world. Moreover, in that he sings the [chant of the] morning-libation in immortality, in the divinities, thereby he goes to the heavenly world. 6. v erily by means of the sāman Prajapati conquered this conquest, viz. what conquest there is of him. He ascended to the heavenly world.
text_mt: Now indeed, at the midday pressing and at the third pressing there is no omission of the ṛc. When he chants on the ṛc, by that he repels his hateful rival from this world; and when at the morning pressing he chants on the immortal among deities, by that he goes to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vai sāmnemāṃ jitim ajayad yāsyeyaṃ jitis tām sa svargaṃ lokam ārohat |
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वै साम्नेमां जितिम् अजयद् यास्येयं जितिस् ताम् स स्वर्गं लोकम् आरोहत् ।
text_mt: Prajāpati won by means of the sāman this conquest which is his conquest here; he ascended to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: te devāḥ prajāpatim upetyābruvann asmabhyam apīdaṃ sāma prayaccheti tatheti tad ebhyas sāma prāyacchat |
meaning: ते देवाः प्रजापतिम् उपेत्याब्रुवन्न् अस्मभ्यम् अपीदं साम प्रयच्छेति तथेति तद् एभ्यस् साम प्रायच्छत् ।
text: These gods coming unto Prajapati said: " Furnish this sāman to us also." [Saying] "Yes," he furnished this sāman to them.
text_mt: Those gods approached Prajāpati and said: 'Give this sāman to us as well.' 'So be it,' [he said]. He gave that sāman to them.

sanskrit_iast: tad enān idaṃ sāma svargaṃ lokaṃ nākāmayata voḍhum |
meaning: तद् एनान् इदं साम स्वर्गं लोकं नाकामयत वोढुम् ।
text: This same sāman did not wish to carry them to the heavenly world.
text_mt: This sāman was not willing to carry them to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: te devāḥ prajāpatim upetyābruvan yad vai nas sāma prādā idaṃ vai nas tat svargaṃ lokaṃ na kāmayate voḍhum iti |
meaning: ते देवाः प्रजापतिम् उपेत्याब्रुवन् यद् वै नस् साम प्रादा इदं वै नस् तत् स्वर्गं लोकं न कामयते वोढुम् इति ।
text: These gods coming unto Prajapati said: " Verily, that sāman which thou hast given to us, that does not wish to carry us to the heavenly world."
text_mt: Those gods approached Prajāpati and said: 'The sāman which you gave us, this indeed is not willing to carry us to the heavenly world.'

sanskrit_iast: tad vai pāpmanā saṃsṛjateti ko 'sya pāpmeti ṛg iti tad ṛcā samasṛjan |
meaning: तद् वै पाप्मना संसृजतेति को ऽस्य पाप्मेति ऋग् इति तद् ऋचा समसृजन् ।
text: "Mix it with evil." "What is its evil?" "There." They mixed it with there,
text_mt: 'Unite it with evil,' [he said]. 'What is its evil?' [they asked]. 'The ṛc,' [he replied]. They united it with the ṛc.

sanskrit_iast: tad idam prajāpater garhayamāṇam atiṣṭhad idaṃ vai mā tat pāpmanā samasrākṣur iti so 'bravīd yas tvaitena vyāvartayād vy eva sa pāpmanā vartātā iti |
meaning: तद् इदम् प्रजापतेर् गर्हयमाणम् अतिष्ठद् इदं वै मा तत् पाप्मना समस्राक्षुर् इति सो ऽब्रवीद् यस् त्वैतेन व्यावर्तयाद् व्य् एव स पाप्मना वर्ताता इति ।
text: That same [sāman] stood upbraiding Prajapati: " Verily, they thus have mixed me with evil." He (P.) said: " Whoso shall separate thee from this [evil], he shall separate himself from evil."
text_mt: It stood complaining to Prajāpati: 'They have indeed united me with evil.' He said: 'Whoever separates you from this, he shall indeed be separated from evil.'

sanskrit_iast: sa ya etad ṛcā prātassavane vyāvartayati vy evaṃ sa pāpmanā vartate | caturthe 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स य एतद् ऋचा प्रातस्सवने व्यावर्तयति व्य् एवं स पाप्मना वर्तते । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: He who at the morning-libation separates it from the re, he thus separates himself from evil.
text_mt: He who separates it [from evil] with the ṛc at the morning pressing is indeed separated from evil. / Second khaṇḍa in the fourth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad ovā ovā iti gīyate kvātrarg bhavati kva sāmeti |
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् ओवा ओवा इति गीयते क्वात्रर्ग् भवति क्व सामेति ।
text: This they say: "If there be'sung ovd ovd, what becomes of the re, what of the sāman."
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'When it is chanted as ovā ovā, where here is the ṛc, where the sāman?'

sanskrit_iast: prastuvann evāṣṭābhir akṣaraiḥ prastauti aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī akṣaram-akṣaraṃ tryakṣaram tac caturviṃśatis sampadyante caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī |
meaning: प्रस्तुवन्न् एवाष्टाभिर् अक्षरैः प्रस्तौति अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री अक्षरम्-अक्षरं त्र्यक्षरम् तच् चतुर्विंशतिस् सम्पद्यन्ते चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री ।
text: When he sings the prastāva, he sings the prastāva with eight syllables. Of eight syllables is the gdyatri; each syllable is a triple syllable. Thus they amount to twenty-four. The gdyatri has twenty-four syllables.
text_mt: In chanting the prastāva itself, he chants the prastāva with eight syllables. The gāyatrī has eight syllables. Syllable by syllable, each is threefold; thus they amount to twenty-four. The gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables.

sanskrit_iast: tām etām prastāvenarcam āptvā yā śrīr yāpacitir yas svargo loko yad yaśo yad annādyaṃ tāny āgāyamāna āste | caturthe 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: ताम् एताम् प्रस्तावेनर्चम् आप्त्वा या श्रीर् यापचितिर् यस् स्वर्गो लोको यद् यशो यद् अन्नाद्यं तान्य् आगायमान आस्ते । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः ।
text: Having obtained this same re by means of the prastāva, he sits singing into his possession what fortune [there is], what reverence, what heavenly world, what glory, what food-eating.
text_mt: Having obtained this ṛc by means of the prastāva, he sits chanting to obtain whatever glory, whatever reverence, whatever heavenly world, whatever fame, whatever food [there is]. / Third khaṇḍa in the fourth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir devān asṛjata tān mṛtyuḥ pāpmānvasṛjyata |
meaning: प्रजापतिर् देवान् असृजत तान् मृत्युः पाप्मान्वसृज्यत ।
text: Prajapati created the gods. After them death, evil was created.
text_mt: Prajāpati created the gods; after them death, evil, was created.

sanskrit_iast: te devā prajāpatim upetyābruvan kasmād u no 'sṛṣṭhā mṛtyuṃ cen naḥ pāpmānam anvavasrakṣyann āsitheti |
meaning: ते देवा प्रजापतिम् उपेत्याब्रुवन् कस्माद् उ नो ऽसृष्ठा मृत्युं चेन् नः पाप्मानम् अन्ववस्रक्ष्यन्न् आसिथेति ।
text: These gods coming unto Prajiipati said: "Why, pray, hast thou created us, if thou wast going to create death, evil, after us?"
text_mt: Those gods approached Prajāpati and said: 'Why did you create us, if you were going to create death, evil, after us?'

sanskrit_iast: tān abravīc chandāṃsi sambharata tāni yathāyatanam praviśata tato mṛtyunā pāpmanā vyāvartsyatheti |
meaning: तान् अब्रवीच् छन्दांसि सम्भरत तानि यथायतनम् प्रविशत ततो मृत्युना पाप्मना व्यावर्त्स्यथेति ।
text: He said to them: "Bring together the metres; enter these each one at his proper place, then you will be separated from death, evil.
text_mt: He said to them: 'Gather the metres; enter them according to their proper abode; then you will be separated from death, evil.'

sanskrit_iast: vasavo gāyatrīṃ samabharan tāṃ te prāviśan tān sācchādayat |
meaning: वसवो गायत्रीं समभरन् तां ते प्राविशन् तान् साच्छादयत् ।
text: The Vasus brought the gdyatri together. They entered it. It concealed them.
text_mt: The Vasus gathered the gāyatrī; they entered it; it covered them.

sanskrit_iast: rudrās triṣṭubhaṃ samabharan tāṃ te prāviśan tān sācchādayat |
meaning: रुद्रास् त्रिष्टुभं समभरन् तां ते प्राविशन् तान् साच्छादयत् ।
text: The Rudras brought the tristubh together. They entered it. It concealed thera.
text_mt: The Rudras gathered the triṣṭubh; they entered it; it covered them.

sanskrit_iast: ādityā jagatīṃ samabharan tāṃ te prāviśan tān sācchādayat |
meaning: आदित्या जगतीं समभरन् तां ते प्राविशन् तान् साच्छादयत् ।
text: The Adityas brought the Jagr«<» together. They entered it. It concealed them.
text_mt: The Ādityas gathered the jagatī; they entered it; it covered them.

sanskrit_iast: viśve devā anuṣṭubhaṃ samabharan tāṃ te prāviśan tān sācchādayat |
meaning: विश्वे देवा अनुष्टुभं समभरन् तां ते प्राविशन् तान् साच्छादयत् ।
text: All the gods brought the anustuhh together. They entered it. It concealed them.
text_mt: The All-gods gathered the anuṣṭubh; they entered it; it covered them.

sanskrit_iast: tān asyām ṛcy asvarāyām mṛtyur nirajānād yathā maṇau maṇisūtram paripaśyed evam |
meaning: तान् अस्याम् ऋच्य् अस्वरायाम् मृत्युर् निरजानाद् यथा मणौ मणिसूत्रम् परिपश्येद् एवम् ।
text: Death became aware of them in this tone-(tune-)less 7'g, just as one might discover the jewel-string within a jewel.
text_mt: Death discerned them in this ṛc without musical tone, just as one might see through a string inside a jewel.

sanskrit_iast: te svaram prāviśan tān svare sato na nirajānāt svarasya tu ghoṣenānvait |
meaning: ते स्वरम् प्राविशन् तान् स्वरे सतो न निरजानात् स्वरस्य तु घोषेनान्वैत् ।
text: They entered tone. Them, being in tone, he did not become aware of. But he went after them by the noise of tone.
text_mt: They entered the musical tone. Being in the musical tone, he did not discern them; but he pursued them by the sound of the musical tone.

sanskrit_iast: ta om ity etad evākṣaraṃ samārohan etad evākṣaraṃ trayī vidyā yad ado 'mṛtaṃ tapati tat prapadya tato mṛtyunā pāpmanā vyāvartanta |
meaning: त ओम् इत्य् एतद् एवाक्षरं समारोहन् एतद् एवाक्षरं त्रयी विद्या यद् अदो ऽमृतं तपति तत् प्रपद्य ततो मृत्युना पाप्मना व्यावर्तन्त ।
text: They climbed together upon that syllable om. That same syllable is the threefold knowledge (Veda). Resorting unto that immortality which burns yonder, they then separated themselves from death, evil.
text_mt: They mounted into this very syllable, om. This very syllable is the threefold knowledge. Having reached that immortal one that burns yonder, they were then separated from death, evil.

sanskrit_iast: evam evaivaṃ vidvān om ity etad evākṣaraṃ samāruhya yad ado 'mṛtaṃ tapati tat prapadya tato mṛtyunā pāpmanā vyāvartate 'tho yasyaivaṃ vidvān udgāyati | caturthe 'nuvāke caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ caturtho 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: एवम् एवैवं विद्वान् ओम् इत्य् एतद् एवाक्षरं समारुह्य यद् अदो ऽमृतं तपति तत् प्रपद्य ततो मृत्युना पाप्मना व्यावर्तते ऽथो यस्यैवं विद्वान् उद्गायति । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके चतुर्थः खण्डः चतुर्थो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: Even so one knowing thus, climbing upon that syllable om, resorting unto that immortality which burns yonder, then separates himself from deatli, evil, and likewise he for whom one knowing thus sings the itdgitha.
text_mt: In this very way, one who knows thus, having mounted into this very syllable, om, having reached that immortal one that burns yonder, is then separated from death, evil; and also [the patron] for whom one who knows thus chants the udgītha. / Fourth khaṇḍa in the fourth anuvāka. The fourth anuvāka is complete.

sanskrit_iast: athaitad ekaviṃśaṃ sāma |
meaning: अथैतद् एकविंशं साम ।
text: Now this is the twenty-onefold sāman. x Of it the threefold knowledge is the hinkdra; Agni, Vayu, yonder sun, those are the p>rastdva; these worlds the ddi—for this all is placed (Śjdhd-\-d in these worlds; faith, sacrifice, sacrificial gifts, those are the udgītha; the quarters, the intermediate quarters, space, those are the pratihāra; the waters, creatures, herbs, those are the upadrava; the moon, the asterisms, the Fathers, those are the nidhana.
text_mt: Now this twenty-one-fold sāman.

sanskrit_iast: tasya trayy eva vidyā hiṅkāraḥ agnir vāyur asāv āditya eṣa prastāvaḥ ima eva lokā ādiḥ teṣu hīdaṃ lokeṣu sarvam āhitam śraddhā yajño dakṣiṇā eṣa udgīthaḥ diśo 'vāntaradiśa ākāśa eṣa pratihāraḥ āpaḥ prajā oṣadhaya eṣa upadravaḥ candramā nakṣatrāṇi pitara etan nidhanam |
meaning: तस्य त्रय्य् एव विद्या हिङ्कारः अग्निर् वायुर् असाव् आदित्य एष प्रस्तावः इम एव लोका आदिः तेषु हीदं लोकेषु सर्वम् आहितम् श्रद्धा यज्ञो दक्षिणा एष उद्गीथः दिशो ऽवान्तरदिश आकाश एष प्रतिहारः आपः प्रजा ओषधय एष उपद्रवः चन्द्रमा नक्षत्राणि पितर एतन् निधनम् ।
text_mt: Its hiṅkāra is the threefold knowledge itself; Agni, Vāyu, that Āditya yonder—this is the prastāva; these worlds here are the ādi, for upon these worlds everything here is placed; faith, sacrifice, priestly fee—this is the udgītha; the quarters, the intermediate quarters, space—this is the pratihāra; the waters, creatures, plants—this is the upadrava; the Moon, the constellations, the ancestors—this is the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad ekaviṃśaṃ sāma sa ya evam etad ekaviṃśaṃ sāma vedaitena hāsya sarveṇodgītam bhavaty etasmād v eva sarvasmād āvṛścyate ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati | pañcamo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: तद् एतद् एकविंशं साम स य एवम् एतद् एकविंशं साम वेदैतेन हास्य सर्वेणोद्गीतम् भवत्य् एतस्माद् व् एव सर्वस्माद् आवृश्च्यते य एवं विद्वांसम् उपवदति । पञ्चमो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: This is the twenty-onefold sāman. He who thus knows this twenty-onefold sāman, of him the udgītha is sung by this all; and from this same universe he is cut off who speaks ill of one knowing thus.
text_mt: That is this twenty-one-fold sāman. He who knows this twenty-one-fold sāman thus—by this whole [sāman] the udgītha is chanted for him; and from this whole is he cut off who speaks ill of one who knows thus. / The fifth anuvāka is complete.

sanskrit_iast: idam evedam agre 'ntarikṣam āsīt tad v evāpy etarhi |
meaning: इदम् एवेदम् अग्रे ऽन्तरिक्षम् आसीत् तद् व् एवाप्य् एतर्हि ।
text: This [all] in the beginning was this atmosphere here; and that is so even now.
text_mt: This intermediate space was in the beginning just this; and so it is even now.

sanskrit_iast: tad yad etad antarikṣaṃ ya evāyam pavata etad evāntarikṣam eṣa ha vā antarikṣanāma |
meaning: तद् यद् एतद् अन्तरिक्षं य एवायम् पवत एतद् एवान्तरिक्षम् एष ह वा अन्तरिक्षनाम ।
text: As for this atmosphere—he who cleanses here is this atmosphere. For he is atmosphere by name.
text_mt: Now that which is this intermediate space: that which purifies itself here (the wind), this very one is the intermediate space; its name indeed is intermediate space (antarikṣa).

sanskrit_iast: eṣa u evaiṣa vitataḥ tad yathā kāṣṭhena palāśe viṣkabdhe syātām akṣeṇa vā cakrāv evam etenemau lokau viṣkabdhau |
meaning: एष उ एवैष विततः तद् यथा काष्ठेन पलाशे विष्कब्धे स्याताम् अक्षेण वा चक्राव् एवम् एतेनेमौ लोकौ विष्कब्धौ ।
text: That same is stretched apart. As two leaves might be propped apart by means of a peg, or two wheels by means of an axle, so these [two] worlds are propped apart by means of this [atmosphere].
text_mt: And this very one is spread out. Just as two leaves might be propped apart by a stick, or two wheels by an axle, so these two worlds are propped apart by this.
