sanskrit_iast: tasminn idaṃ sarvam antaḥ tad yad asminn idaṃ sarvam antas tasmād antaryakṣam antaryakṣaṃ ha vai nāmaitat tad antarikṣam iti parokṣam ācakṣate |
meaning: तस्मिन्न् इदं सर्वम् अन्तः तद् यद् अस्मिन्न् इदं सर्वम् अन्तस् तस्माद् अन्तर्यक्षम् अन्तर्यक्षं ह वै नामैतत् तद् अन्तरिक्षम् इति परोक्षम् आचक्षते ।
text: This all is within it. Because this all is within {antas) it, therefore [it is called] antaryaksa. Antaryaksa verily is its name. It is called antariksa in an occult way.
text_mt: Within this, all this is contained. Because all this is within (antaḥ) it, therefore it is 'within-worthy' (antaryakṣa). Antaryakṣa indeed is its name; cryptically they call it antarikṣa.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā mūtāḥ prabaddhāḥ pralamberann evaṃ haitasmin sarve lokāḥ prabaddhāḥ pralambante |
meaning: तद् यथा मूताः प्रबद्धाः प्रलम्बेरन्न् एवं हैतस्मिन् सर्वे लोकाः प्रबद्धाः प्रलम्बन्ते ।
text: As baskets bound [to one another] would hang down, so in it all the worlds bound [to one another] hang down.
text_mt: Just as woven baskets, tied fast, might hang down, so indeed all worlds, tied fast, hang down from this.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaitasya sāmnas tisra āgās trīṇy āgītāni ṣaḍ vibhūtayaś catasraḥ pratiṣṭhā daśa pragās sapta saṃsthā dvau stobhāv ekaṃ rūpam |
meaning: तस्यैतस्य साम्नस् तिस्र आगास् त्रीण्य् आगीतानि षड् विभूतयश् चतस्रः प्रतिष्ठा दश प्रगास् सप्त संस्था द्वौ स्तोभाव् एकं रूपम् ।
text: Of this same sāman there are three dgds, three dgltas, six stobhas, one form.
text_mt: Of this sāman there are three lead-ins, three chants, six manifestations, four foundations, ten progressions, seven completions, two stobhas, one form.

sanskrit_iast: tad yās tisra āgā ima eva te lokāḥ |
meaning: तद् यास् तिस्र आगा इम एव ते लोकाः ।
text: Now the three dgds, they are these worlds.
text_mt: Now, the three lead-ins: these worlds here are they.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāni āgītāny agnir vāyur asāv āditya etāny āgītāni na ha vai kāṃ cana śriyam aparādhnoti ya evaṃ veda | ṣaṣṭhe 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: अथ यानि आगीतान्य् अग्निर् वायुर् असाव् आदित्य एतान्य् आगीतानि न ह वै कां चन श्रियम् अपराध्नोति य एवं वेद । षष्ठे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: Further, the [three] dgltas, Agni (fire), Vayu (wind), yonder sun are these dgltas. He misses no fortune whatever who knows thus.
text_mt: Then the [three] chants: Agni, Vāyu, that Āditya yonder—these are the chants. He who knows thus does not miss any glory whatsoever. / First khaṇḍa in the sixth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāṣ ṣaḍ vibhūtaya ṛtavas te |
meaning: अथ याष् षड् विभूतय ऋतवस् ते ।
text: Further, the six vibhutis, they are the seasons,
text_mt: Then the six manifestations: the seasons are they.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāś catasraḥ pratiṣṭhā imā eva tāś catasro diśaḥ |
meaning: अथ याश् चतस्रः प्रतिष्ठा इमा एव ताश् चतस्रो दिशः ।
text: Further, the four pratisthds, they are these four quarters,
text_mt: Then the four foundations: these four quarters here are they.

sanskrit_iast: atha ye daśa pragā ima eva te daśa prāṇāḥ |
meaning: अथ ये दश प्रगा इम एव ते दश प्राणाः ।
text: Further, the ten pragds, they are these ten breaths.
text_mt: Then the ten progressions: these ten vital breaths here are they.

sanskrit_iast: atha yās sapta saṃsthā yā evaitās saptāhorātrāḥ prācīr vaṣaṭkurvanti tā eva tāḥ |
meaning: अथ यास् सप्त संस्था या एवैतास् सप्ताहोरात्राः प्राचीर् वषट्कुर्वन्ति ता एव ताः ।
text: Further, the seven samsthds, they are those seven successive (?) days and nights that they utter vasat (?).
text_mt: Then the seven completions: these very seven days and nights that advance making the vaṣaṭ-call, they are they.

sanskrit_iast: atha yau dvau stobhāv ahorātre eva te |
meaning: अथ यौ द्वौ स्तोभाव् अहोरात्रे एव ते ।
text: Further, the two slobhas, they are day and night,
text_mt: Then the two stobhas: day and night are they.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad ekam rūpaṃ karmaiva tat karmaṇā hīdaṃ sarvaṃ vikriyate |
meaning: अथ यद् एकम् रूपं कर्मैव तत् कर्मणा हीदं सर्वं विक्रियते ।
text: Further, the one form, that is action. For by action this all is developed.
text_mt: Then the one form: action indeed is that; for by action all this is transformed.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaitasya sāmno devā ājim āyan sa prajāpatir harasā hiṅkāram udajayad agnis tejasā prastāvaṃ rūpeṇa bṛhaspatir udgīthaṃ svadhayā pitaraḥ pratihāraṃ vīryeṇendro nidhanam |
meaning: तस्यैतस्य साम्नो देवा आजिम् आयन् स प्रजापतिर् हरसा हिङ्कारम् उदजयद् अग्निस् तेजसा प्रस्तावं रूपेण बृहस्पतिर् उद्गीथं स्वधया पितरः प्रतिहारं वीर्येणेन्द्रो निधनम् ।
text: About this same sāman the gods ran a race. Prajapati by a grasp conquered the hinkdra, Agni by splendor the prastāva, by form Brhaspati the ttdg'Uha, by the svadhd the Fathers the pratihāra, by heroism Indra the nidhana.
text_mt: For this sāman the gods ran a race. Prajāpati by fury won the hiṅkāra; Agni by fiery energy, the prastāva; Bṛhaspati by form, the udgītha; the ancestors by the ancestral food offering, the pratihāra; Indra by heroic power, the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: athetare devā antaritā ivāsan ta indram abruvan tava vai vayaṃ smo 'nu na etasmin sāmann ābhajeti |
meaning: अथेतरे देवा अन्तरिता इवासन् त इन्द्रम् अब्रुवन् तव वै वयं स्मो ऽनु न एतस्मिन् सामन्न् आभजेति ।
text: Now the other gods were excluded, as it were. They said to Indra: "Verily, thine we are; let us also have a share in this sāman!'''
text_mt: Then the other gods were, as it were, excluded. They said to Indra: 'We are indeed yours; give us a share in this sāman.'

sanskrit_iast: tebhyas svaram prāyacchat tam prajāpatir abravīt kathettham akaḥ sarvaṃ vā ebhyas sāma prādāḥ etāvad vāva sāma yāvān svaraḥ ṛg vā eṣarte svarād bhavatīti |
meaning: तेभ्यस् स्वरम् प्रायच्छत् तम् प्रजापतिर् अब्रवीत् कथेत्थम् अकः सर्वं वा एभ्यस् साम प्रादाः एतावद् वाव साम यावान् स्वरः ऋग् वा एषर्ते स्वराद् भवतीति ।
text: He gave them the tone. Prajapati said to him: " Why hast thou acted thus? Verily, the whole sāman. thou hast given to them. Truly, as great as the tone is, so great is the sāman. Verily, without tone it becomes re.
text_mt: He gave them musical tone. Prajāpati said to him: 'Why have you done this? You have given them the whole sāman! The sāman is as great as musical tone; without musical tone it is merely ṛc.'

sanskrit_iast: so 'bravīt punar vā aham eṣām etaṃ rasam ādāsya iti tān abravīd upa mā gāyata abhi mā svarateti tatheti |
meaning: सो ऽब्रवीत् पुनर् वा अहम् एषाम् एतं रसम् आदास्य इति तान् अब्रवीद् उप मा गायत अभि मा स्वरतेति तथेति ।
text: He (I.) said: " I will take back again this sap of them." He said to them: "Join in my song, intone with me!" "Yes."
text_mt: He said: 'I will take back this essence of theirs.' He said to them: 'Chant around me; resound toward me.' 'So be it,' [they said].

sanskrit_iast: tam upāgāyan tam abhyasvaram teṣām punā rasam ādatta | ṣaṣṭhe 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तम् उपागायन् तम् अभ्यस्वरम् तेषाम् पुना रसम् आदत्त । षष्ठे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: They joined in the song, they intoned with him. Of them he took the sap back again.
text_mt: They chanted around him; they resounded toward him; he took back their essence. / Second khaṇḍa in the sixth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathā madhudhāne madhunāḷībhir madhv āsiñcād evam eva tat sāman punā rasam āsiñcat |
meaning: स यथा मधुधाने मधुनाऌईभिर् मध्व् आसिञ्चाद् एवम् एव तत् सामन् पुना रसम् आसिञ्चत् ।
text: As one might pour honey into a honey-vessel by means of the honey-ceUs, even so he then poured the sap again into the sāman.
text_mt: Just as one would pour honey into a honeycomb through honey-pipes, in the very same way that sāman poured essence back into [the ṛk].

sanskrit_iast: tasmād u ha nopagāyet indra eṣa yad udgātā sa yathāsāv amīṣāṃ rasam ādatta evam eṣa teṣāṃ rasam ādatte |
meaning: तस्माद् उ ह नोपगायेत् इन्द्र एष यद् उद्गाता स यथासाव् अमीषां रसम् आदत्त एवम् एष तेषां रसम् आदत्ते ।
text: And therefore one should not Join in the song [of the vdgdtar']. This udgdtar is Indra. As he then took the sap of those, even so he now takes the sap of these,
text_mt:
Therefore indeed one should not accompany in singing.
Indra is he who is the udgātṛ.
Just as that one took away the essence of these, so this one takes away the essence of those.

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ ha tu yajamāna upagāyed yajamānasya hi tad bhavaty atho brahmacāry ācāryoktaḥ |
meaning: कामं ह तु यजमान उपगायेद् यजमानस्य हि तद् भवत्य् अथो ब्रह्मचार्य् आचार्योक्तः ।
text: But the sacrificer may join in the song [of the udgdtar'\ at will—for that is the sacrificer's— and also a Vedic student directed by the teacher.
text_mt: At will, however, the sacrificer may accompany in singing, for it belongs to the sacrificer; and also a Vedic student when instructed by his teacher.

sanskrit_iast: tad u vā āhur upaiva gāyet diśo hy upāgāyan diśām evaṃ salokatāṃ jayatīti |
meaning: तद् उ वा आहुर् उपैव गायेत् दिशो ह्य् उपागायन् दिशाम् एवं सलोकतां जयतीति ।
text: Verily, they also say this: " One should join in the song. For the quarters joined in the song. He thus wins the same world with the quarters."
text_mt:
On this point, indeed, they also say: 'One should definitely accompany in singing;
for the directions accompanied in singing; thus one wins the sharing of the same world with the directions.'

sanskrit_iast: te ya eveme mukhyāḥ prāṇā eta evodgātāraś copagātāraś ca ime ha traya udgātāra ima u catvāra upagātāraḥ |
meaning: ते य एवेमे मुख्याः प्राणा एत एवोद्गातारश् चोपगातारश् च इमे ह त्रय उद्गातार इम उ चत्वार उपगातारः ।
text: These breaths in the mouth, they are the udgdtars and upagdtars. For these three are the xidgdtars and these four are the upagdtars.
text_mt:
Those vital breaths that are in the mouth—these very ones are the udgātṛs and the accompanying singers.
These three are the udgātṛs, and these four are the accompanying singers.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād u catura evopagātṝn kurvīta tasmād u hopagātṝn pratyabhimṛśed diśas stha śrotram me mā hiṃsiṣṭeti |
meaning: तस्माद् उ चतुर एवोपगातॄन् कुर्वीत तस्माद् उ होपगातॄन् प्रत्यभिमृशेद् दिशस् स्थ श्रोत्रम् मे मा हिंसिष्टेति ।
text: And therefore one should appoint (bur upagdtars. And therefore he should touch the upagdtars respectively [saying]: " Ye are the quarters, do not injure my hearing."
text_mt:
Therefore, indeed, one should appoint only four accompanying singers.
Therefore, indeed, one should touch the accompanying singers, saying: 'You are the directions; do not injure my hearing.'

sanskrit_iast: sa yas sa rasa āsīd ya evāyam pavata eṣa eva sa rasaḥ |
meaning: स यस् स रस आसीद् य एवायम् पवत एष एव स रसः ।
text: As to what this sap was, he who cleanses here, he is that sap.
text_mt: That essence which existed—this very one that purifies here is that essence.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathā madhvālopam adyād iti ha smāha sucittaś śailana evam etasya rasasyātmānam pūrayeta sa evodgātātmānaṃ ca yajamānaṃ cāmṛtatvaṃ gamayatīti | ṣaṣṭhe 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ṣaṣṭho 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: स यथा मध्वालोपम् अद्याद् इति ह स्माह सुचित्तश् शैलन एवम् एतस्य रसस्यात्मानम् पूरयेत स एवोद्गातात्मानं च यजमानं चामृतत्वं गमयतीति । षष्ठे ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः षष्ठो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: "As one might eat a bite of honey," Sucitta Śailana used to say, " so one should fill himself with this sap. This same udgdtar causeth himself and the sacrificer to attain immortality."
text_mt:
"Just as one would eat a morsel of honey," Sucitta Śailana used to say, "so should one fill oneself with this essence;
he alone, as udgātṛ, leads both himself and the sacrificer to immortality."
Third khaṇḍa in the sixth anuvāka.
The sixth anuvāka is completed.

sanskrit_iast: ayam evedam agra ākāśa āsīt sa u evāpy etarhi |
meaning: अयम् एवेदम् अग्र आकाश आसीत् स उ एवाप्य् एतर्हि ।
text: This [universe] in the beginning was this space here, and that is so even now.
text_mt:
This space alone was here in the beginning.
And it is indeed [so] even now.

sanskrit_iast: sa yas sa ākāśo vāg eva sā tasmād ākāśād vāg vadati |
meaning: स यस् स आकाशो वाग् एव सा तस्माद् आकाशाद् वाग् वदति ।
text: What this space is, that is speech. Therefore speech speaks from space,
text_mt:
That which was space is speech itself.
Therefore speech speaks out of space.

sanskrit_iast: tām etāṃ vācam prajāpatir abhyapīḷayat tasyā abhipīḷitāyai rasaḥ prāṇedat ta eveme lokā abhavan |
meaning: ताम् एतां वाचम् प्रजापतिर् अभ्यपीऌअयत् तस्या अभिपीऌइतायै रसः प्राणेदत् त एवेमे लोका अभवन् ।
text: This same speech Prajapati pressed. Of it being pressed the sap streamed forth. That became these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: sa imāṃl lokān abhyapīḷayat teṣām abhipīḷitānāṃ rasaḥ prāṇedat tā evaitā devatā abhavann agnir vāyur asāv āditya iti |
meaning: स इमांल् लोकान् अभ्यपीऌअयत् तेषाम् अभिपीऌइतानां रसः प्राणेदत् ता एवैता देवता अभवन्न् अग्निर् वायुर् असाव् आदित्य इति ।
text: He pressed these worlds. Of them being pressed the sap streamed forth. That became these divinities: Agni, Vayu, yonder sun.

sanskrit_iast: sa etā devatā abhyapīḷayat tāsām abhipīḷitānāṃ rasaḥ prāṇedat sā trayī vidyābhavat |
meaning: स एता देवता अभ्यपीऌअयत् तासाम् अभिपीऌइतानां रसः प्राणेदत् सा त्रयी विद्याभवत् ।

sanskrit_iast: sa trayīṃ vidyām abhyapīḷayat tasyā abhipīḷitāyai rasaḥ prāṇedat tā evaitā vyāhṛtayo 'bhavan bhūr bhuvas svar iti |
meaning: स त्रयीं विद्याम् अभ्यपीऌअयत् तस्या अभिपीऌइतायै रसः प्राणेदत् ता एवैता व्याहृतयो ऽभवन् भूर् भुवस् स्वर् इति ।
text: He pressed these divinities. Of them being pressed the sap streamed forth. That became the threefold knowledge, e. He pressed the threefold knowledge. Of it being pressed the sap streamed forth. That became these sacred utterances: bhus, bhuvas, svar.

sanskrit_iast: sa etā vyāhṛtīr abhyapīḷayat tāsām abhipīḷitānāṃ rasaḥ prāṇedat tad etad akṣaram abhavad om iti yad etad |
meaning: स एता व्याहृतीर् अभ्यपीऌअयत् तासाम् अभिपीऌइतानां रसः प्राणेदत् तद् एतद् अक्षरम् अभवद् ओम् इति यद् एतद् ।
text: He pressed these sacred utterances. Of them being pressed the sap streamed forth. That became that syllable, viz. om.

sanskrit_iast: sa etad akṣaram abhyapīḷayat tasyābhipīḷitasya rasaḥ prāṇedat | saptame 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स एतद् अक्षरम् अभ्यपीऌअयत् तस्याभिपीऌइतस्य रसः प्राणेदत् । सप्तमे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: He pressed that syllable. Of it being pressed the sap streamed forth.
text_mt:
He squeezed this syllable.
From it, when squeezed, essence flowed forth.
First khaṇḍa in the seventh anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: tad akṣarad eva yad akṣarad eva tasmād akṣaram |
meaning: तद् अक्षरद् एव यद् अक्षरद् एव तस्माद् अक्षरम् ।
text: That flowed. Because it flowed {aksarat), therefore it is aksara (syllable),
text_mt:
It flowed (akṣarat);
because it flowed (akṣarat), therefore it is a syllable (akṣara).

sanskrit_iast: yad v evākṣaraṃ nākṣīyata tasmād akṣayam akṣayaṃ ha vai nāmaitat tad akṣaram iti parokṣam ācakṣate |
meaning: यद् व् एवाक्षरं नाक्षीयत तस्माद् अक्षयम् अक्षयं ह वै नामैतत् तद् अक्षरम् इति परोक्षम् आचक्षते ।
text: And because, being aksara, it was not exhausted (y'Asi), therefore it is aksaya. Verily, aksaya is its name. It is called aksara in an occult way.

sanskrit_iast: tad dhaitad eka om iti gāyanti tat tathā na gāyet īśvaro hainad etena rasenāntardhātoḥ atho dve ivaivam bhavata om iti o ity u haike gāyanti tad u ha tan na gītam naiva tathā gāyet oṃ ity eva gāyet tad enad etena rasena saṃdadhāti |
meaning: तद् धैतद् एक ओम् इति गायन्ति तत् तथा न गायेत् ईश्वरो हैनद् एतेन रसेनान्तर्धातोः अथो द्वे इवैवम् भवत ओम् इति ओ इत्य् उ हैके गायन्ति तद् उ ह तन् न गीतम् नैव तथा गायेत् ओं इत्य् एव गायेत् तद् एनद् एतेन रसेन संदधाति ।
text: Now some sing this as om. Let one not sing it thus. He is liable to hide it by this sap. So also there come to be two, as it were, viz. o-m. And some sing o. And that is also not sang thus. Let him not sing it thus either. Let him sing 07h. Thus he combines it with that sap.

sanskrit_iast: tad etaṃ rasaṃ tarpayati rasas tṛpto 'kṣaraṃ tarpayati akṣaraṃ tṛptaṃ vyāhṛtīs tarpayati vyāhṛtayas tṛptā vedāṃs tarpayanti vedās tṛptā devatās tarpayanti devatās tṛptā lokāṃs tarpayanti lokās tṛptā akṣaraṃ tarpayanti akṣaraṃ tṛptaṃ vācaṃ tarpayati vāk tṛptākāśaṃ tarpayati ākāśas tṛptaḥ prajās tarpayati tṛpyati prajayā paśubhir ya etad evaṃ vedātho yasyaivaṃ vidvān udgāyati | saptame 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ saptamo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: तद् एतं रसं तर्पयति रसस् तृप्तो ऽक्षरं तर्पयति अक्षरं तृप्तं व्याहृतीस् तर्पयति व्याहृतयस् तृप्ता वेदांस् तर्पयन्ति वेदास् तृप्ता देवतास् तर्पयन्ति देवतास् तृप्ता लोकांस् तर्पयन्ति लोकास् तृप्ता अक्षरं तर्पयन्ति अक्षरं तृप्तं वाचं तर्पयति वाक् तृप्ताकाशं तर्पयति आकाशस् तृप्तः प्रजास् तर्पयति तृप्यति प्रजया पशुभिर् य एतद् एवं वेदाथो यस्यैवं विद्वान् उद्गायति । सप्तमे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः सप्तमो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: He thus causes this sap to rejoice. The sap, rejoiced, causes the syllable to rejoice. The syllable, rejoiced, causes the sacred utterances to rejoice. The sacred utterances, rejoiced, cause the Vedas to rejoice. The Vedas, rejoiced, cause the divinities to rejoice. The divinities, rejoiced, cause the worlds to rejoice. The worlds, rejoiced, cause the syllable to rejoice. The syllable, rejoiced, causes speech to rejoice. Speech, rejoiced, causes space to rejoice. Space, rejoiced, causes the creatures to rejoice. He rejoices in offspring and cattle who knows this thus, and also he for whom one knowing thus sings the udgītha.

sanskrit_iast: ayam evedam agra ākāśa āsīt sa u evāpy etarhi |
meaning: अयम् एवेदम् अग्र आकाश आसीत् स उ एवाप्य् एतर्हि ।
text: This [universe] was in the beginning this space here; and that is so even now. % What this space is, that is the sun. For when he has risen this all is visible,
text_mt:
This space alone was here in the beginning.
And it is indeed [so] even now.

sanskrit_iast: sa yas sa ākāśa āditya eva sa etasmin udite sarvam idam ākāśate |
meaning: स यस् स आकाश आदित्य एव स एतस्मिन् उदिते सर्वम् इदम् आकाशते ।
text_mt:
That which was space is Āditya himself.
For when he has risen, this whole [world] shines (ākāśate).

sanskrit_iast: tasya martyāmṛtayor vai tīrāṇi samudra eva tad yat samudreṇa parigṛhītaṃ tan mṛtyor āptam atha yat paraṃ tad amṛtam |
meaning: तस्य मर्त्यामृतयोर् वै तीराणि समुद्र एव तद् यत् समुद्रेण परिगृहीतं तन् मृत्योर् आप्तम् अथ यत् परं तद् अमृतम् ।
text: Verily its limits of the mortal and immortal are the ocean. What is encompassed by the ocean, that is obtained by death, and what is beyond, that is immortal.
text_mt:
His shores between the mortal and the immortal are the ocean itself.
Now, what is encompassed by the ocean is overtaken by death; and what is beyond is immortal.

sanskrit_iast: sa yo ha sa samudro ya evāyam pavata eṣa eva sa samudraḥ etaṃ hi saṃdravantaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāny anusaṃdravanti |
meaning: स यो ह स समुद्रो य एवायम् पवत एष एव स समुद्रः एतं हि संद्रवन्तं सर्वाणि भूतान्य् अनुसंद्रवन्ति ।
text: As for this ocean—he who cleanses here is this ocean. For after him running together {Śdru+sam) all created beings run together,
text_mt:
That ocean which existed—this very one that purifies here is that ocean.
For all beings run along after him as he runs together.

sanskrit_iast: tasya dyāvāpṛthivī eva rodhasī atha yathā nadyāṃ kaṃsāni vā prahīṇāni syus sarāṃsi vaivam asyāyam pārthivas samudraḥ |
meaning: तस्य द्यावापृथिवी एव रोधसी अथ यथा नद्यां कंसानि वा प्रहीणानि स्युस् सरांसि वैवम् अस्यायम् पार्थिवस् समुद्रः ।
text: Heaven and earth are its two banks. As beakers or pails abandoTied in a river would be, so is this earthly ocean of his.
text_mt:
His two banks are heaven and earth.
And just as bowls or ponds might be cast into a river, so is this earthly ocean for him.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa pāra eva samudrasyodeti sa udyann eva vāyoḥ pṛṣṭha ākramate so 'mṛtād evodeti amṛtam anusaṃcarati amṛte pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
meaning: स एष पार एव समुद्रस्योदेति स उद्यन्न् एव वायोः पृष्ठ आक्रमते सो ऽमृताद् एवोदेति अमृतम् अनुसंचरति अमृते प्रतिष्ठितः ।
text: This one rises at the shore of the ocean. Rising he ascends on the back of the wind. He rises from the immortal. He goes about after the immortal. He stands firm in the immortal.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaitat trivṛd rūpam mṛtyor anāptaṃ śuklaṃ kṛṣṇam puruṣaḥ |
meaning: तस्यैतत् त्रिवृद् रूपम् मृत्योर् अनाप्तं शुक्लं कृष्णम् पुरुषः ।
text: That threefold form of him which is not obtained by death is white, black, person,
text_mt: His threefold form is this, not overtaken by death: the white, the black, and the person.

sanskrit_iast: tad yac chuklaṃ tad vāco rūpam ṛco 'gner mṛtyoḥ sā yā sā vāg ṛk sā atha yo 'gnir mṛtyus saḥ |
meaning: तद् यच् छुक्लं तद् वाचो रूपम् ऋचो ऽग्नेर् मृत्योः सा या सा वाग् ऋक् सा अथ यो ऽग्निर् मृत्युस् सः ।
text: What is white, that is the form of speech, of the re, of Agni (fire), of death. What this speech is, that is the re; and what Agni is, that is death.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat kṛṣṇaṃ tad apāṃ rūpam annasya manaso yajuṣaḥ tad yās tā āpo 'nnaṃ tat atha yan mano yajuṣ ṭat |
meaning: अथ यत् कृष्णं तद् अपां रूपम् अन्नस्य मनसो यजुषः तद् यास् ता आपो ऽन्नं तत् अथ यन् मनो यजुष् टत् ।
text: Further, what is black, that is the form ot the waters, of food, of mind, of the yajus. What these waters are, that is food; and what the mind is, that is the yajus.

sanskrit_iast: atha yaḥ puruṣas sa prāṇas tat sāma tad brahma tad amṛtam sa yaḥ prāṇas tat sāma atha yad brahma tad amṛtam | aṣṭame 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: अथ यः पुरुषस् स प्राणस् तत् साम तद् ब्रह्म तद् अमृतम् स यः प्राणस् तत् साम अथ यद् ब्रह्म तद् अमृतम् । अष्टमे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: Further, what this person is, that is breath, that is the sāman, that is the brahman, that is the immortal. What breath is, that is the sāman; and what the brahman is, that is the immortal.
text_mt:
Then the person who is [there] is breath, that sāman, that brahman, that immortal.
That breath is the sāman;
and that brahman is the immortal.
First khaṇḍa in the eighth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: athādhyātmam idam eva cakṣus trivṛc chuklaṃ kṛṣṇam puruṣaḥ |
meaning: अथाध्यात्मम् इदम् एव चक्षुस् त्रिवृच् छुक्लं कृष्णम् पुरुषः ।
text: Now with regard to the self. This eye here is threefold: white, black, person. 2-4 = I. 25. s-io.
text_mt:
Now pertaining to the self:
This eye itself is threefold: the white, the black, and the person.

sanskrit_iast: tad yac chuklaṃ tad vāco rūpam ṛco 'gner mṛtyoḥ sā yā sā vāg ṛk sā atha yo 'gnir mṛtyus saḥ |
meaning: तद् यच् छुक्लं तद् वाचो रूपम् ऋचो ऽग्नेर् मृत्योः सा या सा वाग् ऋक् सा अथ यो ऽग्निर् मृत्युस् सः ।

sanskrit_iast: atha yat kṛṣṇaṃ tad apāṃ rūpam annasya manaso yajuṣaḥ tad yās tā āpo 'nnaṃ tat atha yan mano yajuṣ ṭat |
meaning: अथ यत् कृष्णं तद् अपां रूपम् अन्नस्य मनसो यजुषः तद् यास् ता आपो ऽन्नं तत् अथ यन् मनो यजुष् टत् ।
text: This is the upgoing of the brahman. And from there is the on-going (?).

sanskrit_iast: atha yaḥ puruṣas sa prāṇas tat sāma tad brahma tad amṛtam sa yaḥ prāṇas tat sāma atha yad brahma tad amṛtam |
meaning: अथ यः पुरुषस् स प्राणस् तत् साम तद् ब्रह्म तद् अमृतम् स यः प्राणस् तत् साम अथ यद् ब्रह्म तद् अमृतम् ।

sanskrit_iast: saiṣotkrāntir brahmaṇaḥ athātaḥ parākrāntiḥ |
meaning: सैषोत्क्रान्तिर् ब्रह्मणः अथातः पराक्रान्तिः ।
text_mt:
This is the stepping up of brahman.
Now next is the stepping beyond.

sanskrit_iast: sā yā sākrāntir vidyud eva sā sa yad eva vidyuto vidyotamānāyai śyetaṃ rūpam bhavati tad vāco rūpam ṛco 'gner mṛtyoḥ |
meaning: सा या साक्रान्तिर् विद्युद् एव सा स यद् एव विद्युतो विद्योतमानायै श्येतं रूपम् भवति तद् वाचो रूपम् ऋचो ऽग्नेर् मृत्योः ।
text: This ascending is the lightning. The reddish-white form which is of the lightning as it lightens, that is the form of speech, of the re, of Agni (fire), of death.
text_mt:
That which is the stepping [beyond] is lightning itself.
Now, whatever white form there is of the flashing lightning, that is the form of speech, of the ṛgverse, of Agni, of death.

sanskrit_iast: yad v eva vidyutas saṃdravantyai nīḷaṃ rūpam bhavati tad apāṃ rūpam annasya manaso yajuṣaḥ |
meaning: यद् व् एव विद्युतस् संद्रवन्त्यै नीऌअं रूपम् भवति तद् अपां रूपम् अन्नस्य मनसो यजुषः ।
text: And the dark-blue form which is of the lightning as it runs together, that is the form of the waters, of food, of mind, of the yajus.
text_mt: And whatever dark blue form there is of the lightning as it runs together, that is the form of the waters, of food, of the mind, of the yajus-formula.

sanskrit_iast: ya evaiṣa vidyuti puruṣas sa prāṇas tat sāma tad brahma tad amṛtam sa yaḥ prāṇas tat sāma atha yad brahma tad amṛtam | aṣṭame 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: य एवैष विद्युति पुरुषस् स प्राणस् तत् साम तद् ब्रह्म तद् अमृतम् स यः प्राणस् तत् साम अथ यद् ब्रह्म तद् अमृतम् । अष्टमे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: And that person which is in the lightning, that is breath, that is the sāman, that is the brahman, that is the immortal. What breath is, that is the sāman; and what the brahman is, that is the immortal.
text_mt:
This very person who is in the lightning is breath, that sāman, that brahman, that immortal.
That breath is the sāman;
and that brahman is the immortal.
Second khaṇḍa in the eighth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sa haiṣo 'mṛtena parivṛḍho mṛtyum adhyāste 'nnaṃ kṛtvā |
meaning: स हैषो ऽमृतेन परिवृढो मृत्युम् अध्यास्ते ऽन्नं कृत्वा ।
text: This same one, fortified by the immortal, having made food, sits upon death.
text_mt: Surrounded by the immortal, he sits over death, having made it his food.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa eva puruṣo yo 'yaṃ cakṣuṣi ya āditye so 'tipuruṣaḥ yo vidyuti sa paramapuruṣaḥ |
meaning: अथैष एव पुरुषो यो ऽयं चक्षुषि य आदित्ये सो ऽतिपुरुषः यो विद्युति स परमपुरुषः ।
text: Now he is this person who is in the eye here. He who is in the sun is the snperior-person. He who is in the lightning is the supreme-person.

sanskrit_iast: ete ha vāva trayaḥ puruṣāḥ ā hāsyaite jāyante |
meaning: एते ह वाव त्रयः पुरुषाः आ हास्यैते जायन्ते ।
text: These are the three persons; to him indeed they are born.
text_mt:
These indeed are the three persons;
these are born for him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yo 'yaṃ cakṣuṣy eṣo 'nurūpo nāma anvaṅ hy eṣa sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tam anurūpa ity upāsīta anvañci hainaṃ sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti |
meaning: स यो ऽयं चक्षुष्य् एषो ऽनुरूपो नाम अन्वङ् ह्य् एष सर्वाणि रूपाणि तम् अनुरूप इत्य् उपासीत अन्वञ्चि हैनं सर्वाणि रूपाणि भवन्ति ।
text: He who is here in the eye is conformable (anurupa) by name. For he follows after all forms. One should worship him as conformable. Verily all forms [will] follow after him.

sanskrit_iast: ya āditye sa pratirūpaḥ pratyaṅ hy eṣa sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tam pratirūpa ity upāsīta pratyañci hainaṃ sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti |
meaning: य आदित्ये स प्रतिरूपः प्रत्यङ् ह्य् एष सर्वाणि रूपाणि तम् प्रतिरूप इत्य् उपासीत प्रत्यञ्चि हैनं सर्वाणि रूपाणि भवन्ति ।
text: He who is in the sun is of corresponding form (pratirupa). For he is corresponding to all forms. One should worship him as of corresponding form. Verily all forms [will] correspond to him.

sanskrit_iast: yo vidyuti sa sarvarūpaḥ sarvāṇi hy etasmin rūpāṇi taṃ sarvarūpa ity upāsīta sarvāṇi hāsmin rūpāṇi bhavanti |
meaning: यो विद्युति स सर्वरूपः सर्वाणि ह्य् एतस्मिन् रूपाणि तं सर्वरूप इत्य् उपासीत सर्वाणि हास्मिन् रूपाणि भवन्ति ।
text: He who is in the lightning is of all forms. For all forms are in him. One should worship him as of all forms. Verily all forms [will] be in him.
text_mt: The one in lightning is the omniform (all-formed). For all forms are in it. One should venerate it as the omniform. All forms belong to him.

sanskrit_iast: ete ha vāva trayaḥ puruṣāḥ ā hāsyaite jāyante ya etad evaṃ vedātho yasyaivaṃ vidvān udgāyati | aṣṭame 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ aṣṭamo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: एते ह वाव त्रयः पुरुषाः आ हास्यैते जायन्ते य एतद् एवं वेदाथो यस्यैवं विद्वान् उद्गायति । अष्टमे ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः अष्टमो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: Verily these are the three persons. They are born to him who knows this thus, and to him for whom one knowing thus sings the udgitha.
text_mt: These indeed are the three persons. They are born to him who knows this thus, and also to him for whom one knowing thus sings the udgītha. / Third section in the eighth anuvāka. The eighth anuvāka is complete.

sanskrit_iast: ayam evedam agra ākāśa āsīt sa u evāpy etarhi |
meaning: अयम् एवेदम् अग्र आकाश आसीत् स उ एवाप्य् एतर्हि ।
text: This [universe] here in the beginning was space, and that is so even now.
text_mt: This space alone was here in the beginning. And it indeed is [here] even now.

sanskrit_iast: sa yas sa ākāśa indra eva saḥ sa yas sa indra eṣa eva sa ya eṣa eva tapati sa eṣa saptaraśmir vṛṣabhas tuviṣmān |
meaning: स यस् स आकाश इन्द्र एव सः स यस् स इन्द्र एष एव स य एष एव तपति स एष सप्तरश्मिर् वृषभस् तुविष्मान् ।
text: This space is Indra. What this Indra is, that is he who burns here. That same one is seven-rayed, virile, powerful.
text_mt: That which is that space is Indra alone. That which is that Indra is this very one who shines here. That one is the seven-rayed bull, mighty.

sanskrit_iast: tasya vāṅmayo raśmiḥ prāṅ pratiṣṭhitaḥ sā yā sā vāg agnis saḥ sa daśadhā bhavati śatadhā sahasradhāyutadhā prayutadhā niyutadhārbudadhā nyarbudadhā nikharvadhā padmam akṣitir vyomāntaḥ |
meaning: तस्य वाङ्मयो रश्मिः प्राङ् प्रतिष्ठितः सा या सा वाग् अग्निस् सः स दशधा भवति शतधा सहस्रधायुतधा प्रयुतधा नियुतधार्बुदधा न्यर्बुदधा निखर्वधा पद्मम् अक्षितिर् व्योमान्तः ।
text: Of him the ray consisting of speech stands firm in front (east). That speech is Agni (fire). It becomes tenfold, hundredfold, thousandfold, ten thousandfold, hundred thousandfold, millionfold, ten millionfold, himdred millionfold, billionfold, ten billionfold, a hundred billionfold, a thousand billionfold.
text_mt: His ray consisting of speech is established facing east. That which is that speech is Agni. It becomes tenfold, a hundredfold, a thousandfold, ten-thousandfold, a hundred-thousandfold, a millionfold, ten-millionfold, a hundred-millionfold, a billionfold, a ten-billionfold, inexhaustible, sky-ended.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa etasya raśmir vāg bhūtvā sarvāsv āsu prajāsu pratyavasthitaḥ sa yaḥ kaś ca vadaty etasyaiva raśminā vadati |
meaning: स एष एतस्य रश्मिर् वाग् भूत्वा सर्वास्व् आसु प्रजासु प्रत्यवस्थितः स यः कश् च वदत्य् एतस्यैव रश्मिना वदति ।
text: This ray of him becoming speech is located respectively in all these creatures. Whosoever speaks, he speaks by the ray of him.
text_mt: This ray of his, having become speech, is stationed in all these creatures. Whosoever speaks, speaks through this very ray.

sanskrit_iast: atha manomayo dakṣiṇā pratiṣṭhitaḥ tad yat tan manaś candramās saḥ sa daśadhā bhavati |
meaning: अथ मनोमयो दक्षिणा प्रतिष्ठितः तद् यत् तन् मनश् चन्द्रमास् सः स दशधा भवति ।
text: Now [the ray] consisting of mind stands firm at the right (south). That mind is the moon. That becomes tenfold.
text_mt: Now, the [ray] consisting of mind is established facing south. That which is that mind is the Moon. It becomes tenfold.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa etasya raśmir mano bhūtvā sarvāsv āsu prajāsu pratyavasthitaḥ sa yaḥ kaś ca manuta etasyaiva raśminā manute |
meaning: स एष एतस्य रश्मिर् मनो भूत्वा सर्वास्व् आसु प्रजासु प्रत्यवस्थितः स यः कश् च मनुत एतस्यैव रश्मिना मनुते ।
text: That ray of him becoming mind is located respectively in all these creatures. Whosoever thinks, he thinks by the ray of him.
text_mt: This ray of his, having become mind, is stationed in all these creatures. Whosoever thinks, thinks through this very ray.

sanskrit_iast: atha cakṣurmayaḥ pratyaṅ pratiṣṭhitaḥ tad yat tac cakṣur ādityas saḥ sa daśadhā bhavati |
meaning: अथ चक्षुर्मयः प्रत्यङ् प्रतिष्ठितः तद् यत् तच् चक्षुर् आदित्यस् सः स दशधा भवति ।
text: Now [the ray] consisting of sight stands firm in the rear (west). That sight is the sun. That becomes tenfold,
text_mt: Now, the [ray] consisting of sight is established facing west. That which is that sight is Āditya. It becomes tenfold.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa etasya raśmiś cakṣur bhūtvā sarvāsv āsu prajāsu pratyavasthitaḥ sa yaḥ kaś ca paśyaty etasyaiva raśminā paśyati |
meaning: स एष एतस्य रश्मिश् चक्षुर् भूत्वा सर्वास्व् आसु प्रजासु प्रत्यवस्थितः स यः कश् च पश्यत्य् एतस्यैव रश्मिना पश्यति ।
text: That ray of him becoming sight is located respectively in all these creatures. Whosoever sees, he sees by the ray of him.
text_mt: This ray of his, having become sight, is stationed in all these creatures. Whosoever sees, sees through this very ray.

sanskrit_iast: atha śrotramaya udaṅ pratiṣṭhitaḥ tad yat tac chrotraṃ diśas tāḥ sa daśadhā bhavati |
meaning: अथ श्रोत्रमय उदङ् प्रतिष्ठितः तद् यत् तच् छ्रोत्रं दिशस् ताः स दशधा भवति ।
text: Now [the ray] consisting of hearing stands firm upward (north). That hearing is the quarters. That becomes tenfold.
text_mt: Now, the [ray] consisting of hearing is established facing north. That which is that hearing is the directions. It becomes tenfold.

sanskrit_iast: sa eśa etasya raśmiś śrotram bhūtvā sarvāsv āsu prajāsu pratyavasthitaḥ sa yaḥ kaś ca śṛṇoty etasyaiva raśminā śṛṇoti | navame 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स एश एतस्य रश्मिश् श्रोत्रम् भूत्वा सर्वास्व् आसु प्रजासु प्रत्यवस्थितः स यः कश् च शृणोत्य् एतस्यैव रश्मिना शृणोति । नवमे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: That ray of him becoming hearing is located respectively in all these creatures. Whosoever hears, he hears by the ray of him.
text_mt: This ray of his, having become hearing, is stationed in all these creatures. Whosoever hears, hears through this very ray. / First section in the ninth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: atha prāṇamaya ūrdhvaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ sa yas sa prāṇo vāyus saḥ sa daśadhā bhavati |
meaning: अथ प्राणमय ऊर्ध्वः प्रतिष्ठितः स यस् स प्राणो वायुस् सः स दशधा भवति ।
text: Now [the ray] consisting of breath stands firm aloft. That breath is Vayu (wind). It becomes tenfold,
text_mt: Now, the [ray] consisting of breath is established upward. That which is that breath is Vāyu. It becomes tenfold.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa etasya raśmiḥ prāṇo bhūtvā sarvāsv āsu prajāsu pratyavasthitaḥ sa yaḥ kaś ca prāṇity etasyaiva raśminā prāṇiti |
meaning: स एष एतस्य रश्मिः प्राणो भूत्वा सर्वास्व् आसु प्रजासु प्रत्यवस्थितः स यः कश् च प्राणित्य् एतस्यैव रश्मिना प्राणिति ।
text: That ray of him becoming breath is located respectively in all these creatures. "Whosoever breathes, he breathes by the ray of him.
text_mt: This ray of his, having become breath, is stationed in all these creatures. Whosoever breathes, breathes through this very ray.

sanskrit_iast: athāsumayas tiryaṅ pratiṣṭhitaḥ sa ha sa īśāno nāma sa daśadhā bhavati |
meaning: अथासुमयस् तिर्यङ् प्रतिष्ठितः स ह स ईशानो नाम स दशधा भवति ।
text: Now [the ray] consisting of the vital spirit stands firm crosswise. That same is Lord by name. That becomes tenfold. 4, That ray of him becoming the vital spirit is located respectively in all these creatures. Whosoever possesses the vital spirit, he possesses the vital spirit by the ray of him.
text_mt: Now, the [ray] consisting of vital spirit is established transversely. That indeed is named the Ruler. It becomes tenfold.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa etasya raśmir asur bhūtvā sarvāsv āsu prajāsu pratyavasthitaḥ sa yaḥ kaś cāsumān etasyaiva raśmināsumān |
meaning: स एष एतस्य रश्मिर् असुर् भूत्वा सर्वास्व् आसु प्रजासु प्रत्यवस्थितः स यः कश् चासुमान् एतस्यैव रश्मिनासुमान् ।
text_mt: This ray of his, having become vital spirit, is stationed in all these creatures. Whosoever possesses vital spirit, possesses vital spirit through this very ray.

sanskrit_iast: athānnamayo 'rvāṅ pratiṣṭhitaḥ tad yat tad annam āpas tāḥ sa daśadhā bhavati śatadhā sahasradhāyutadhā prayutadhā niyutadhārbudadhā nyarbudadhā nikharvadhā padmam akṣitir vyomāntaḥ |
meaning: अथान्नमयो ऽर्वाङ् प्रतिष्ठितः तद् यत् तद् अन्नम् आपस् ताः स दशधा भवति शतधा सहस्रधायुतधा प्रयुतधा नियुतधार्बुदधा न्यर्बुदधा निखर्वधा पद्मम् अक्षितिर् व्योमान्तः ।
text: Now [the ray] consisting of food stands firm hitherward. That food is the waters. That becomes tenfold, hundredfold, thousandfold, ten thousandfold, hundred thousandfold, millionfold, ten millionfold, hundred millionfold, billionfold, ten billionfold, a hundred billionfold, a thousand billionfold.
text_mt: Now, the [ray] consisting of food is established downward. That which is that food is the waters. It becomes tenfold, a hundredfold, a thousandfold, ten-thousandfold, a hundred-thousandfold, a millionfold, ten-millionfold, a hundred-millionfold, a billionfold, a ten-billionfold, inexhaustible, sky-ended.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa etasya raśmir annam bhūtvā sarvāsv āsu prajāsu pratyavasthitaḥ sa yaḥ kaś cāśnāty etasyaiva raśmināśnāti |
meaning: स एष एतस्य रश्मिर् अन्नम् भूत्वा सर्वास्व् आसु प्रजासु प्रत्यवस्थितः स यः कश् चाश्नात्य् एतस्यैव रश्मिनाश्नाति ।
text: That ray of him becoming food is located respectively in all these creatures. Whosoever eats, he eats by the ray of him.
text_mt: This ray of his, having become food, is stationed in all these creatures. Whosoever eats, eats through this very ray.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa saptaraśmir vṛṣabhas tuviṣmān tad etad ṛcābhyanūcyate yas saptaraśmir vṛṣabhas tuviṣmān avāsṛjat sartave sapta sindhūn yo rauhiṇam asphurad vajrabāhur dyām ārohantaṃ sa janāsa indra iti |
meaning: स एष सप्तरश्मिर् वृषभस् तुविष्मान् तद् एतद् ऋचाभ्यनूच्यते यस् सप्तरश्मिर् वृषभस् तुविष्मान् अवासृजत् सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून् यो रौहिणम् अस्फुरद् वज्रबाहुर् द्याम् आरोहन्तं स जनास इन्द्र इति ।
text: That same one is seven-rayed, virile, powerful. That same is spoken of in a tc: " Who sevenrayed, virile, powerful, let loose to run the seven streams; who with the thunderbolt in his arm smote Rauhina ascending the sky—he, ye people, is Indra."
text_mt: That one is the seven-rayed bull, mighty. Concerning this it is declared by a verse: / 'He who, the seven-rayed bull, mighty, released the seven streams to flow, / who, thunderbolt in hand, struck Rauhiṇa as he was climbing to heaven—he, O people, is Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: yas saptaraśmir iti sapta hy eta ādityasya raśmayaḥ vṛṣabha iti eṣa hy evāsām prajānām ṛṣabhaḥ tuviṣmān iti mahīyaivāsyaiṣā |
meaning: यस् सप्तरश्मिर् इति सप्त ह्य् एत आदित्यस्य रश्मयः वृषभ इति एष ह्य् एवासाम् प्रजानाम् ऋषभः तुविष्मान् इति महीयैवास्यैषा ।
text: 'Who seven-rayed,' for these rays of the sun are seven. ' Virile,' for he is the bull of these creatures. ' Powerful,' that is his exaltation.
text_mt: 'He who is seven-rayed': / for seven indeed are the rays of Āditya. / 'The bull': / for he indeed is the bull among these creatures. / 'Mighty': / for this greatness is truly his.

sanskrit_iast: avāsṛjat sartave sapta sindhūn iti sapta hy ete sindhavaḥ tair idaṃ sarvaṃ sitam tad yad etair idaṃ sarvaṃ sitaṃ tasmāt sindhavaḥ |
meaning: अवासृजत् सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून् इति सप्त ह्य् एते सिन्धवः तैर् इदं सर्वं सितम् तद् यद् एतैर् इदं सर्वं सितं तस्मात् सिन्धवः ।
text: ' Let loose to run the seven streams,' for these streams are seven; by them this all is bound. Because by them the all is bound {Śsi), therefore they are [called] streams (sindhu).
text_mt: 'Released the seven streams to flow': / for seven indeed are these streams. / By them all this is bound. / Because all this is bound (sita) by them, therefore they are streams (sindhavaḥ).

sanskrit_iast: yo rauhiṇam asphurad vajrabāhur iti eṣa rauhiṇam asphurad vajrabāhuḥ |
meaning: यो रौहिणम् अस्फुरद् वज्रबाहुर् इति एष रौहिणम् अस्फुरद् वज्रबाहुः ।
text: ' Who with the thunderbolt in his arm smote Rauhina,' for he with the thunderbolt in his arm did smite Rauhina.
text_mt: 'Who, thunderbolt in hand, struck Rauhiṇa': / for he struck Rauhiṇa, thunderbolt in hand.

sanskrit_iast: dyām ārohantaṃ sa janāsa indra iti eṣa hīndraḥ | navame 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: द्याम् आरोहन्तं स जनास इन्द्र इति एष हीन्द्रः । नवमे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: 'Ascending the sky, he, ye people, is Indra,' for he is Indra.
text_mt: 'As he was climbing to heaven—he, O people, is Indra': / for he is Indra. / Second section in the ninth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā girim panthānas samudiyur iti ha smāha śāṭyāyanir evam eta ādityasya raśmaya etam ādityaṃ sarvato 'piyanti sa haivaṃ vidvān om ity ādadāna etair etasya raśmibhir etam ādityaṃ sarvato 'pyeti |
meaning: तद् यथा गिरिम् पन्थानस् समुदियुर् इति ह स्माह शाट्यायनिर् एवम् एत आदित्यस्य रश्मय एतम् आदित्यं सर्वतो ऽपियन्ति स हैवं विद्वान् ओम् इत्य् आददान एतैर् एतस्य रश्मिभिर् एतम् आदित्यं सर्वतो ऽप्येति ।
text: "As paths might lead together up a mountain," Śatyayani used to say, " even so these rays of the sun go from all sides to that sun." Verily one knowing thus who starts with om approaches this sun from all sides by means of these rays of him.
text_mt: 'Just as paths run together up a mountain,' so Śāṭyāyani used to say, 'even so these rays of Āditya merge from all sides into this Āditya.' / He who knows thus, taking up the sound 'om', merges from all sides into this Āditya through these rays of his.

sanskrit_iast: tad etat sarvatodvāram aniṣedhaṃ sāma anyatodvāraṃ hainad eka evābhraṃgam upāsate ato 'nyathā vidyuḥ |
meaning: तद् एतत् सर्वतोद्वारम् अनिषेधं साम अन्यतोद्वारं हैनद् एक एवाभ्रंगम् उपासते अतो ऽन्यथा विद्युः ।
text: That same is the unobstructed (anisedha) sāman having doors on all sides. Some, indeed, worship it as having doors on both sides, cloud-going. Let them know differently from that.
text_mt: This is the sāman with doors on all sides, unobstructed. Some, however, venerate it merely as wandering like a cloud, with a door only on one side. They would know otherwise than this.

sanskrit_iast: atha ya etad evaṃ veda sa evaitat sarvatodvāram aniṣedhaṃ sāma veda |
meaning: अथ य एतद् एवं वेद स एवैतत् सर्वतोद्वारम् अनिषेधं साम वेद ।
text: And he who knows it thus, he knows the unobstructed sāman having doors on all sides.
text_mt: Now, he who knows this thus, he alone knows this sāman with doors on all sides, unobstructed.

sanskrit_iast: sā eṣā vidyut etan maṇḍalaṃ samantam paripatati tat sāma atha yat param atibhāti sa puṇyakṛtyāyai rasaḥ tam abhyatimucyate |
meaning: सा एषा विद्युत् एतन् मण्डलं समन्तम् परिपतति तत् साम अथ यत् परम् अतिभाति स पुण्यकृत्यायै रसः तम् अभ्यतिमुच्यते ।
text: That same is this lightning. What flies around this whole disk, that is the sāman; and what shines across, beyond, that is the sap of good action. TJnto that he is released,
text_mt: That is this lightning. That disk which flies all around is the sāman. And that which shines beyond is the essence of good action. Into it he is released beyond.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad abhrātṛvyaṃ sāma na ha vā indraḥ kaṃ cana bhrātṛvyam paśyate sa yathendro na kaṃ cana bhrātṛvyam paśyata evam eva na kaṃ cana bhrātṛvyam paśyate ya etad evaṃ vedātho yasyaivaṃ vidvān udgāyati | navame 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ navamo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: तद् एतद् अभ्रातृव्यं साम न ह वा इन्द्रः कं चन भ्रातृव्यम् पश्यते स यथेन्द्रो न कं चन भ्रातृव्यम् पश्यत एवम् एव न कं चन भ्रातृव्यम् पश्यते य एतद् एवं वेदाथो यस्यैवं विद्वान् उद्गायति । नवमे ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः नवमो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: That same is the rivalless .sāman. For Indra indeed sees no rival whatever. As Indra sees no rival whatever, even so he sees no rival whatever who knows this thus and likewise he for whom one knowing thns sings the udgītha.
text_mt: This is the rival-free sāman. Indra indeed sees no rival at all. Just as Indra sees no rival at all, even so he sees no rival at all who knows this thus, and also he for whom one knowing thus sings the udgītha. / Third section in the ninth anuvāka. The ninth anuvāka is complete.

sanskrit_iast: ayam evedam agra ākāśa āsīt sa u evāpy etarhi sa yas sa ākāśa indra eva saḥ sa yas sa indras sāmaiva tat |
meaning: अयम् एवेदम् अग्र आकाश आसीत् स उ एवाप्य् एतर्हि स यस् स आकाश इन्द्र एव सः स यस् स इन्द्रस् सामैव तत् ।
text: This [all] here was in the beginning space. And that is so even now. What this space is, that is Indra. What this Indra is, that is the sāman.
text_mt: This space alone was here in the beginning. And it indeed is [here] even now. That which is that space is Indra alone. That which is that Indra is that very sāman.

sanskrit_iast: tāsyaitasya sāmna iyam eva prācī dig ghiṅkāra iyam prastāva iyam ādir iyam udgītho 'sau pratihāro 'ntarikṣam upadrava iyam eva nidhanam |
meaning: तास्यैतस्य साम्न इयम् एव प्राची दिग् घिङ्कार इयम् प्रस्ताव इयम् आदिर् इयम् उद्गीथो ऽसौ प्रतिहारो ऽन्तरिक्षम् उपद्रव इयम् एव निधनम् ।
text: Of this same sāman this eastern quarter is the hinkdra, this (i. e. the southern quarter) the prastāva, this (i. e. the western quarter) the ddi, this (i. e. the northern quarter) the udgitha, yonder [quarter] the pratihāra, the atmosphere the upadrava, this [quarter] the nidhana.
text_mt: Of that very sāman, this eastern direction is the hiṅkāra, this [southern] is the prastāva, this [western] is the ādi, this [northern] is the udgītha, that [zenith] is the pratihāra, the intermediate space is the upadrava, this [nadir] alone is the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: tad etat saptavidhaṃ sāma sa ya evam etat saptavidhaṃ sāma veda yat kiṃ ca prācyāṃ diśi yā devatā ye manuṣyā ye paśavo yad annādyaṃ tat sarvaṃ hiṅkāreṇāpnoti |
meaning: तद् एतत् सप्तविधं साम स य एवम् एतत् सप्तविधं साम वेद यत् किं च प्राच्यां दिशि या देवता ये मनुष्या ये पशवो यद् अन्नाद्यं तत् सर्वं हिङ्कारेणाप्नोति ।
text: That is the sevenfold sāman. He who knows this thus sevenfold sāman, whatever there is in the eastern quarter, what divinities, what men, what domestic animals, what food, all that he obtains by means of the hinkdra.
text_mt: This is the sevenfold sāman. He who knows this sevenfold sāman thus, whatever deity, whatever men, whatever cattle, whatever edible food is in the eastern direction, he obtains all that through the hiṅkāra.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad dakṣiṇāyaṃ diśi tat sarvam prastāvenāpnoti |
meaning: अथ यद् दक्षिणायं दिशि तत् सर्वम् प्रस्तावेनाप्नोति ।
text: And what there is in the southern quarter, all that he obtains by means of the prastāva.
text_mt: Now, whatever is in the southern direction, he obtains all that through the prastāva.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat pratīcyāṃ diśi tat sarvam ādināpnoti |
meaning: अथ यत् प्रतीच्यां दिशि तत् सर्वम् आदिनाप्नोति ।
text: And what there is in the western quarter, all that be obtains by means of the ddi.
text_mt: Now, whatever is in the western direction, he obtains all that through the ādi.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad udīcyāṃ diśi tat sarvam udgīthenāpnoti |
meaning: अथ यद् उदीच्यां दिशि तत् सर्वम् उद्गीथेनाप्नोति ।
text: And what there is in the northern quarter, all that he obtains by means of the udgītha.
text_mt: Now, whatever is in the northern direction, he obtains all that through the udgītha.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad amuṣyāṃ diśi tat sarvam pratihāreṇāpnoti |
meaning: अथ यद् अमुष्यां दिशि तत् सर्वम् प्रतिहारेणाप्नोति ।
text: And what there is in yonder quarter, all that he obtains by means of the pratihāra.
text_mt: Now, whatever is in that [upper] direction, he obtains all that through the pratihāra.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad antarikṣe tat sarvam upadraveṇāpnoti |
meaning: अथ यद् अन्तरिक्षे तत् सर्वम् उपद्रवेणाप्नोति ।
text: And what there is in the atmosphere, all that he obtains by means of the upadrava.
text_mt: Now, whatever is in the intermediate space, he obtains all that through the upadrava.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad asyāṃ diśi yā devatā ye manuṣyā ye paśavo yad annādyaṃ tat sarvaṃ nidhanenāpnoti |
meaning: अथ यद् अस्यां दिशि या देवता ये मनुष्या ये पशवो यद् अन्नाद्यं तत् सर्वं निधनेनाप्नोति ।
text: And what there is in this quarter, what divinities, what men, what domestic animals, what food, all that he obtains by means of the nidhana.
text_mt: Now, whatever deity, whatever men, whatever cattle, whatever edible food is in this [lower] direction, he obtains all that through the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ haivāsyāptam bhavati sarvaṃ jitaṃ na hāsya kaś cana kāmo 'nāpto bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: सर्वं हैवास्याप्तम् भवति सर्वं जितं न हास्य कश् चन कामो ऽनाप्तो भवति य एवं वेद ।
text: Verily everything is obtained of him, everything conquered, no wish whatever is unfulfilled of him who knows thus.
text_mt: All indeed is obtained by him, all is won; no desire of his is unobtained, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: sa yad dha kiṃ ca kiṃ caivaṃ vidvān eṣu lokeṣu kurute svasya haiva tat svataḥ kurute tad etad ṛcābhyanūcyate | daśame 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स यद् ध किं च किं चैवं विद्वान् एषु लोकेषु कुरुते स्वस्य हैव तत् स्वतः कुरुते तद् एतद् ऋचाभ्यनूच्यते । दशमे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: Whatever one knowing thus does in these worlds, that is his, he does it by himself. That same is referred to by a re:
text_mt:
Whatever one who knows thus does in these worlds, he does it indeed from what is his own.
Regarding this it is stated in a verse:
First khaṇḍa in the tenth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: yad dyāva indra te śataṃ śatam bhūmīr uta syuḥ na tvā vajrint sahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātam aṣṭa rodasī iti |
meaning: यद् द्याव इन्द्र ते शतं शतम् भूमीर् उत स्युः न त्वा वज्रिन्त् सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातम् अष्ट रोदसी इति ।
text: "If, O Indra, there were a hundred skies and a hundred earths for thee, not a thousand suns, O thou possessing the thunderbolt, unto thee when born, attained, nor Rodasi."
text_mt: "If there were a hundred heavens for you, O Indra, and a hundred earths, / Not a thousand suns, O wielder of the thunderbolt, nor both worlds, could attain to you when born." [ṚV 8.70.5]

sanskrit_iast: yad dyāva indra te śataṃ śatam bhūmīr uta syur iti yac chataṃ dyāvas syuś śatam bhūmyas tābhya eṣa evākāśo jyāyān |
meaning: यद् द्याव इन्द्र ते शतं शतम् भूमीर् उत स्युर् इति यच् छतं द्यावस् स्युश् शतम् भूम्यस् ताभ्य एष एवाकाशो ज्यायान् ।
text: ' If, O Indra, there were a hundred skies and a hundred earths for thee,' what hundred skies there might be and hundred earths, this space is superior to them.
text_mt:
"If there were a hundred heavens for you, O Indra, and a hundred earths":
Even if there were a hundred heavens and a hundred earths, this space is greater than them.

sanskrit_iast: na tvā vajrint sahasraṃ sūryā anv iti na hy etaṃ sahasraṃ cana sūryā anu |
meaning: न त्वा वज्रिन्त् सहस्रं सूर्या अन्व् इति न ह्य् एतं सहस्रं चन सूर्या अनु ।
text: ' Not a thousand suns, O thou possessing the thunderbolt, unto thee,' for not at all [do] a thousand suns [attain] unto him.
text_mt:
"Not a thousand suns, O wielder of the thunderbolt, could attain to you":
For not even a thousand suns can attain to this one.

sanskrit_iast: na jātam aṣṭa rodasī iti na hy etaṃ jātaṃ rodanti ime ha vāva rodasī tābhyām eṣa evākāśo jyāyān etasmin hy evaite antaḥ |
meaning: न जातम् अष्ट रोदसी इति न ह्य् एतं जातं रोदन्ति इमे ह वाव रोदसी ताभ्याम् एष एवाकाशो ज्यायान् एतस्मिन् ह्य् एवैते अन्तः ।
text: 'When born attained, nor Rodasl,' for they do not bewail (y'r««/) him when born. Verily as to these two worlds {rodasl), this space is superior to them both. For both are within it.
text_mt:
"Nor both worlds could attain to him when born":
For they do not encompass him when born.
These two indeed are the two worlds (heaven and earth); greater than them is this space,
for these two are within it.

sanskrit_iast: sa yas sa ākāśa indra eva saḥ sa yas sa indra eṣa eva sa ya eṣa tapati |
meaning: स यस् स आकाश इन्द्र एव सः स यस् स इन्द्र एष एव स य एष तपति ।
text: What this space is, that is Indra; what this Indra is, that is he who burns here.
text_mt:
Now that which is space is Indra;
that which is Indra is this one who burns here [the sun].

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣo 'bhrāṇy atimucyamāna eti tad yathaiṣo 'bhrāṇy atimucyamāna ety evam eva sa sarvasmāt pāpmano 'timucyamāna eti ya evaṃ vedātho yasyaivaṃ vidvān udgāyati | daśame 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ daśamo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: स एषो ऽभ्राण्य् अतिमुच्यमान एति तद् यथैषो ऽभ्राण्य् अतिमुच्यमान एत्य् एवम् एव स सर्वस्मात् पाप्मनो ऽतिमुच्यमान एति य एवं वेदाथो यस्यैवं विद्वान् उद्गायति । दशमे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः दशमो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: He keeps liberating himself from the clouds. As he keeps liberating himself from the clouds, even so does he keep liberating himself from all evil who knows thus, and he for whom one knowing thus sings the udgītha.
text_mt:
He moves freeing himself from the clouds.
Just as he moves freeing himself from the clouds, so indeed does he move freeing himself from all evil who knows thus, and also he for whom one who knows thus sings the udgītha.
Second khaṇḍa in the tenth anuvāka.
The tenth anuvāka is complete.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛt sāma catuṣpāt brahma tṛtīyam indras tṛtīyam prajāpatis tṛtīyam annam eva caturthaḥ pādaḥ |
meaning: त्रिवृत् साम चतुष्पात् ब्रह्म तृतीयम् इन्द्रस् तृतीयम् प्रजापतिस् तृतीयम् अन्नम् एव चतुर्थः पादः ।
text: Threefold is the sāman, fourfooted. The brahman is a third, Indra is a third, Pi-ajapati is a third, food is the fourth foot (quarter).
text_mt:
The sāman is threefold and four-footed:
brahman is one third, Indra is one third, Prajāpati is one third; and food is the fourth foot.

sanskrit_iast: tad yad vai brahma sa prāṇo 'tha ya indras sā vāg atha yaḥ prajāpatis tan mano 'nnam eva caturthaḥ pādaḥ |
meaning: तद् यद् वै ब्रह्म स प्राणो ऽथ य इन्द्रस् सा वाग् अथ यः प्रजापतिस् तन् मनो ऽन्नम् एव चतुर्थः पादः ।
text: What the brahman is, that is breath; and what Indra is, that is speech; and what Prajapati is, that is mind; food is the fourth foot (quarter),
text_mt: Now that which is brahman is breath; then that which is Indra is speech; then that which is Prajāpati is mind; and food is the fourth foot.

sanskrit_iast: mana eva hiṅkāro vāk prastāvaḥ prāṇa udgītho 'nnam eva caturthaḥ pādaḥ |
meaning: मन एव हिङ्कारो वाक् प्रस्तावः प्राण उद्गीथो ऽन्नम् एव चतुर्थः पादः ।
text: Mind is the hinkdra, speech is the prastāva, breath is the udgītha, food is the fourth foot (quarter).
text_mt: Mind is the hiṅkāra, speech is the prastāva, breath is the udgītha, and food is the fourth foot.

sanskrit_iast: karoty eva vācā nayati prāṇena gamayati manasā tad etan niruddhaṃ yan manaḥ tena yatra kāmayate tad ātmānaṃ ca yajamānaṃ ca dadhāti |
meaning: करोत्य् एव वाचा नयति प्राणेन गमयति मनसा तद् एतन् निरुद्धं यन् मनः तेन यत्र कामयते तद् आत्मानं च यजमानं च दधाति ।
text: One acts with speech, one leads with breath, one' causes to go with the mind. That same is shut up, viz. the mind. By means of it he thus places himself and the sacrificer where he wishes.

sanskrit_iast: athādhidaivatam candramā eva hiṅkāro 'gniḥ prastāva āditya udgītha āpa eva caturthaḥ pādaḥ tad dhi pratyakṣam annam |
meaning: अथाधिदैवतम् चन्द्रमा एव हिङ्कारो ऽग्निः प्रस्ताव आदित्य उद्गीथ आप एव चतुर्थः पादः तद् धि प्रत्यक्षम् अन्नम् ।
text: Now regarding the divinities. The moon is the hinkdra, Agni is the prastāva, the sun is the udgītha, the waters are the fourth foot (quarter). For they are manifestly food.
text_mt:
Now pertaining to the deities:
The Moon is the hiṅkāra, Agni is the prastāva, Āditya is the udgītha, the waters are the fourth foot,
for that is food visibly.

sanskrit_iast: tā vā etā devatā amāvāsyāṃ rātriṃ saṃyanti candramā amāvāsyāṃ rātrim ādityam praviśaty ādityo 'gnim |
meaning: ता वा एता देवता अमावास्यां रात्रिं संयन्ति चन्द्रमा अमावास्यां रात्रिम् आदित्यम् प्रविशत्य् आदित्यो ऽग्निम् ।
text: These same divinities come together on the night of the new moon. The moon, on the night of the new moon, enters the sun, the sun [enters] Agni.
text_mt:
These deities unite on the night of the new moon;
on the night of the new moon the Moon enters Āditya, and Āditya enters Agni.

sanskrit_iast: tad yat saṃyanti tasmāt sāma sa ha vai sāmavit sa sāma veda ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: तद् यत् संयन्ति तस्मात् साम स ह वै सामवित् स साम वेद य एवं वेद ।
text: Because they come together (,^/i + sam), hence [the word] sāman. He is s«maw-knowing, he knows the sāman, who knows thus.
text_mt:
Because they unite (saṃyanti), therefore it is a sāman.
He is indeed a knower of the sāman, he knows the sāman, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: tāsāṃ vā etāsāṃ devatānām ekaikaiva devatā sāma bhavati |
meaning: तासां वा एतासां देवतानाम् एकैकैव देवता साम भवति ।
text: Of these same divinities each one divinity is a sāman.
text_mt: Of these deities, each single deity becomes the sāman.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa evādityas trivṛc catuṣpād raśmayo maṇḍalam puruṣaḥ raśmaya eva hiṅkāraḥ tasmāt te prathamata evodyatas tāyante maṇḍalam prastāvaḥ puruṣa udgītho yā etā āpo 'ntas sa eva caturthaḥ pādaḥ |
meaning: एष एवादित्यस् त्रिवृच् चतुष्पाद् रश्मयो मण्डलम् पुरुषः रश्मय एव हिङ्कारः तस्मात् ते प्रथमत एवोद्यतस् तायन्ते मण्डलम् प्रस्तावः पुरुष उद्गीथो या एता आपो ऽन्तस् स एव चतुर्थः पादः ।
text: This sun is threefold, fourfooted: rays, disk, person. The rays are the hinkdra. Therefore they are extended when it first rises. The disk is the ^Śrastdva. The person is the udgītha. The waters within are the fourth foot (quarter). )o. Likewise of the moon [there are] rays, disk, person. The rays are the hinkdra. The disk is the prastāva. The person is the udgītha. The waters within are the fourth foot (quarter),
text_mt:
This Āditya is threefold and four-footed: the rays, the disk, the person.
The rays are the hiṅkāra;
therefore they spread out first when he rises.
The disk is the prastāva; the person is the udgītha; and those waters that are within are the fourth foot.

sanskrit_iast: evam eva candramaso raśmayo maṇḍalam puruṣaḥ raśmaya eva hiṅkāro maṇḍalam prastāvaḥ puruṣa udgītho yā etā āpo 'ntas sa eva caturthaḥ pādaḥ |
meaning: एवम् एव चन्द्रमसो रश्मयो मण्डलम् पुरुषः रश्मय एव हिङ्कारो मण्डलम् प्रस्तावः पुरुष उद्गीथो या एता आपो ऽन्तस् स एव चतुर्थः पादः ।
text: Four are the one, four the others. =1. 1. 8.
text_mt:
In the same way, of the Moon: the rays, the disk, the person.
The rays are the hiṅkāra, the disk is the prastāva, the person is the udgītha, and those waters that are within are the fourth foot.

sanskrit_iast: catvāry anyāni catvāry anyāni tāny aṣṭau aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī gāyatraṃ sāma brahma u gāyatrī tad u brahmābhisampadyate aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavas teno paśavyam | ekādaśe 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: चत्वार्य् अन्यानि चत्वार्य् अन्यानि तान्य् अष्टौ अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री गायत्रं साम ब्रह्म उ गायत्री तद् उ ब्रह्माभिसम्पद्यते अष्टाशफाः पशवस् तेनो पशव्यम् । एकादशे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।

sanskrit_iast: athādhyātmam idam eva cakṣus trivṛc catuṣpāc chuklaṃ kṛṣṇam puruṣaḥ śuklam eva hiṅkāraḥ kṛṣṇam prastāvaḥ puruṣa udgītho yā imā āpo 'ntas sa eva caturthaḥ pādaḥ |
meaning: अथाध्यात्मम् इदम् एव चक्षुस् त्रिवृच् चतुष्पाच् छुक्लं कृष्णम् पुरुषः शुक्लम् एव हिङ्कारः कृष्णम् प्रस्तावः पुरुष उद्गीथो या इमा आपो ऽन्तस् स एव चतुर्थः पादः ।
text: Now with regard to the self. This eye is threefold, fourfooted: white, black, person. The white is» the hinkdra, the black is the prastāva, the person is the udgītha, the waters within are the fourth foot (quarter).
text_mt:
Now pertaining to the self:
This eye is threefold and four-footed: the white, the dark, the person.
The white is the hiṅkāra, the dark is the prastāva, the person is the udgītha, and these waters that are within are the fourth foot.

sanskrit_iast: idam ādityasyāyanam idaṃ candramasaḥ catvārīmāni catvārīmāni tāny aṣṭau aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī gāyatraṃ sāma brahma u gāyatrī tad u brahmābhisampadyate aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavas teno paśavyam |
meaning: इदम् आदित्यस्यायनम् इदं चन्द्रमसः चत्वारीमानि चत्वारीमानि तान्य् अष्टौ अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री गायत्रं साम ब्रह्म उ गायत्री तद् उ ब्रह्माभिसम्पद्यते अष्टाशफाः पशवस् तेनो पशव्यम् ।
text: This is the course of the sun, this [the course] of the moon. Four are these, four these. = I. 1. 8.

sanskrit_iast: sa yo 'yam pavate sa eṣa eva prajāpatiḥ tad v eva sāma tasyāyaṃ devo yo 'yaṃ cakṣuṣi puruṣaḥ sa eṣa āhutim atimatyotkrāntaḥ |
meaning: स यो ऽयम् पवते स एष एव प्रजापतिः तद् व् एव साम तस्यायं देवो यो ऽयं चक्षुषि पुरुषः स एष आहुतिम् अतिमत्योत्क्रान्तः ।
text: He who cleanses here, that same one is Prajilpati. That is also the sāman. Its god is this person in the eye. That same, contemning the oiforing, [has] gone up (?).
text_mt:
Now he who purifies here [the wind], he is Prajāpati;
and that indeed is the sāman.
His god is this person who is in the eye.
He has gone beyond, having disregarded the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāv etau candramāś cādityaś ca yāv etāv apsu dṛśyete etāv etayor devau |
meaning: अथ याव् एतौ चन्द्रमाश् चादित्यश् च याव् एताव् अप्सु दृश्येते एताव् एतयोर् देवौ ।
text: And these two, moon and sun, which are seen here in the waters, these two are the gods of these two.
text_mt: Now these two, the Moon and Āditya, who are seen in the waters, these two are the gods of these two.

sanskrit_iast: yad dha vā idam āhur devānāṃ devā ity ete ha te ta eta āhutim atimatyotkrāntāḥ |
meaning: यद् ध वा इदम् आहुर् देवानां देवा इत्य् एते ह ते त एत आहुतिम् अतिमत्योत्क्रान्ताः ।
text: Truly when they say " the gods of the gods," it is these [that they mean]. These same, contemning the offering, [have] gone up (?).
text_mt:
When they say, "the gods of the gods," these are they.
They have gone beyond, having disregarded the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: tad dha pṛthur vainyo divyān vrātyān papraccha yebhir vāta iṣitaḥ pravāti ye dadante pañca diśas samīcīḥ ya āhutīr atyamanyanta devā apāṃ netāraḥ katame ta āsann iti |
meaning: तद् ध पृथुर् वैन्यो दिव्यान् व्रात्यान् पप्रच्छ येभिर् वात इषितः प्रवाति ये ददन्ते पञ्च दिशस् समीचीः य आहुतीर् अत्यमन्यन्त देवा अपां नेतारः कतमे त आसन्न् इति ।
text: Now Prthu Vainya asked the divine mendicants thus: " The gods by whom, impelled the wind blows forth, who give the five converging quarters, who contemned the offerings, the leaders of the waters —which are they?"
text_mt:
Regarding that, Pṛthu Vainya asked the divine vrātyas:
"By whom the wind, impelled, blows forth, they who maintain the five united directions, / the gods who disregarded the oblations, the leaders of the waters—which ones were they?"

sanskrit_iast: te ha pratyūcur imām eṣām pṛthivīṃ vasta eko 'ntarikṣam pary eko babhūva divam eko dadate yo vidhartā viśvā āśāḥ pratirakṣanty anya iti |
meaning: ते ह प्रत्यूचुर् इमाम् एषाम् पृथिवीं वस्त एको ऽन्तरिक्षम् पर्य् एको बभूव दिवम् एको ददते यो विधर्ता विश्वा आशाः प्रतिरक्षन्त्य् अन्य इति ।
text: They answered: " One of them dons this earth here, one hath encompassed the atmosphere, one, who is the disposer, gives the sky, others severally protect all regions."
text_mt:
They replied:
"One of them clothes this earth, one encompasses the intermediate space, / one maintains heaven, who is the upholder, others protect all quarters."

sanskrit_iast: imām eṣām pṛthivīṃ vasta eka ity agnir ha saḥ |
meaning: इमाम् एषाम् पृथिवीं वस्त एक इत्य् अग्निर् ह सः ।
text: ' One dons this earth here,' that is Agni.
text_mt: "One clothes this earth": that is Agni.

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣam pary eko babhūveti vāyur ha saḥ |
meaning: अन्तरिक्षम् पर्य् एको बभूवेति वायुर् ह सः ।
text: ' One hath encompassed the atmosphere,' that is Vayu.
text_mt: "One encompasses the intermediate space": that is Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast: divam eko dadate yo vidhartety ādityo ha saḥ |
meaning: दिवम् एको ददते यो विधर्तेत्य् आदित्यो ह सः ।
text: 'One, who is the disposer, gives the sky,' that is the sun.
text_mt: "One maintains heaven, who is the upholder": that is Āditya.

sanskrit_iast: viśvā āśāḥ pratirakṣanty anya iti etā ha vai devatā viśvā āśāḥ pratirakṣanti candramā nakṣatrāṇīti tā etās sāmaiva satyo vyūḍho annādyāya | ekādaśe 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ekādaśo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: विश्वा आशाः प्रतिरक्षन्त्य् अन्य इति एता ह वै देवता विश्वा आशाः प्रतिरक्षन्ति चन्द्रमा नक्षत्राणीति ता एतास् सामैव सत्यो व्यूढो अन्नाद्याय । एकादशे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः एकादशो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: 'Others severally protect all regions,' these divinities indeed severally protect all regions, viz. -moon and asterisras. These are true, extended kindness (?) for food-eating.
text_mt:
"Others protect all quarters":
these deities protect all quarters: the Moon and the constellations.
These, being the sāman, are distributed for the sake of food.
Second khaṇḍa in the eleventh anuvāka.
The eleventh anuvāka is complete.

sanskrit_iast: athaitat sāma tad āhus saṃvatsara eva sāmeti |
meaning: अथैतत् साम तद् आहुस् संवत्सर एव सामेति ।
text: Now this is the sāman. This they say: The sāman is in the year.
text_mt:
Now this sāman:
Regarding it, they say: "The sāman is the year."

sanskrit_iast: tasya vasanta eva hiṅkāraḥ tasmāt paśavo vasantā hiṅkarikratas samudāyanti |
meaning: तस्य वसन्त एव हिङ्कारः तस्मात् पशवो वसन्ता हिङ्करिक्रतस् समुदायन्ति ।
text: Of it spring is the hinkdra. Therefore animals come together in the spring, continually uttering him.
text_mt:
Spring is its hiṅkāra;
therefore cattle go around together in spring, making the sound hiṃ.

sanskrit_iast: grīṣmaḥ prastāvaḥ anirukto vai prastāvo 'nirukta ṛtūnāṃ grīṣmaḥ |
meaning: ग्रीष्मः प्रस्तावः अनिरुक्तो वै प्रस्तावो ऽनिरुक्त ऋतूनां ग्रीष्मः ।
text: The summer is the prastāva. The prastāva is indistinct; the summer is indistinct among the seasons.
text_mt:
Summer is the prastāva;
the prastāva is unexpressed, and summer is the unexpressed among the seasons.

sanskrit_iast: varṣā udgīthaḥ ud iva vai varṣaṃ gāyati |
meaning: वर्षा उद्गीथः उद् इव वै वर्षं गायति ।
text: The rainy season {varsdh) is the udgitha. One sings the udgitha through the year (varsd), as it were.
text_mt:
The rains are the udgītha;
for rain sings aloud, as it were.

sanskrit_iast: śarat pratihāraḥ śaradi ha khalu vai bhūyiṣṭhā oṣadhayaḥ pacyante |
meaning: शरत् प्रतिहारः शरदि ह खलु वै भूयिष्ठा ओषधयः पच्यन्ते ।
text: The autumn is the pratihāra. Verily in the autumn most herbs ripen.
text_mt:
Autumn is the pratihāra;
for in autumn most herbs ripen.

sanskrit_iast: hemanto nidhanam nidhanakṛtā iva vai heman prajā bhavanti |
meaning: हेमन्तो निधनम् निधनकृता इव वै हेमन् प्रजा भवन्ति ।
text: The winter is the nidhana. In the winter creatures are put to an end {nidhannkrta), as it were.
text_mt:
Winter is the nidhana;
for in winter creatures are, as it were, brought to an end.

sanskrit_iast: tāv etāv antau saṃdhattaḥ etad anv anantas saṃvatsaraḥ tasyaitāv antau yad dhemantaś ca vasantaś ca etad anu grāmasyāntau sametaḥ etad anu niṣkasyāntau sametaḥ etad anv ahir bhogān paryāhṛtya śaye |
meaning: ताव् एताव् अन्तौ संधत्तः एतद् अन्व् अनन्तस् संवत्सरः तस्यैताव् अन्तौ यद् धेमन्तश् च वसन्तश् च एतद् अनु ग्रामस्यान्तौ समेतः एतद् अनु निष्कस्यान्तौ समेतः एतद् अन्व् अहिर् भोगान् पर्याहृत्य शये ।
text: These two ends combine together; consequently the year is endless. Its two ends are winter and spring. In accordance with this the two ends of a village join together. In accordance with this the two ends of a necklace join together. In accordance with this a snake lies taking its coils about it.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā ha vai niṣkas samantaṃ grīvā abhiparyakta evam anantaṃ sāma sa ya evam etad anantaṃ sāma vedānantatām eva jayati | dvādaśe 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तद् यथा ह वै निष्कस् समन्तं ग्रीवा अभिपर्यक्त एवम् अनन्तं साम स य एवम् एतद् अनन्तं साम वेदानन्तताम् एव जयति । द्वादशे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: Truly, as a necklace bent all around the neck, so is the endless sāman. He who knows this endless sāman thus conquers endlessness.
text_mt:
Just as a necklace encircles the neck on all sides, in the same way the sāman is endless.
He who knows thus this endless sāman conquers endlessness.
First khaṇḍa in the twelfth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: athaitat parjanye sāma tasya purovāta eva hiṅkāraḥ atha yad abhrāṇi samplāvayati sa prastāvaḥ atha yat stanayati sa udgīthaḥ atha yad vidyotate sa pratihāraḥ atha yad varṣati tan nidhanam |
meaning: अथैतत् पर्जन्ये साम तस्य पुरोवात एव हिङ्कारः अथ यद् अभ्राणि सम्प्लावयति स प्रस्तावः अथ यत् स्तनयति स उद्गीथः अथ यद् विद्योतते स प्रतिहारः अथ यद् वर्षति तन् निधनम् ।
text: Now this is the sāman in Parjanya. The wind which precedes is its hinkdra; when it causes the clouds to float together, that is X\\V: prastāva; when it thunders, that is the udgītha; when it lightens, that is the pratihāra; when it rains, that is the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: tad etat parjanye sāma sa ya evam etat parjanye sāma veda varṣuko hāsmai parjanyo bhavati |
meaning: तद् एतत् पर्जन्ये साम स य एवम् एतत् पर्जन्ये साम वेद वर्षुको हास्मै पर्जन्यो भवति ।
text: That is the sāman in Parjanya. He who thus knows the sāman in Parjanya, truly to him Parjanya sends rain.
text_mt:
That is this sāman in Parjanya.
He who knows thus this sāman in Parjanya, Parjanya becomes prone to rain for him.

sanskrit_iast: athaitat puruṣe sāma tasyāyam eva hiṅkāro 'yam prastāvo 'yam udgītho 'yam pratihāra idaṃ nidhanam |
meaning: अथैतत् पुरुषे साम तस्यायम् एव हिङ्कारो ऽयम् प्रस्तावो ऽयम् उद्गीथो ऽयम् प्रतिहार इदं निधनम् ।
text: Now this is the sāman'\w man. Of it this is the hinkdra, this the prastuva, this the udgītha, this the x>ratihdra, this the nidhana.
text_mt:
Now this sāman in man:
This is its hiṅkāra, this is the prastāva, this is the udgītha, this is the pratihāra, this is the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: tad etat puruṣe sāma sa ya evam etat puruṣe sāma vedordhva eva prajayā paśubhir ārohann eti |
meaning: तद् एतत् पुरुषे साम स य एवम् एतत् पुरुषे साम वेदोर्ध्व एव प्रजया पशुभिर् आरोहन्न् एति ।
text: That is the sāman \\\ man. He who thus knows the sāman in man, he keeps ascending upward by progeny and by cattle,
text_mt: This is the sāman in the person. He who knows this sāman in the person thus goes on ascending upward indeed with offspring and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ya u enat pratyag veda ye pratyañco lokās tāñ jayati tasyāyam eva hiṅkāro 'yam prastāvo 'yam udgītho 'yam pratihāra idaṃ nidhanam ye pratyañco lokās tāñ jayati |
meaning: य उ एनत् प्रत्यग् वेद ये प्रत्यञ्चो लोकास् ताञ् जयति तस्यायम् एव हिङ्कारो ऽयम् प्रस्तावो ऽयम् उद्गीथो ऽयम् प्रतिहार इदं निधनम् ये प्रत्यञ्चो लोकास् ताञ् जयति ।
text: And he who knows it in reversed' direction conquers those worlds which are reversed. Of it this is the hinkdra, this the prastāva, this the udgītha, this the pratihāra, this the nidhana. The worlds which are reversed, those he conquers.
text_mt: And whoever knows it backward wins whatever worlds are backward. Of this [sāman], this [breath] is the hiṅkāra, this is the prastāva, this is the udgītha, this is the pratihāra, this is the nidhana. Whatever worlds are backward, he wins them.

sanskrit_iast: ya u enat tiryag veda ye tiryañco lokās tāñ jayati tasya lomaiva hiṅkāras tvak prastāvo māṃsam udgītho 'sthi pratihāro majjā nidhanam |
meaning: य उ एनत् तिर्यग् वेद ये तिर्यञ्चो लोकास् ताञ् जयति तस्य लोमैव हिङ्कारस् त्वक् प्रस्तावो मांसम् उद्गीथो ऽस्थि प्रतिहारो मज्जा निधनम् ।
text: And he who knows it crosswise conquers those worlds which are crosswise. Of it the hair of the head is the hinkdra, the skin the prastāva, the flesh the udgītha, the bone the pratihāra, the marrow the nidhana.
text_mt: And whoever knows it transverse wins whatever worlds are transverse. Its hair is the hiṅkāra, skin the prastāva, flesh the udgītha, bone the pratihāra, marrow the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: tasya trīṇy āvir gāyati prastāvam pratihāraṃ nidhanam tasmāt puruṣasya trīṇy asthīny āvir dantāś ca dvayāś ca nakhāḥ ye tiryañco lokās tāñ jayati |
meaning: तस्य त्रीण्य् आविर् गायति प्रस्तावम् प्रतिहारं निधनम् तस्मात् पुरुषस्य त्रीण्य् अस्थीन्य् आविर् दन्ताश् च द्वयाश् च नखाः ये तिर्यञ्चो लोकास् ताञ् जयति ।
text: Of it he sings three openly, viz. the prastāva, the pratihāra, the nidhana. Therefore three bones of man lie open, viz. the teeth and the two kinds of nails. The worlds wiiich are crosswise, those he conquers,
text_mt: Of it, he sings three [parts] openly: the prastāva, the pratihāra, the nidhana. Therefore three bones of a person are open: the teeth and both sets of nails. Whatever worlds are transverse, he wins them.

sanskrit_iast: ya u enat samyag veda ye samyañco lokās tāñ jayati tasya mana eva hiṅkāro vāk prastāvaḥ prāṇa udgīthaś cakṣuḥ pratihāraś śrotraṃ nidhanam ye samyañco lokās tāñ jayati |
meaning: य उ एनत् सम्यग् वेद ये सम्यञ्चो लोकास् ताञ् जयति तस्य मन एव हिङ्कारो वाक् प्रस्तावः प्राण उद्गीथश् चक्षुः प्रतिहारश् श्रोत्रं निधनम् ये सम्यञ्चो लोकास् ताञ् जयति ।
text: And he who knows it converging conquers those worlds which are converging. Of it mind is the hinkdra, speech the prastāva, breath the udgītha, sight the pratihāra, hearing the nidhana. The worlds which are converging, those he conquers,
text_mt: And whoever knows it forward wins whatever worlds are forward. Its mind is the hiṅkāra, speech the prastāva, breath the udgītha, eye the pratihāra, ear the nidhana. Whatever worlds are forward, he wins them.

sanskrit_iast: athaitad devatāsu sāma tasya vāyur eva hiṅkāro 'gniḥ prastāva āditya udgīthaś candramā pratihāro diśa eva nidhanam |
meaning: अथैतद् देवतासु साम तस्य वायुर् एव हिङ्कारो ऽग्निः प्रस्ताव आदित्य उद्गीथश् चन्द्रमा प्रतिहारो दिश एव निधनम् ।
text: And this is the sāman in the divinities. Of it Vayu is the hinkdra, Agni the prastāva, the sun the udgītha, the moon the pratihāra, the quarters the nidhana.
text_mt: Now this sāman among the deities: Vāyu is its hiṅkāra, Agni the prastāva, Āditya the udgītha, the Moon the pratihāra, the quarters the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad devatāsu sāma sa ya evam etad devatāsu sāma veda devatānām eva salokatāṃ jayati | dvādaśe 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तद् एतद् देवतासु साम स य एवम् एतद् देवतासु साम वेद देवतानाम् एव सलोकतां जयति । द्वादशे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: That is the sāman in the divinities. He who knows thus this sāman in the divinities, he conquers a share in the same world with the divinities.
text_mt: This is that sāman among the deities. He who knows this sāman thus among the deities wins sharing the same world with the deities. // Second khaṇḍa in the twelfth anuvāka

sanskrit_iast: tasyaitās tisra āgā āgneyy ekaindry ekā vaiśvadevy ekā |
meaning: तस्यैतास् तिस्र आगा आग्नेय्य् एकैन्द्र्य् एका वैश्वदेव्य् एका ।
text: Of it there are these three dgds: one belonging to Agni, one belonging to Indra, one belonging to all the gods.
text_mt: It has these three musical tones: one pertaining to Agni, one pertaining to Indra, one pertaining to the All-gods.

sanskrit_iast: sā yā mandrā sāgneyī tayā prātassavanasyodgeyam āgneyaṃ vai prātassavanam āgneyo 'yaṃ lokaḥ svayāgayā prātassavanasyodgāyaty ṛdhnotīmaṃ lokam |
meaning: सा या मन्द्रा साग्नेयी तया प्रातस्सवनस्योद्गेयम् आग्नेयं वै प्रातस्सवनम् आग्नेयो ऽयं लोकः स्वयागया प्रातस्सवनस्योद्गायत्य् ऋध्नोतीमं लोकम् ।
text: That which is low, that belongs to Agni. With it the udgītha of the morning-libation should be sung. Verily the morninglibation belongs to Agni, this world belongs to Agni. He [then] sings the udgītha of the morning-libation with his (Agni's) own dgd, he enjoys this world,
text_mt: That which is low is pertaining to Agni; with it one should chant the morning pressing. The morning pressing belongs to Agni, and this world belongs to Agni. With its own tone one chants the udgītha of the morning pressing, and prospers in this world.

sanskrit_iast: atha yā ghoṣiṇy upabdimatī saindrī tayā mādhyandinasya savanasyodgeyam aindraṃ vai mādhyandinaṃ savanam aindro 'sau lokaḥ svayāgayā mādhyandinasya savanasyodgāyaty ṛdhnoty amuṃ lokam |
meaning: अथ या घोषिण्य् उपब्दिमती सैन्द्री तया माध्यन्दिनस्य सवनस्योद्गेयम् ऐन्द्रं वै माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् ऐन्द्रो ऽसौ लोकः स्वयागया माध्यन्दिनस्य सवनस्योद्गायत्य् ऋध्नोत्य् अमुं लोकम् ।
text: And that which is loud [and] noisy, that belongs to Indra. With it the udgītha of the noonlibation should be sung. Verily the noon-libation belongs to Indra, yonder world belongs to Indra. He [then] sings the udgītha of the noon-libation with his (Indra's) own dgd, he enjoys yonder world.
text_mt: Now that which is loud and resonant is pertaining to Indra; with it one should chant the midday pressing. The midday pressing belongs to Indra, and that world belongs to Indra. With its own tone one chants the udgītha of the midday pressing, and prospers in that world.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāṃ vīṅkhayann iva prathayann iva gāyati sā vaiśvadevī tayā tṛtīyasavanasyodgeyam vaiśvadevaṃ vai tṛtīyasavanaṃ vaiśvadevo 'yam antarālokaḥ svayāgayā tṛtīyasavanasyodgāyaty ṛdhnotīmam antarālokam |
meaning: अथ यां वीङ्खयन्न् इव प्रथयन्न् इव गायति सा वैश्वदेवी तया तृतीयसवनस्योद्गेयम् वैश्वदेवं वै तृतीयसवनं वैश्वदेवो ऽयम् अन्तरालोकः स्वयागया तृतीयसवनस्योद्गायत्य् ऋध्नोतीमम् अन्तरालोकम् ।
text: And [the dgd] which he sings shaking, as it were (tremolo), spreading it, as it were, that belongs to all the gods. With it the udgītha of the evening-libation should be sung. Verily the evening-libation belongs to all the gods, this intermediate world belongs to all the gods. He [then] sings the udgītha of the evening-libation with their own dgd., he enjoys this intermediate world.
text_mt: Now that which one sings as if swinging, as if spreading out, is pertaining to the All-gods; with it one should chant the third pressing. The third pressing belongs to the All-gods, and this intermediate world belongs to the All-gods. With its own tone one chants the udgītha of the third pressing, and prospers in this intermediate world.

sanskrit_iast: atho uccā khalv āhur ekayaivāgayodgeyaṃ yad evāsya madhyaṃ vāca iti tad yayā vai vācā vyāyacchamāna udgāyati tad evāsya madhyaṃ vācaḥ tayā vā etayā vācā sarvā vāca upagacchati avyāsiktām ekasthāṃ śriyam ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: अथो उच्चा खल्व् आहुर् एकयैवागयोद्गेयं यद् एवास्य मध्यं वाच इति तद् यया वै वाचा व्यायच्छमान उद्गायति तद् एवास्य मध्यं वाचः तया वा एतया वाचा सर्वा वाच उपगच्छति अव्यासिक्ताम् एकस्थां श्रियम् ऋध्नोति य एवं वेद ।
text_mt: Now indeed, they also say: 'One should chant the udgītha with only one tone, which is the middle of one's speech.' For the speech with which one chants the udgītha without straining is the middle of one's speech. Indeed, with this speech he reaches all speeches; he who knows thus prospers in undivided, unified prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: atha yā krauñcā sā bārhaspatyā sa yo brahmavarcasakāmas syāt sa tayodgāyet tad brahma vai bṛhaspatiḥ tad vai brahmavarcasam ṛdhnoti tathā ha brahmavarcasī bhavati |
meaning: अथ या क्रौञ्चा सा बार्हस्पत्या स यो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस् स्यात् स तयोद्गायेत् तद् ब्रह्म वै बृहस्पतिः तद् वै ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ऋध्नोति तथा ह ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति ।
text: Now above (?) they say: " The udgītha should be sung with one dgd only, viz. [with that] which is the middle (mean) of his voice." The voice with which he sings the udgītha expanding it apart, that is the middle (mean) of his voice, Śj means of this same voice he attains unto all voices. He who knows thus enjoys fortune not poured out in different directions [but] closely united, e. And that which is plover-like belongs to Brhaspati. He who may be desirous of prominence in sacred lore should sing the udgītha with it. Verily this brahman is Brhaspati. He'thus enjoys prominence in sacred lore. He thus becomes prominent in sacred lore.
text_mt: Now that which is the heron tone belongs to Bṛhaspati. If one should desire spiritual radiance, he should chant the udgītha with it. For Bṛhaspati is brahman; thus he prospers in spiritual radiance, and so he becomes full of spiritual radiance.

sanskrit_iast: atha ha caikitāneya ekasyaiva sāmna āgāṃ gāyati gāyatrasyaiva tad anavānaṃ geyam tat sāmna evā pratihārād anavānaṃ geyam tat prāṇo vai gāyatram tad vai prāṇam ṛdhnoti tathā ha sarvam āyur eti | dvādaśe 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: अथ ह चैकितानेय एकस्यैव साम्न आगां गायति गायत्रस्यैव तद् अनवानं गेयम् तत् साम्न एवा प्रतिहाराद् अनवानं गेयम् तत् प्राणो वै गायत्रम् तद् वै प्राणम् ऋध्नोति तथा ह सर्वम् आयुर् एति । द्वादशे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: Now Caikitaneya sings the dgd of one sāman only, viz. of the gdyatral-sdmanl. That should be sung without taking breath. That [part] of the sāman unto the pratihāra should be sung without taking breath. Thus breath is the gāyatra\-sāman\ Verily he thus enjoys breath. He thus attains complete life.
text_mt: Now Caikitāneya sings the tone of only one sāman, of the gāyatra alone. It is to be sung without pausing for breath; from the sāman up to the pratihāra it is to be sung without pausing for breath. For the gāyatra is breath; thus he prospers in breath, and so he attains a full lifespan. // Second [recte third] khaṇḍa in the twelfth anuvāka

sanskrit_iast: atha ha brahmadattaṃ caikitāneyam udgāyantaṃ kurava upodur ujjahihi sāma dālbhyeti |
meaning: अथ ह ब्रह्मदत्तं चैकितानेयम् उद्गायन्तं कुरव उपोदुर् उज्जहिहि साम दाल्भ्येति ।
