text: I. 55. 1.—[saying]: "Hath he originated from me {mad adhy abhut)? Hath he originated from me?" Therefore they say "honey-son" (madhuputra). And therefore women do not eat honey, saying: " We perform this vow of sons."
text_mt: "From me he has come into being! From me he has come into being!" [each said]. Therefore they say, "son of honey" (madhuputra).

sanskrit_iast: tasmād uta striyo madhu nāśnanti putrāṇām idaṃ vrataṃ carāma iti vadantīḥ | tad ayaṃ tṛco 'nūdaśrayata iyam eva gāyatry antarikṣaṃ triṣṭub asau jagatī tasyaitat tṛcaḥ |
meaning: तस्माद् उत स्त्रियो मधु नाश्नन्ति पुत्राणाम् इदं व्रतं चराम इति वदन्तीः । तद् अयं तृचो ऽनूदश्रयत इयम् एव गायत्र्य् अन्तरिक्षं त्रिष्टुब् असौ जगती तस्यैतत् तृचः ।
text: Then this triplet rose up in consequence: this [earth] the gāyatrī; the atmosphere the tristubh; yonder [sky] the jagatt. That is its triplet.
text_mt: Therefore also women do not eat honey, saying, "We are observing this vow for [our] sons." Then this triplet [of verses] arose following [them]: this [earth] is the gāyatrī, the intermediate space is the triṣṭubh, yonder [heaven] is the jagatī. Of him this is the triplet.

sanskrit_iast: sa upariṣṭāt sāmādhyāhitaṃ tapati so 'dhruva ivāsīd alelāyad iva sa nordhvo 'tapat |
meaning: स उपरिष्टात् सामाध्याहितं तपति सो ऽध्रुव इवासीद् अलेलायद् इव स नोर्ध्वो ऽतपत् ।
text: He (yonder sun) burns on high, a sdm,an set above. He was unstable, as it were; he twinkled, as it were. He did not burn upward.
text_mt: He, placed above the sāman, burns. He was as if unsteady, as if trembling. He did not burn upwards.

sanskrit_iast: sa devān abravīd un mā gāyateti kiṃ tatas syād iti śriyaṃ vaḥ prayaccheyam mām iha dṛṃheteti |
meaning: स देवान् अब्रवीद् उन् मा गायतेति किं ततस् स्याद् इति श्रियं वः प्रयच्छेयम् माम् इह दृंहेतेति ।
text: He said to the gods: "Sing me iha udgitha.'''' " What would be the result?" " I would bestow fortune upon you. Make me firm here."
text_mt: He said to the gods: "Sing up to me (un mā gāyata)." [They said:] "What would come of that?" [He said:] "I would grant you prosperity. Make me firm here!"

sanskrit_iast: tatheti tam udagāyan tam etad atrādṛṃhan tebhyaś śriyam prāyacchat saiṣā devānāṃ śrīḥ |
meaning: तथेति तम् उदगायन् तम् एतद् अत्रादृंहन् तेभ्यश् श्रियम् प्रायच्छत् सैषा देवानां श्रीः ।
text: " Very well." They sang him the udgītha. They thus made him firm there. He bestowed fortune upon them. That is that fortune of the gods.
text_mt: "So be it." They sang up to him (udagāyan). They made him firm here. He granted them prosperity. That is this prosperity of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: tata etad ūrdhvas tapati sa nārvāṅ atapat |
meaning: तत एतद् ऊर्ध्वस् तपति स नार्वाङ् अतपत् ।
text: Hence he thus burns upwards. He did not burn hitherward.
text_mt: Then he burns upwards. He did not burn downwards.

sanskrit_iast: sa ṛṣīn abravīd anu mā gāyateti kiṃ tatas syād iti śriyaṃ vaḥ prayaccheyam mām iha dṛṃheteti |
meaning: स ऋषीन् अब्रवीद् अनु मा गायतेति किं ततस् स्याद् इति श्रियं वः प्रयच्छेयम् माम् इह दृंहेतेति ।
text: He said to the sages {rsi): " Sing after me." " What would be the result of it?" " I would bestow fortune upon you. Make me firm here."
text_mt: He said to the ṛṣis: "Sing along to me (anu mā gāyata)." [They said:] "What would come of that?" [He said:] "I would grant you prosperity. Make me firm here!"

sanskrit_iast: tatheti tam anvagāyan tam etad atrādṛṃhan tebhyaś śriyam prāyacchat saiṣa rṣīṇāṃ śrīḥ |
meaning: तथेति तम् अन्वगायन् तम् एतद् अत्रादृंहन् तेभ्यश् श्रियम् प्रायच्छत् सैष र्षीणां श्रीः ।
text: " Very well." They sang after him. They thus made him firm there. He bestowed fortune upon them. That is that fortune of the sages.
text_mt: "So be it." They sang along to him (anvagāyan). They made him firm here. He granted them prosperity. That is this prosperity of the ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast: tata etad arvāṅ tapati sa na tiryaṅ atapat |
meaning: तत एतद् अर्वाङ् तपति स न तिर्यङ् अतपत् ।
text: Hence he thus burns hitherward. He did not burn crosswise.
text_mt: Then he burns downwards. He did not burn transversely.

sanskrit_iast: sa gandharvāpsaraso 'bravīd ā mā gāyateti kiṃ tatas syād iti śriyaṃ vaḥ prayaccheyam mām iha dṛṃheteti |
meaning: स गन्धर्वाप्सरसो ऽब्रवीद् आ मा गायतेति किं ततस् स्याद् इति श्रियं वः प्रयच्छेयम् माम् इह दृंहेतेति ।
text: He said to the Gandharvas and Apsarases: " Sing unto me." " What would be the result of it?" "I would bestow fortune upon you. Make me firm here."
text_mt: He said to the Gandharvas and Apsarases: "Sing hither to me (ā mā gāyata)." [They said:] "What would come of that?" [He said:] "I would grant you prosperity. Make me firm here!"

sanskrit_iast: tatheti tam āgāyan tam etad atrādṛṃhan tebhyaś śriyam prāyacchat saiṣā gandharvāpsarasāṃ śrīḥ |
meaning: तथेति तम् आगायन् तम् एतद् अत्रादृंहन् तेभ्यश् श्रियम् प्रायच्छत् सैषा गन्धर्वाप्सरसां श्रीः ।
text: "Very well." They sang unto him. They thus made him firm there. He bestowed fortune upon them. That is that fortune of the Gandharvas and Apsarases.
text_mt: "So be it." They sang hither to him (āgāyan). They made him firm here. He granted them prosperity. That is this prosperity of the Gandharvas and Apsarases.

sanskrit_iast: tata etat tiryaṅ tapati |
meaning: तत एतत् तिर्यङ् तपति ।
text: Hence he thus burns crosswise.
text_mt: Then he burns transversely.

sanskrit_iast: tāni vā etāni trīṇi sāmna udgītam anugītam āgītam tad yathedaṃ vayam āgāyodgāyāma etad udgītam atha yad yathāgītaṃ tad anugītam atha yat kiṃ ceti sāmnas tad āgītam etāni hy eva trīṇi sāmnaḥ | saptadaśe 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ saptadaśo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: तानि वा एतानि त्रीणि साम्न उद्गीतम् अनुगीतम् आगीतम् तद् यथेदं वयम् आगायोद्गायाम एतद् उद्गीतम् अथ यद् यथागीतं तद् अनुगीतम् अथ यत् किं चेति साम्नस् तद् आगीतम् एतानि ह्य् एव त्रीणि साम्नः । सप्तदशे ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः सप्तदशो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: Verily these are the three of the sāman [viz.]: what is sung as udgītha, what is sung after (amtglta), what is sung unto (dg'ita). As we here having sung unto sing the udgītha, that is what is sung as udgītha; and what is sung like the dglta, that is that which is sung after; and anything of the sāman [that is sung], that is sung unto. For there are just these three [parts] of the sāman.
text_mt: These indeed are the three chantings of the sāman: the udgīta, the anugīta, and the āgīta. That which we sing hither and sing up, this is the udgīta. And that which is sung along, that is the anugīta. And whatever else of the sāman, that is the āgīta. For these are the three of the sāman. Third khaṇḍa in the seventeenth anuvāka. The seventeenth anuvāka is ended.

sanskrit_iast: āpo vā idam agre mahat salilam āsīt sa ūrmir ūrmim askandat tato hiraṇmayau kukṣyau samabhavatāṃ te eva rksāme |
meaning: आपो वा इदम् अग्रे महत् सलिलम् आसीत् स ऊर्मिर् ऊर्मिम् अस्कन्दत् ततो हिरण्मयौ कुक्ष्यौ समभवतां ते एव र्क्सामे ।
text: This all was at first the waters, a great flood. One wave mounted [the other] wave. Thence two golden wombs came into being, these two [viz.]: re and sāman.
text_mt: In the beginning, waters indeed were this great ocean. Wave leaped upon wave. Thence two golden halves of a shell came into being; they were indeed the ṛc and the sāman.

sanskrit_iast: seyam ṛg idaṃ sāmābhyaplavata tām apṛcchat kā tvam asīti sāham asmīty abravīt atha vā aham amo 'smīti tad yat sā cāmaś ca tat sāmnas sāmatvam |
meaning: सेयम् ऋग् इदं सामाभ्यप्लवत ताम् अपृच्छत् का त्वम् असीति साहम् अस्मीत्य् अब्रवीत् अथ वा अहम् अमो ऽस्मीति तद् यत् सा चामश् च तत् साम्नस् सामत्वम् ।
text: This same re floated unto that same sāman. = I. 53. 6. 3. = I. 53. e.
text_mt: This ṛc floated towards this sāman. He asked her: "Who are you?" She said: "I am she (sā)." [He said:] "Now, indeed, I am he (ama)." That she was sā and he ama, that is the sāman-hood of the sāman.

sanskrit_iast: tau vai sambhavāveti nety abravīt svasā vai mama tvam asi anyatra mithunam icchasveti |
meaning: तौ वै सम्भवावेति नेत्य् अब्रवीत् स्वसा वै मम त्वम् असि अन्यत्र मिथुनम् इच्छस्वेति ।
text_mt: "Let us two unite!" [said the sāman]. She said: "No, you are indeed my brother. Seek a mate elsewhere!"

sanskrit_iast: sā parāplavata mithunam icchamānā sā samās sahasraṃ saptatīḥ paryaplavata |
meaning: सा पराप्लवत मिथुनम् इच्छमाना सा समास् सहस्रं सप्ततीः पर्यप्लवत ।
text: She floated away desiring intercourse. She floated around a thousand seventies of years,
text_mt: She floated away, seeking a mate. She floated around for seventy thousand years.

sanskrit_iast: tad eṣa ślokas strī smaivāgre saṃcaratīcchantī salile patim samās sahasraṃ saptatīs tato 'jāyata paśyata iti |
meaning: तद् एष श्लोकस् स्त्री स्मैवाग्रे संचरतीच्छन्ती सलिले पतिम् समास् सहस्रं सप्ततीस् ततो ऽजायत पश्यत इति ।
text: Regarding this there is this ŚloJea: " In the beginning the woman used to go seeking [her] lord in the flood, one thousand seventies of years; thence the beauteous one was born."

sanskrit_iast: asau vā ādityaḥ paśyataḥ eṣa eva tad ajāyata etena hi paśyati |
meaning: असौ वा आदित्यः पश्यतः एष एव तद् अजायत एतेन हि पश्यति ।
text: Yonder sun is the beauteous one [pafyata); he was born then, for by him one sees {pa^yati).
text_mt: Yonder sun is indeed the Seer. He indeed was born then, for by him one sees.

sanskrit_iast: sāvittvā nyaplavata sābravīn na vai taṃ vindāmi yena sambhaveyam tvayaiva sambhavānīti |
meaning: सावित्त्वा न्यप्लवत साब्रवीन् न वै तं विन्दामि येन सम्भवेयम् त्वयैव सम्भवानीति ।
text: She, not having found [anyone], floated in. She said: "Verily I find no one with whom I might have intercourse. Let me have intercourse with thee."
text_mt: Having found [none], she floated back down. She said: "Indeed, I find no one with whom I may unite. Let me unite with you alone!"

sanskrit_iast: sā vai dvitīyām icchasvety abravīn na vai maikodyaṃsyasīti sā dvitīyāṃ vittvā nyaplavata |
meaning: सा वै द्वितीयाम् इच्छस्वेत्य् अब्रवीन् न वै मैकोद्यंस्यसीति सा द्वितीयां वित्त्वा न्यप्लवत ।
text: "Then seek a second one," he said; "verily not alone wilt thou sustain me." She, having found a second one, floated in.
text_mt: He said: "Seek a second [verse]; alone you will not uphold me!" Having found a second, she floated back down.

sanskrit_iast: icchasvaivety abravīn no vāva mā dve udyaṃsyatha iti sā tṛtīyāṃ vittvā nyaplavata so 'bravīd atra vai modyaṃsyatheti |
meaning: इच्छस्वैवेत्य् अब्रवीन् नो वाव मा द्वे उद्यंस्यथ इति सा तृतीयां वित्त्वा न्यप्लवत सो ऽब्रवीद् अत्र वै मोद्यंस्यथेति ।
text: " Seek a third one," lie said; " verily ye two will not sustain me." She, having found a third one, floated in. He said: "Verily now you will sustain me."
text_mt: "Seek a third!" he said, "the two of you will surely not uphold me!" Having found a third, she floated back down. He said: "Now indeed you will uphold me!"

sanskrit_iast: sa yad ekayāgre samavadata tasmād ekarce sāma atha yad dve apāsedhat tasmād dvayor na kurvanti atha yat tiṣṛbhis samapādayat tasmād u tṛce sāma |
meaning: स यद् एकयाग्रे समवदत तस्माद् एकर्चे साम अथ यद् द्वे अपासेधत् तस्माद् द्वयोर् न कुर्वन्ति अथ यत् तिषृभिस् समपादयत् तस्माद् उ तृचे साम ।
text: Because he talked first with one, therefore the sāman is in one re. And because he refused two, therefore they do not do (sing) it in two [ṛc's]. And because be agreed with three, therefore the sawaw is in a triplet,
text_mt: Because he conversed with one in the beginning, therefore there is a sāman on a single verse. Then because he pushed away two, therefore they do not make [a sāman] on two. Then because he completed it with three, therefore the sāman is on a triplet.

sanskrit_iast: tā abravīt punīdhvaṃ na pūtā vai stheti | aṣṭādaśe 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: ता अब्रवीत् पुनीध्वं न पूता वै स्थेति । अष्टादशे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: He said to them: "Cleanse yourselves, verily you are not clean."
text_mt: He said to them: "Purify yourselves; you are not purified!" First khaṇḍa in the eighteenth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sā gāyatrī gāthayāpunīta nārāśaṃsyā triṣṭub raibhyā jagatī bhīmam bata malam apāvadhiṣateti tasmād bhīmalā dhiyo vā etāḥ dhiyo vā imā malam apāvadhiṣateti tasmād u bhīmalāḥ tasmād u gāyatāṃ nāśnīyāt malena hy ete jīvanti |
meaning: सा गायत्री गाथयापुनीत नाराशंस्या त्रिष्टुब् रैभ्या जगती भीमम् बत मलम् अपावधिषतेति तस्माद् भीमला धियो वा एताः धियो वा इमा मलम् अपावधिषतेति तस्माद् उ भीमलाः तस्माद् उ गायतां नाश्नीयात् मलेन ह्य् एते जीवन्ति ।
text: That gāyatrī cleansed itself with the gdthd, the tristubh with the ndrdfansi, the jagatl with the rdibhl. " Lo, they have struck away fearful (b'hlma) defilement (rnala)." Therefore these devices are terrible (? bhimala). " Verily, these devices have struck away defilement." And therefore [they are] terrible {? bhimala). And therefore one should not eat [anything] of those singing; for they live on defilement {m,ala).
text_mt: The gāyatrī purified herself with a song (gāthā), the triṣṭubh with a nārāśaṃsī, the jagatī with a raibhī. "Alas, they have repelled terrible impurity!" Therefore these are terrible (bhīmalā) thoughts. "These thoughts have repelled impurity!" Therefore also they are terrible. Therefore one should not eat [food] of singers; for they live on impurity.

sanskrit_iast: atha rk sāmābravīd bahu vai kiṃ ca kiṃ ca pumāṃś carati tvam anupunīṣveti sa ūrdhvagaṇenāpunīta |
meaning: अथ र्क् सामाब्रवीद् बहु वै किं च किं च पुमांश् चरति त्वम् अनुपुनीष्वेति स ऊर्ध्वगणेनापुनीत ।
text: Then the re said to the sāman: " Verily, much does a man pratice of this sort and of that. Cleanse thyself also." He cleansed himself with the upper series (?). 3. = I. 51. 1.
text_mt: Then the ṛc said to the sāman: "A male wanders into much of whatever it may be. Purify yourself in turn!" He purified himself with the upward flock (ūrdhvagaṇa).

sanskrit_iast: pūtāni ha vā asya sāmāni pūtā ṛcaḥ pūtāni yajūṃṣi pūtam anūktam pūtaṃ sarvam bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: पूतानि ह वा अस्य सामानि पूता ऋचः पूतानि यजूंषि पूतम् अनूक्तम् पूतं सर्वम् भवति य एवं वेद ।
text_mt: Purified indeed are his sāmans, purified his ṛcs, purified his yajuses, purified what is recited after, purified everything becomes for him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: tābhyāṃ diśo mithunāya paryauhan tāṃ sambhaviṣyann ahvayatāmo 'ham asmi sā tvaṃ sā tvam asy amo 'ham iti |
meaning: ताभ्यां दिशो मिथुनाय पर्यौहन् तां सम्भविष्यन्न् अह्वयतामो ऽहम् अस्मि सा त्वं सा त्वम् अस्य् अमो ऽहम् इति ।
text: They enclosed the quarters for their intercourse. When he was about to have intercourse with her, he called out: " I am he, thou art she; thou art she, 1 am he."
text_mt: For them two they enclosed the directions for union. When he was about to unite with her, he called out: "I am he (ama), you are she (sā); you are she, I am he."

sanskrit_iast: tām etad ubhayato vācātyaricyata hiṅkāreṇa purastāt stobhena madhyato nidhanenopariṣṭāt ati tisro brāhmaṇāyanīs sadṛśī ricyate ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: ताम् एतद् उभयतो वाचात्यरिच्यत हिङ्कारेण पुरस्तात् स्तोभेन मध्यतो निधनेनोपरिष्टात् अति तिस्रो ब्राह्मणायनीस् सदृशी रिच्यते य एवं वेद ।
text: With speech he thus exceeded her on both sides, with the hinkdra in front, with the stobha in the middle, with the nidhana in the rear. Three similar women of the Brahman caste exceeds he who knows thus.
text_mt: He exceeded her on both sides with speech: with the hiṅkāra in front, with the stobha in the middle, with the nidhana at the end. He who knows thus surpasses three equal women of brahmin descent.

sanskrit_iast: tayor yas sambhavator ūrdhvaś śūṣo 'dravat te te prāṇā evordhvā adravan |
meaning: तयोर् यस् सम्भवतोर् ऊर्ध्वश् शूषो ऽद्रवत् ते ते प्राणा एवोर्ध्वा अद्रवन् ।
text: The vital blast which when they had intercourse ran upward, that is the breaths. These breaths ran upward.
text_mt: The upward vigor that ran forth from the two as they united, that was the breaths. Those breaths ran forth upwards.

sanskrit_iast: so 'sāv ādityas sa eṣa eva ud agnir eva gī candramā eva tham sāmāny eva ud ṛca eva gī yajūṃṣy eva tham ity adhidevatam |
meaning: सो ऽसाव् आदित्यस् स एष एव उद् अग्निर् एव गी चन्द्रमा एव थम् सामान्य् एव उद् ऋच एव गी यजूंष्य् एव थम् इत्य् अधिदेवतम् ।
text: Yonder sun, that same is ud, Agni is gl, the moon is tham. The sāmans are ud, the ṛc's are gl, the yajuses are tham. So with regard to the divinities.
text_mt: He is yonder sun; he is ud, Agni is gī, the Moon is tham; the sāmans are ud, the ṛcs are gī, the yajuses are tham—thus with respect to the deities.

sanskrit_iast: athādhyātmam prāṇa eva ud vāg eva gī mana eva tham sa eṣo 'dhidevataṃ cādhyātmaṃ codgīthaḥ |
meaning: अथाध्यात्मम् प्राण एव उद् वाग् एव गी मन एव थम् स एषो ऽधिदेवतं चाध्यात्मं चोद्गीथः ।
text: Now with regard to the self. Breath is iid, speech is gl, mind is thain. That is this udgītha with regard both to the divinities and to the self.
text_mt: Now with respect to the self: breath is ud, speech is gī, mind is tham. That is the udgītha both with respect to the deities and with respect to the self.

sanskrit_iast: sa ya evam etad adhidevataṃ cādhyātmaṃ codgīthaṃ vedaitena hāsya sarveṇodgītam bhavaty etasmād u eva sarvasmād āvṛścyate ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati | aṣṭādaśe 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स य एवम् एतद् अधिदेवतं चाध्यात्मं चोद्गीथं वेदैतेन हास्य सर्वेणोद्गीतम् भवत्य् एतस्माद् उ एव सर्वस्माद् आवृश्च्यते य एवं विद्वांसम् उपवदति । अष्टादशे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: He who thus knows the tidgltha with regard both to the divinities and to the self, verily his udgītha is sung by this all; and he is cut off from this all who speaks ill of one who knows thus.
text_mt: He who thus knows this udgītha with respect to the deities and with respect to the self, by all this it becomes sung up for him; and from all this is he cut off who speaks ill of one who knows thus. Second khaṇḍa in the eighteenth anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: tad yad idam āhuḥ ka udagāsīr iti ka etam ādityam agāsīr iti ha vā etat pṛcchanti |
meaning: तद् यद् इदम् आहुः क उदगासीर् इति क एतम् आदित्यम् अगासीर् इति ह वा एतत् पृच्छन्ति ।
text: When they say here: "As who hast thou sung the udgītha?" they ask this: "As who hast thou sung this sun?"
text_mt: As to what they say, "Which [chanter] did you sing up?"—"Which [chanter] sang this sun?" is what they ask.

sanskrit_iast: etaṃ ha vā etaṃ trayyā vidyayā gāyanti yathā vīṇāgāthino gāpayeyur evam |
meaning: एतं ह वा एतं त्रय्या विद्यया गायन्ति यथा वीणागाथिनो गापयेयुर् एवम् ।
text: Verily they sing it with the threefold knowledge, just as lute-players might play.
text_mt: Him indeed they sing with the triple knowledge, just as lute-singers would have someone sing.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa hradaḥ kāmānām pūrṇo yan manaḥ tasyaiṣā kulyā yad vāk |
meaning: स एष ह्रदः कामानाम् पूर्णो यन् मनः तस्यैषा कुल्या यद् वाक् ।
text: Mind is this pool full of desires. Speech is the stream of it.
text_mt: That which is the mind is this lake filled with desires. That which is speech is its watercourse.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā vā apo hradāt kulyayoparām upanayanty evam evaitan manaso 'dhi vācodgātā yajamānam yasya kāmān prayacchati |
meaning: तद् यथा वा अपो ह्रदात् कुल्ययोपराम् उपनयन्त्य् एवम् एवैतन् मनसो ऽधि वाचोद्गाता यजमानम् यस्य कामान् प्रयच्छति ।
text: As they lead the water from a lake nearer by means of a stream, just so the udgdtar [leads] that from the mind by means of speech unto the sacrificer whose wishes he fulfils.
text_mt: Then just as they lead waters from a lake to lower ground through a watercourse, so indeed does the udgātṛ, through speech, grant the desires of the sacrificer from the mind.

sanskrit_iast: sa ya udgātāraṃ dakṣiṇābhir ārādhayati taṃ sā kulyopadhāvati ya u enaṃ nārādhayati sa u tām apihanti |
meaning: स य उद्गातारं दक्षिणाभिर् आराधयति तं सा कुल्योपधावति य उ एनं नाराधयति स उ ताम् अपिहन्ति ।
text: Whoso by sacrificial gifts conciliates the udgdtar, unto him this stream runs; and whoso does not conciliate him, he drives this [stream] away.
text_mt: He who pleases the udgātṛ with sacrificial gifts, towards him runs that watercourse. And he who does not please him, he dams it up.

sanskrit_iast: atha vā ataḥ prattiś caiva pratigrahaś ca tad dhūmam iti vai pradīyate tad vācā yajamānāya pradeyam manasātmane tathā ha sarvaṃ na prayacchati |
meaning: अथ वा अतः प्रत्तिश् चैव प्रतिग्रहश् च तद् धूमम् इति वै प्रदीयते तद् वाचा यजमानाय प्रदेयम् मनसात्मने तथा ह सर्वं न प्रयच्छति ।
text: Now henceforth [about] giving and receiving. [A gift] is given [with the words]: " This is smoke." Thus it should be given to the sacrificer with speech, with the mind to one's self. Thus one does not bestow all.
text_mt: Now, then, of giving and receiving: "Take this!"—thus indeed it is given. That should be given to the sacrificer through speech, and to oneself through the mind. Thus indeed he does not give away everything.

sanskrit_iast: tad yad idaṃ sambhavato reto 'sicyata tad aśayat yathā hiraṇyam avikṛtaṃ lelāyad evam |
meaning: तद् यद् इदं सम्भवतो रेतो ऽसिच्यत तद् अशयत् यथा हिरण्यम् अविकृतं लेलायद् एवम् ।
text: That seed which was shed when they had intercourse, that lay there, just like undefiled sparkling gold.
text_mt: That seed which was emitted from the two as they united lay there like unworked gold, trembling.

sanskrit_iast: tasya sarve devā mamatvina āsan mama mameti te 'bruvan vīdaṃ karavāmahā iti te 'bruvañ chreyo vā idam asmat ātmabhir evainad vikaravāmahā iti |
meaning: तस्य सर्वे देवा ममत्विन आसन् मम ममेति ते ऽब्रुवन् वीदं करवामहा इति ते ऽब्रुवञ् छ्रेयो वा इदम् अस्मत् आत्मभिर् एवैनद् विकरवामहा इति ।
text: Of it all the gods were desirous to be possessors [saying]: " It is mine, it is mine." They said: "Let us divide it among ourselves." They said:" Verily, it is superior to us. Let us divide it by our selves."
text_mt: All the gods claimed ownership of it, [saying,] “Mine! Mine!” They said: “Let us divide this.” They said: “This is indeed better than us. Let us divide it through our own selves.”

sanskrit_iast: tad ātmabhir eva vyakurvata teṣāṃ vāyur eva hiṅkāra āsāgniḥ prastāva indra ādis somabṛhaspatī udgītho 'śvinau pratihāro viśve devā upadravaḥ prajāpatir eva nidhanam |
meaning: तद् आत्मभिर् एव व्यकुर्वत तेषां वायुर् एव हिङ्कार आसाग्निः प्रस्ताव इन्द्र आदिस् सोमबृहस्पती उद्गीथो ऽश्विनौ प्रतिहारो विश्वे देवा उपद्रवः प्रजापतिर् एव निधनम् ।
text: They divided it by their selves. Of them Vayu was the hinkdra, Agni the prOjStdva, Indra the ddi. Soma and Brhaspati the udgītha, the two Agvins the pratihāra, all the gods the upadrava, Prajapati the nidhana.
text_mt: They divided it through their own selves: of them, Vāyu was the hiṅkāra; Agni the prastāva; Indra the ādi; Soma and Bṛhaspati the udgītha; the Aśvins the pratihāra; the Viśve Devas the upadrava; Prajāpati alone the nidhana.

sanskrit_iast: etā vai sarvā devatā etā hiraṇyam asya sarvābhir devatābhis stutam bhavati ya evaṃ veda etābhya u eva sa sarvābhyo devatābhya āvṛścyate ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati | aṣṭādaśe 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: एता वै सर्वा देवता एता हिरण्यम् अस्य सर्वाभिर् देवताभिस् स्तुतम् भवति य एवं वेद एताभ्य उ एव स सर्वाभ्यो देवताभ्य आवृश्च्यते य एवं विद्वांसम् उपवदति । अष्टादशे ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः ।
text: Verily these are all the divinities; these are gold. Praised by all divinities it is of him who knows thus; and from all divinities he is cut off who speaks ill of one who knows thus.
text_mt: These indeed are all the deities; these are the gold. Praise is chanted by all the deities for him who knows thus. And he who speaks ill of one who knows thus is cut off from all these deities. The third section in the eighteenth lesson.

sanskrit_iast: atha ha brahmadattaś caikitāneyaḥ kuruṃ jagāmābhipratāriṇaṃ kākṣasenim sa hāsmai madhuparkaṃ yayāca |
meaning: अथ ह ब्रह्मदत्तश् चैकितानेयः कुरुं जगामाभिप्रतारिणं काक्षसेनिम् स हास्मै मधुपर्कं ययाच ।
text: Now Brahmadatta Caikitaneya went to the Kuru Abhipratarin Kaksaseni. He (A.) offered him a honey-potion [madhuparka). -j. Now his purohita Śaunaka, stepping forth, sat down near by. He (B.) drank the honey-potion without addressing him (^.).
text_mt: Now Brahmadatta Caikitāneya went to the Kuru Abhipratārin Kākṣaseni. He requested the honey-mixture of him.

sanskrit_iast: atha hāsya vai prapadya purohito 'nte niṣasāda śaunakaḥ taṃ hānāmantrya madhuparkam papau |
meaning: अथ हास्य वै प्रपद्य पुरोहितो ऽन्ते निषसाद शौनकः तं हानामन्त्र्य मधुपर्कम् पपौ ।
text_mt: Then his purohita Śaunaka, approaching, sat down nearby. Without addressing him, [Brahmadatta] drank the honey-mixture.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ hovāca kiṃ vidvān no dālbhyānāmantrya madhuparkam pibasīti sāmavairyam prapadyeti hovāca |
meaning: तं होवाच किं विद्वान् नो दाल्भ्यानामन्त्र्य मधुपर्कम् पिबसीति सामवैर्यम् प्रपद्येति होवाच ।
text: He {Q.) said to him (B.): "As knowing what, O Dalbhya, dost thou drink the honey-potion without addressing [me]?" " Having recourse to that which belongs to the strength of the sāman (?)," he (B.) said.
text_mt: He said to him: “Knowing what, O Dālbhya, do you drink the honey-mixture without addressing us?” He said: “Having resort to the heroism of the sāman.”

sanskrit_iast: taṃ ha tatraiva papraccha yad vāyau tad vetthā3 iti hiṅkāro vā asya sa iti |
meaning: तं ह तत्रैव पप्रच्छ यद् वायौ तद् वेत्था3 इति हिङ्कारो वा अस्य स इति ।
text: He {(}.) asked him (B.) just there: " Dost thou know that which is in Vayu?" "Verily, the hinkdra of it."
text_mt: He asked him right there: “Do you know that which is in Vāyu?” [Brahmadatta replied:] “That is indeed its hiṅkāra.”

sanskrit_iast: yad agnau tad vetthā3 iti prastāvo vā asya sa iti |
meaning: यद् अग्नौ तद् वेत्था3 इति प्रस्तावो वा अस्य स इति ।
text: "Dost thou know that which is in Agni?" " Verily, the prastāva of it."
text_mt: “Do you know that which is in Agni?” “That is indeed its prastāva.”

sanskrit_iast: yad indre tad vetthā3 iti ādir vā asya sa iti |
meaning: यद् इन्द्रे तद् वेत्था3 इति आदिर् वा अस्य स इति ।
text: " Dost thou know that which is in Indra?" "Verily, the atZiof it."
text_mt: “Do you know that which is in Indra?” “That is indeed its ādi.”

sanskrit_iast: yat somabṛhaspatyos tad vetthā3 iti udgītho vā asya sa iti |
meaning: यत् सोमबृहस्पत्योस् तद् वेत्था3 इति उद्गीथो वा अस्य स इति ।
text: "Dost thou know that which is in Soma and Brhaspati?" " Verily, the udgitha of it."
text_mt: “Do you know that which is in Soma and Bṛhaspati?” “That is indeed its udgītha.”

sanskrit_iast: yad aśvinos tad vetthā3 iti pratihāro vā asya sa iti |
meaning: यद् अश्विनोस् तद् वेत्था3 इति प्रतिहारो वा अस्य स इति ।
text: " Dost thou know that which is in the two A5vins?" " Verily, the praiihdra of it."
text_mt: “Do you know that which is in the Aśvins?” “That is indeed its pratihāra.”

sanskrit_iast: yad viśveṣu deveṣu tad vetthā3 iti upadravo vā asya sa iti |
meaning: यद् विश्वेषु देवेषु तद् वेत्था3 इति उपद्रवो वा अस्य स इति ।
text: Dost thou know that which is in all the gods?" " Verily, the upadrava of it."
text_mt: “Do you know that which is in the Viśve Devas?” “That is indeed its upadrava.”

sanskrit_iast: yat prajāpatau tad vetthā3 iti nidhanaṃ vā asya tad iti hovāca ārṣeyaṃ vā asya tad bandhutā vā asya seti |
meaning: यत् प्रजापतौ तद् वेत्था3 इति निधनं वा अस्य तद् इति होवाच आर्षेयं वा अस्य तद् बन्धुता वा अस्य सेति ।
text: " Dost thou know that which is in Prajapati?" " Verily, the nidhana of it," he said; "that of it belongs to the sages (rsi); that is its connection."
text_mt: “Do you know that which is in Prajāpati?” He said: “That is indeed its nidhana. That is its ancestral lineage, that is its kinship.”

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca namas te 'stu bhagavo vidvān apā madhuparkam iti |
meaning: स होवाच नमस् ते ऽस्तु भगवो विद्वान् अपा मधुपर्कम् इति ।
text: He {().) said: "Homage be to thee, reverend sir; with knowledge hast thou drunk the honey-potion."
text_mt: He said: “Homage be to you, reverend sir! Knowing, you have drunk the honey-mixture.”

sanskrit_iast: atha hetaraḥ papraccha kiṃdevatyaṃ sāmavairyam prapadyeti yaddevatyāsu stuvata iti hovāca taddevatyam iti |
meaning: अथ हेतरः पप्रच्छ किंदेवत्यं सामवैर्यम् प्रपद्येति यद्देवत्यासु स्तुवत इति होवाच तद्देवत्यम् इति ।
text: Then the other one (A.) asked: " What divinities has that which belongs to the strength of the sāman (?) to which thou hast recourse?" " What divinities the [vei'ses] have with which the praise [stotra) is sung," he (B.) said, " those it has as divinities."
text_mt: Then the other asked: “Having resort to the heroism of the sāman, to what deity does it belong?” He said: “To whatever deity [the verses belong] on which they chant praise, to that deity does it belong.”

sanskrit_iast: tad etat sādhv eva pratyuktam vyāptir vā asyaiṣeti hovāca brūhy eveti medaṃ te namo 'karmeti hovāca maiva no 'tiprākṣīr iti |
meaning: तद् एतत् साध्व् एव प्रत्युक्तम् व्याप्तिर् वा अस्यैषेति होवाच ब्रूह्य् एवेति मेदं ते नमो ऽकर्मेति होवाच मैव नो ऽतिप्राक्षीर् इति ।
text: "That was well answered; that is its accomplishment (?)," he said; "just talk." "Don't! We have done thee this honor," he said; " do not ask us too much."
text_mt: “That has indeed been properly answered. This is its pervasive reach,” he said; “Speak on!” He said: “Let us not make this homage to you! Do not question us too far!”

sanskrit_iast: sa hovācāprakṣyaṃ vāva tvā devatām aprakṣyaṃ vāva tvā devatāyai devatāḥ vāgdevatyaṃ sāma vāco mano devatā manasaḥ paśavaḥ paśūnām oṣadhaya oṣadhīnām āpaḥ tad etad adbhyo jātaṃ sāmāpsu pratiṣṭhitam iti | aṣṭādaśe 'nuvāke caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स होवाचाप्रक्ष्यं वाव त्वा देवताम् अप्रक्ष्यं वाव त्वा देवतायै देवताः वाग्देवत्यं साम वाचो मनो देवता मनसः पशवः पशूनाम् ओषधय ओषधीनाम् आपः तद् एतद् अद्भ्यो जातं सामाप्सु प्रतिष्ठितम् इति । अष्टादशे ऽनुवाके चतुर्थः खण्डः ।
text: He said: " I should have asked thee about the divinity, I should have asked thee about the divinities of the divinity. The sāman has speech as its divinity; mind is the divinity of speech, the domestic animals [are the divinity] of mind, the herbs [are the divinity] of the domestic animals, the waters [are the divinity] of the herbs. That same is the sāman born from the waters, standing firm in the waters."
text_mt: He said: “I would indeed have questioned you about the deity; I would indeed have questioned you about the deities of the deity. Speech is the deity of the sāman; mind is the deity of speech; cattle [are the deity] of mind; plants [are the deity] of cattle; waters [are the deity] of plants. This sāman, born from the waters, is established in the waters.” The fourth section in the eighteenth lesson.

sanskrit_iast: devāsurā aspardhanta te devā manasodagāyan tad eṣām asurā abhidrutya pāpmanā samasṛjan tasmād bahu kiṃ ca kiṃ ca manasā dhyāyati puṇyaṃ cainena dhyāyati pāpaṃ ca |
meaning: देवासुरा अस्पर्धन्त ते देवा मनसोदगायन् तद् एषाम् असुरा अभिद्रुत्य पाप्मना समसृजन् तस्माद् बहु किं च किं च मनसा ध्यायति पुण्यं चैनेन ध्यायति पापं च ।
text: The gods and the Asuras contended. The gods sang the udgWia with the mind. The Asuras, running against this [mind] of them, mixed it with evil. Therefore with the mind one thinks many a thing of one kind and another; both [what is] good one thinks with it and [what; is] evil.
text_mt: The gods and the asuras contended. Those gods chanted the udgītha with the mind. Rushing at it, the asuras contaminated it with evil. Therefore with the mind one thinks much of whatever; and with it one thinks good and bad.

sanskrit_iast: te vācodagāyan tāṃ tathaivākurvan tasmād bahu kiṃ ca kiṃ ca vācā vadati satyaṃ cainayā vadaty anṛtaṃ ca |
meaning: ते वाचोदगायन् तां तथैवाकुर्वन् तस्माद् बहु किं च किं च वाचा वदति सत्यं चैनया वदत्य् अनृतं च ।
text: They sang the udgitha with speech. That [speech] they treated in just the same way. Therefore with speech one speaks many a thing of this kind and of that; both [what is] true one speaks with it and what is] untrue.
text_mt: They chanted the udgītha with speech. They did the very same to it. Therefore with speech one speaks much of whatever; and with it one speaks truth and falsehood.

sanskrit_iast: te cakṣuṣodagāyan tat tathaivākurvan tasmād bahu kiṃ ca kiṃ ca cakṣuṣā paśyati darśanīyaṃ cainena paśyaty adarśanīyaṃ ca |
meaning: ते चक्षुषोदगायन् तत् तथैवाकुर्वन् तस्माद् बहु किं च किं च चक्षुषा पश्यति दर्शनीयं चैनेन पश्यत्य् अदर्शनीयं च ।
text: They sang the udgītha with sight. That sight] they treated in just the same manner. Therefore with sight one sees many a thing of this kind and of that; both [what is] seemly one sees with it and [what is] unseemly.
text_mt: They chanted the udgītha with sight. They did the very same to it. Therefore with sight one sees much of whatever; and with it one sees what is sightly and what is unsightly.

sanskrit_iast: te śrotreṇodagāyan tat tathaivākurvan tasmād bahu kiṃ ca kiṃ ca śrotreṇa śṛṇoti śravaṇīyaṃ cainena śṛṇoty aśravaṇīyaṃ ca |
meaning: ते श्रोत्रेणोदगायन् तत् तथैवाकुर्वन् तस्माद् बहु किं च किं च श्रोत्रेण शृणोति श्रवणीयं चैनेन शृणोत्य् अश्रवणीयं च ।
text: They sang the udgītha with hearing. That [hearing] they treated in just the same manner. Therefore with hearing one hears many a thing of this kind and of that; both [what is] worth hearing one hears with it and [what is] not worth hearing.
text_mt: They chanted the udgītha with hearing. They did the very same to it. Therefore with hearing one hears much of whatever; and with it one hears what is worth hearing and what is not worth hearing.

sanskrit_iast: te 'pānenodagāyan taṃ tathaivākurvan tasmād bahu kiṃ ca kiṃ cāpānena jighrati surabhi cainena jighrati durgandhi ca |
meaning: ते ऽपानेनोदगायन् तं तथैवाकुर्वन् तस्माद् बहु किं च किं चापानेन जिघ्रति सुरभि चैनेन जिघ्रति दुर्गन्धि च ।
text: They sang the udgUha with exhalation. That [exhalation] they treated in just the same manner. Therefore with exhalation one smells many a thing of this kind and of that; both what is fragrant one smells with it and what is of bad odor.
text_mt: They chanted the udgītha with the downward breath. They did the very same to it. Therefore with the downward breath one smells much of whatever; and with it one smells what is fragrant and what is foul-smelling.

sanskrit_iast: te prāṇenodagāyan athāsurā ādravaṃs tathā kariṣyāma iti manyamānāḥ |
meaning: ते प्राणेनोदगायन् अथासुरा आद्रवंस् तथा करिष्याम इति मन्यमानाः ।
text: They sang the udgītha with breath. Then the Asuras ran up, thinking: " We will treat it in the same manner."
text_mt: They chanted the udgītha with breath. Then the asuras rushed up, thinking, “We will do likewise.”

sanskrit_iast: sa yathāśmānam ṛtvā loṣṭo vidhvaṃsetaivam evāsurā vyadhvaṃsanta sa eṣo 'śmākhaṇaṃ yat prāṇaḥ |
meaning: स यथाश्मानम् ऋत्वा लोष्टो विध्वंसेतैवम् एवासुरा व्यध्वंसन्त स एषो ऽश्माखणं यत् प्राणः ।
text: As a clod of earth colliding with a stone would break to pieces, even so the Asuras broke to pieces. Breath is this stone as a tai-get.
text_mt: Just as a clod of earth, striking against a stone, would shatter, so indeed the asuras shattered. Breath is this solid stone.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathāśmānam ākhaṇam ṛtvā loṣṭo vidhvaṃsata evam eva sa vidhvaṃsate ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati | aṣṭādaśe 'nuvāke pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ aṣṭādaśo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: स यथाश्मानम् आखणम् ऋत्वा लोष्टो विध्वंसत एवम् एव स विध्वंसते य एवं विद्वांसम् उपवदति । अष्टादशे ऽनुवाके पञ्चमः खण्डः अष्टादशो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: As a clod of earth, colliding with a stone as a target, breaks to pieces, even so he breaks to pieces who speaks ill of one who knows thus.
text_mt: Just as a clod of earth, striking against a solid stone, shatters, so indeed he shatters who speaks ill of one who knows thus. The fifth section in the eighteenth lesson. The eighteenth lesson is complete.

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ vai ṣaḍ udgātāra āsan vāk ca manaś ca cakṣuś ca śrotraṃ cāpānaś ca prāṇaś ca |
meaning: देवानां वै षड् उद्गातार आसन् वाक् च मनश् च चक्षुश् च श्रोत्रं चापानश् च प्राणश् च ।
text: Of the gods there were six M%a<fflrs .• viz., speech and mind and sight and hearing and exhalation and breath.
text_mt: The gods indeed had six udgātṛs: speech, mind, sight, hearing, the downward breath, and breath.

sanskrit_iast: te 'dhriyanta tenodgātrā dīkṣāmahai yenāpahatya mṛtyum apahatya pāpmānaṃ svargaṃ lokam iyāmeti |
meaning: ते ऽध्रियन्त तेनोद्गात्रा दीक्षामहै येनापहत्य मृत्युम् अपहत्य पाप्मानं स्वर्गं लोकम् इयामेति ।
text: They resolved: " Let us consecrate ourselves with that udgdtar by whom, having smitten away death, having smitten away evil, we may go to the heavenly world."
text_mt: They resolved: “Let us consecrate ourselves with that udgātṛ by whom, having struck away death, having struck away evil, we may go to the heavenly world.”

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvan vācodgātrā dīkṣāmahā iti te vācodgātrādīkṣanta sa yad eva vācā vadati tad ātmana āgāyad atha ya itare kāmās tān devebhyaḥ |
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन् वाचोद्गात्रा दीक्षामहा इति ते वाचोद्गात्रादीक्षन्त स यद् एव वाचा वदति तद् आत्मन आगायद् अथ य इतरे कामास् तान् देवेभ्यः ।
text: They said: " Let us consecrate ourselves with speech as udgdtar." They consecrated themselves with speech as udgdtar. What one speaks with speech, that it sang to itself; and what the other desires are, those [it sang] to the gods.
text_mt: They said: “Let us consecrate ourselves with speech as the udgātṛ.” They consecrated themselves with speech as the udgātṛ. Whatever one speaks with speech, that he sang for himself, but whatever other desires there were, those [he sang] for the gods.

sanskrit_iast: tām pāpmānvasṛjyata sa yad eva vācā pāpaṃ vadati sa eva sa pāpmā |
meaning: ताम् पाप्मान्वसृज्यत स यद् एव वाचा पापं वदति स एव स पाप्मा ।
text: Evil was created after it. What evil thing one speaks with speech, that is that evil.
text_mt: Evil attached itself to it. Whatever evil one speaks with speech, that is that very evil.

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvan na vai no 'yam mṛtyuṃ na pāpmānam atyavākṣīt manasodgātrā dikṣāmahā iti |

text: They said: " Verily, this one hath not carried us beyond death, nor beyond evil. Let us consecrate ourselves with the mind as udgdtar."
text_mt: They said: “This one has indeed carried us beyond neither death nor evil. Let us consecrate ourselves with the mind as the udgātṛ.”

sanskrit_iast: te manasodgātrādīkṣanta sa yad eva manasā dhyāyati tad ātmana āgāyad atha ya itare kāmās tān devebhyaḥ |

text_mt: They consecrated themselves with the mind as the udgātṛ. Whatever one thinks with the mind, that he sang for himself, but whatever other desires there were, those [he sang] for the gods.

text_mt: Evil attached itself to it. Whatever evil one thinks with the mind, that is that very evil.

text_mt: They said: “This one has indeed carried us beyond neither death nor evil. Let us consecrate ourselves with the downward breath as the udgātṛ.”

sanskrit_iast: te 'pānenodgātrādīkṣanta sa yad evāpānenāpāniti tad ātmana āgāyad atha ya itare kāmās tān devebhyaḥ |

text: They consecrated themselves with exhalation as udgdtar. What one exhales with exhalation, that it sang to itself; and what the other desires are, those [it sang] to the gods.
text_mt: They consecrated themselves with the downward breath as the udgātṛ. Whatever one breathes out with the downward breath, that he sang for himself, but whatever other desires there were, those [he sang] for the gods.

sanskrit_iast: tam pāpmānvasṛjyata sa yad evāpānena pāpaṃ gandham apāniti sa eva sa pāpmā |
meaning: तम् पाप्मान्वसृज्यत स यद् एवापानेन पापं गन्धम् अपानिति स एव स पाप्मा ।
text: Evil was created after it. What evil odor one exhales with exhalation, that is that evil,
text_mt: Evil attached itself to it. Whatever bad odour one smells with the downward breath, that is that very evil.

text_mt: They said: “This one has indeed carried us beyond neither death nor evil. Let us consecrate ourselves with breath as the udgātṛ.”

sanskrit_iast: te prāṇenodgātrādīkṣanta sa yad eva prāṇena prāṇiti tad ātmana āgāyad atha ya itare kāmās tān devebhyaḥ |

text: They consecrated themselves with breath as udgdtar. What one breathes with breath, that it sang to itself; and what the other desires are, those [it sang] to the gods.
text_mt: They consecrated themselves with breath as the udgātṛ. Whatever one breathes with breath, that he sang for himself, but whatever other desires there were, those [he sang] for the gods.

sanskrit_iast: tam pāpmā nānvasṛjyata na hy etena prāṇena pāpaṃ vadati na pāpaṃ dhyāyati na pāpam paśyati na pāpaṃ śṛṇoti na pāpaṃ gandham apāniti |
meaning: तम् पाप्मा नान्वसृज्यत न ह्य् एतेन प्राणेन पापं वदति न पापं ध्यायति न पापम् पश्यति न पापं शृणोति न पापं गन्धम् अपानिति ।
text: No evil was created after that. For with this breath one speaks no evil thing, thinks no evil thing, sees no evil thing, hears no evil thing, exhales no evil odor.
text_mt: Evil did not attach itself to it. For with this breath one speaks no evil, thinks no evil, sees no evil, hears no evil, and smells no bad odour.

sanskrit_iast: tenāpahatya mṛtyum apahatya pāpmānaṃ svargaṃ lokam āyan apahatya haiva mṛtyum apahatya pāpmānaṃ svargaṃ lokam eti ya evaṃ veda | prathame 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तेनापहत्य मृत्युम् अपहत्य पाप्मानं स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् अपहत्य हैव मृत्युम् अपहत्य पाप्मानं स्वर्गं लोकम् एति य एवं वेद । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: By it having smitten away death, having smitten away evil, they went to the heavenly world. Having smitten away death, having smitten away evil, he who knows thus goes to the heavenly world.
text_mt:
Having struck away death by it, having struck away evil, they went to the heavenly world.
Striking away death indeed, striking away evil, he goes to the heavenly world who knows thus.
First khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sā yā sā vāg āsīt so 'gnir abhavat |
meaning: सा या सा वाग् आसीत् सो ऽग्निर् अभवत् ।
text: What this speech was, that became Agni.
text_mt: Now that speech which was there became Agni.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat tan mana āsīt sa candramā abhavat |
meaning: अथ यत् तन् मन आसीत् स चन्द्रमा अभवत् ।
text: And what this mind was, that became the moon.
text_mt: Then that mind which was there became the Moon.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat tac cakṣur āsīt sa ādityo 'bhavat |
meaning: अथ यत् तच् चक्षुर् आसीत् स आदित्यो ऽभवत् ।
text: And what this sight was, that became the sun.
text_mt: Then that sight which was there became Āditya.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat tac chrotram āsīt tā imā diśo 'bhavan tā u eva viśve devāḥ |
meaning: अथ यत् तच् छ्रोत्रम् आसीत् ता इमा दिशो ऽभवन् ता उ एव विश्वे देवाः ।
text: And what this hearing was, that became these quarters; and these are all the gods.
text_mt:
Then that hearing which was there became these quarters of space;
they indeed are the All-gods.

sanskrit_iast: atha yas so 'pāna āsīt sa bṛhaspatir abhavat yad asyai vāco bṛhatyai patis tasmād bṛhaspatiḥ |
meaning: अथ यस् सो ऽपान आसीत् स बृहस्पतिर् अभवत् यद् अस्यै वाचो बृहत्यै पतिस् तस्माद् बृहस्पतिः ।
text: And what this exhalation was, that became Brhaspati. Because he is the husband (lord, pati) of this great (brhatl) speech, therefore he is [called] Brhaspati.
text_mt:
Then that downward breath which was there became Bṛhaspati;
because it is the lord (pati) of this great (bṛhatī) speech, therefore it is Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: atha yas sa prāṇa āsīt sa prajāpatir abhavat sa eṣa putrī prajāvān udgītho yaḥ prāṇaḥ tasya svara eva prajāḥ prajāvān bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: अथ यस् स प्राण आसीत् स प्रजापतिर् अभवत् स एष पुत्री प्रजावान् उद्गीथो यः प्राणः तस्य स्वर एव प्रजाः प्रजावान् भवति य एवं वेद ।
text: And what this breath was, that became Prajapati. That same, viz. breath, is rich in sons, rich in offspring, the udgītha. Of it tone is the offspring. Rich in offspring becomes he who knows thus.
text_mt:
Then that breath which was there became Prajāpati.
This breath is that udgītha, having sons and having offspring;
its notes are its offspring.
He becomes possessed of offspring who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ haitam eke pratyakṣam eva gāyanti prāṇā3 prāṇā3 prāṇā3 hum bhā ovā iti |
meaning: तं हैतम् एके प्रत्यक्षम् एव गायन्ति प्राणा3 प्राणा3 प्राणा3 हुम् भा ओवा इति ।
text: Some sing that [breath] openly: " Breath, breath, breath, hum, bhd, ovd."
text_mt: Some indeed sing this visibly: ‘prāṇā3, prāṇā3, prāṇā3, hum bhā ovā’.

sanskrit_iast: tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanis tata etam arhati pratyakṣaṃ gātum yad vāva vācā karoti tad etad evāsya kṛtam bhavatīti |
meaning: तद् उ होवाच शाट्यायनिस् तत एतम् अर्हति प्रत्यक्षं गातुम् यद् वाव वाचा करोति तद् एतद् एवास्य कृतम् भवतीति ।
text: And Śatyayani said regarding this: " Therefore it is possible to sing it directly. Verily, what he performs with speech, that same is performed of him."
text_mt:
Regarding this, Śāṭyāyani said: 'On that account he is worthy to sing it visibly;
for whatever he does with speech, that very thing becomes accomplished for him.'

sanskrit_iast: atha vā ata ṛksāmnor eva prajātiḥ sa yad dhiṅkaroty abhy eva tena krandati atha yat prastauty aiva tena plavate atha yad ādim ādatte reta eva tena siñcati atha yad udgāyati reta eva tena siktaṃ sambhāvayati atha yat pratiharati reta eva tena sambhūtam pravardhayati atha yad upadravati reta eva tena pravṛddhaṃ vikaroti atha yan nidhanam upaiti reta eva tena vikṛtam prajanayati saiṣa rksāmnoḥ prajātiḥ |
meaning: अथ वा अत ऋक्साम्नोर् एव प्रजातिः स यद् धिङ्करोत्य् अभ्य् एव तेन क्रन्दति अथ यत् प्रस्तौत्य् ऐव तेन प्लवते अथ यद् आदिम् आदत्ते रेत एव तेन सिञ्चति अथ यद् उद्गायति रेत एव तेन सिक्तं सम्भावयति अथ यत् प्रतिहरति रेत एव तेन सम्भूतम् प्रवर्धयति अथ यद् उपद्रवति रेत एव तेन प्रवृद्धं विकरोति अथ यन् निधनम् उपैति रेत एव तेन विकृतम् प्रजनयति सैष र्क्साम्नोः प्रजातिः ।
text: Now [about] the generation of the re and the sāman. In that he utters the hinkdra, thereby he cries to [her]. In that he utters the prastāva, thereby he mounts. In that he utters the ddi, thereby he emits seed. In that he utters the udgītha, thereby he causes the emitted seed to come to life. In that he utters the pratihāra, thereby he causes the seed, come to life, to grow forth. In that he utters the upadrava, he develops the seed, having grown forth. In that he enters upon the nidhana, thereby he causes the seed, being unfolded, to be born forth. That is the generation of the re and of the sdm,an.

sanskrit_iast: sa ya evam etām ṛksāmnoḥ prajātiṃ veda pra hainam ṛksāmanī janayataḥ | prathame 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | prathamo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: स य एवम् एताम् ऋक्साम्नोः प्रजातिं वेद प्र हैनम् ऋक्सामनी जनयतः । प्रथमे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः । प्रथमो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: He who thus knows this generation of the re and of the sdtnan, him the re and the sāman propagate.
text_mt:
He who knows thus this procreation of ṛc and sāman, ṛc and sāman propagate him.
Second khaṇḍa in the first anuvāka.
The first anuvāka is completed.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa evedam agra āsīd ya eṣa tapati sa eṣa sarveṣām bhūtānāṃ tejo hara indriyaṃ vīryam ādāyordhva udakrāmat |
meaning: एष एवेदम् अग्र आसीद् य एष तपति स एष सर्वेषाम् भूतानां तेजो हर इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आदायोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् ।
text: This [universe] in the beginning was he who burns here. This same, taking the splendor, the grasp, the vitality, the virility of all beings, went upward..
text_mt:
He indeed who burns here was this [universe] in the beginning;
he, having taken the fiery brilliance, glow, faculty, and vigor of all beings, stepped upward.

sanskrit_iast: so 'kāmayataikam evākṣaraṃ svādu mṛdu devānāṃ vanāmeti |
meaning: सो ऽकामयतैकम् एवाक्षरं स्वादु मृदु देवानां वनामेति ।
text: He desired: " May we win the one sweet soft syllable of the gods."
text_mt: He desired: 'May I win the one syllable, sweet and gentle, of the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: sa tapo 'tapyata sa tapas taptvaikam evākṣaram abhavat |
meaning: स तपो ऽतप्यत स तपस् तप्त्वैकम् एवाक्षरम् अभवत् ।
text: He performed penance. He having performed penance became the one syllable.
text_mt:
He performed heat [of austerity];
having performed heat, he became the one syllable.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ devāś ca rṣayaś copasamaipsan athaiṣo 'surān bhūtahano 'sṛjataitasya pāpmano 'nanvāgamāya |
meaning: तं देवाश् च र्षयश् चोपसमैप्सन् अथैषो ऽसुरान् भूतहनो ऽसृजतैतस्य पाप्मनो ऽनन्वागमाय ।
text: That gods and sages desired together to obtain. Then he created creature-slaying Asuras, in order to prevent evil from going after.
text_mt:
The gods and ṛṣis desired to reach it;
then he created the asuras, slayers of beings, so that this evil should not pursue [him].

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vācopasamaipsan te vācaṃ samārohan teṣāṃ vācam paryādatta tasmāt paryādattā vāk satyaṃ ca hy enayā vadaty anṛtaṃ ca |
meaning: तं वाचोपसमैप्सन् ते वाचं समारोहन् तेषां वाचम् पर्यादत्त तस्मात् पर्यादत्ता वाक् सत्यं च ह्य् एनया वदत्य् अनृतं च ।
text: That they desired together to obtain by speech. They ascended speech together. He took possession of their speech. Therefore speech is taken possession of; for [what is] true one speaks with it and [what is] untrue.

sanskrit_iast: tam manasopasamaipsan te manas samārohan teṣām manaḥ paryādatta tasmāt paryādattam manas puṇyaṃ ca hy enena dhyāyati pāpaṃ ca |
meaning: तम् मनसोपसमैप्सन् ते मनस् समारोहन् तेषाम् मनः पर्यादत्त तस्मात् पर्यादत्तम् मनस् पुण्यं च ह्य् एनेन ध्यायति पापं च ।
text: That they desired together to obtain by mind. They ascended mind together. He took possession of their mind. Therefore mind is taken possession of; for [what is] good one thinks with it and [what is] evil.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ cakṣuṣopasamaipsan te cakṣus samārohan tesāṃ cakṣuḥ paryādatta tasmāt paryāttaṃ cakṣuḥ darśanīyaṃ ca hy enena paśyaty adarśanīyaṃ ca |
meaning: तं चक्षुषोपसमैप्सन् ते चक्षुस् समारोहन् तेसां चक्षुः पर्यादत्त तस्मात् पर्यात्तं चक्षुः दर्शनीयं च ह्य् एनेन पश्यत्य् अदर्शनीयं च ।
text: That they desired together to obtain by sight. They ascended sight together. He took possession of their sight. Therefore sight is taken possession of; for [what is] seemly one sees with it and [what is] unseemly,

sanskrit_iast: taṃ śrotreṇopasamaipsan te śrotraṃ samārohan teṣāṃ śrotram paryādatta tasmāt paryāttaṃ śrotram śravaṇīyaṃ cainena śṛṇoty aśravaṇīyaṃ ca |
meaning: तं श्रोत्रेणोपसमैप्सन् ते श्रोत्रं समारोहन् तेषां श्रोत्रम् पर्यादत्त तस्मात् पर्यात्तं श्रोत्रम् श्रवणीयं चैनेन शृणोत्य् अश्रवणीयं च ।
text: That they desired together to obtain by hearing. They ascended hearing together. He took possession of their hearing. Therefore hearing is taken possession of. For [what is] worth hearing one hears with it and [what is] not worth hearing.

sanskrit_iast: tam apānenopasamaipsan te 'pānaṃ samārohan teṣām apānam paryādatta tasmāt paryātto 'pānaḥ surabhi ca hy enena jighrati durgandhi ca |
meaning: तम् अपानेनोपसमैप्सन् ते ऽपानं समारोहन् तेषाम् अपानम् पर्यादत्त तस्मात् पर्यात्तो ऽपानः सुरभि च ह्य् एनेन जिघ्रति दुर्गन्धि च ।
text: That they desired together to obtain by exhalation. They ascended exhalation together. He took possession of their exhalation. Therefore exhalation is taken possession of; for fragrance one smells with it and bad odor.

sanskrit_iast: tam prāṇenopasamaipsan tam prāṇenopasamāpnuvan |
meaning: तम् प्राणेनोपसमैप्सन् तम् प्राणेनोपसमाप्नुवन् ।
text: That they desired together to obtain by breath. That they obtained together by breath,
text_mt:
They desired to reach it through breath;
they reached it through breath.

sanskrit_iast: athāsurā bhūtahana ādravan mohayiṣyāma iti manyamānāḥ |
meaning: अथासुरा भूतहन आद्रवन् मोहयिष्याम इति मन्यमानाः ।
text: Then the creature-slaying Asuras ran unto [themj, thinking: " We will confound [them]." is. — I. 60. 8., is. = I. 60. ».
text_mt: Then the asuras, slayers of beings, ran up, thinking: 'We will cause confusion.'

sanskrit_iast: sa yathāśmānam ṛtvā loṣṭo vidhvaṃsetaivam evāsurā vyadhvaṃsanta sa eṣo 'śmākhaṇo yat prāṇaḥ |
meaning: स यथाश्मानम् ऋत्वा लोष्टो विध्वंसेतैवम् एवासुरा व्यध्वंसन्त स एषो ऽश्माखणो यत् प्राणः ।
text_mt:
Just as a clod of earth having struck a stone would shatter, so indeed the asuras shattered;
that breath is this solid stone.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathāśmānam ākhaṇam ṛtvā loṣṭo vidhvaṃsata evam eva sa vidhvaṃsate ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati | dvitīye 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स यथाश्मानम् आखणम् ऋत्वा लोष्टो विध्वंसत एवम् एव स विध्वंसते य एवं विद्वांसम् उपवदति । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text_mt:
Just as a clod of earth having struck a solid stone shatters, so indeed shatters he who speaks ill against one who knows thus.
First khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa vaśī dīptāgra udgītho yat prāṇaḥ eṣa hīdaṃ sarvaṃ vaśe kurute |
meaning: स एष वशी दीप्ताग्र उद्गीथो यत् प्राणः एष हीदं सर्वं वशे कुरुते ।
text: That same, viz. breath, is the controling flame-pointed udgitha. For it gets this all into control.
text_mt:
That breath is this controlling udgītha with a blazing point;
for this brings all this under control.

sanskrit_iast: vaśī bhavati vaśe svān kurute ya evaṃ veda asya hy asāv agre dīpyate3 amuṣya vā saḥ |
meaning: वशी भवति वशे स्वान् कुरुते य एवं वेद अस्य ह्य् असाव् अग्रे दीप्यते3 अमुष्य वा सः ।
text: He becomes controling, he gets his people into control who knows thus; for does yonder one flame at this one's point or this one at yonder one's?
text_mt:
He becomes a controller and brings his own under control who knows thus;
for his [point] blazes yonder at the top, or that [blazes] of yonder one.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ haitam udgīthaṃ śāṭyāyanir ācaṣṭe vaśī dīptāgra iti dīptāgrā ha vā asya kīrtir bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: तं हैतम् उद्गीथं शाट्यायनिर् आचष्टे वशी दीप्ताग्र इति दीप्ताग्रा ह वा अस्य कीर्तिर् भवति य एवं वेद ।
text: That same udgitha ^Śtyayani calls 'the controling one, the flame-pointed one.' Verily flame-pointed becomes his fame who knows thus.
text_mt:
Śāṭyāyani proclaims this udgītha as 'controlling, with a blazing point';
blazing at the point indeed becomes the fame of him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: ābhūtir iti kārīrādayaḥ prāṇaṃ vā anu prajāḥ paśava ābhavanti sa ya evam etam ābhūtir ity upāsta aiva prāṇena prajayā paśubhir bhavati |
meaning: आभूतिर् इति कारीरादयः प्राणं वा अनु प्रजाः पशव आभवन्ति स य एवम् एतम् आभूतिर् इत्य् उपास्त ऐव प्राणेन प्रजया पशुभिर् भवति ।
text: The Kariradis [call it] 'existence' (dbhuti). Verily, along with breath offspring and domestic animals exist. Whoso thus worships it as existence, with breath, with offspring, with domestic animals he exists.

sanskrit_iast: sambhūtir iti sātyayajñayaḥ prāṇaṃ vā anu prajāḥ paśavas sambhavanti sa ya evam etaṃ sambhūtir ity upāste sam eva prāṇena prajayā paśubhir bhavati |
meaning: सम्भूतिर् इति सात्ययज्ञयः प्राणं वा अनु प्रजाः पशवस् सम्भवन्ति स य एवम् एतं सम्भूतिर् इत्य् उपास्ते सम् एव प्राणेन प्रजया पशुभिर् भवति ।
text: The SatyayajSis [call it] ' origination' (sambhuti). Verily, along with breath offspring and domestic animals originate. Whoso thus worships it as origination, with breath, with offspring, with domestic animals he originates.

sanskrit_iast: prabhūtir iti śailanāḥ prāṇaṃ vā anu prajāḥ paśavaḥ prabhavanti sa ya evam etam prabhūtir ity upāste praiva prāṇena prajayā paśubhir bhavati |
meaning: प्रभूतिर् इति शैलनाः प्राणं वा अनु प्रजाः पशवः प्रभवन्ति स य एवम् एतम् प्रभूतिर् इत्य् उपास्ते प्रैव प्राणेन प्रजया पशुभिर् भवति ।
text: The Śailanas [call it] 'prevalence' (prabhuti). Verily, along with bi-eath offspring and domestic animals prevail. Whoso thus worships it as prevalence, with breath, with offspring, with domestic animals he prevails.

sanskrit_iast: bhūtir iti bhāllabinaḥ prāṇaṃ vā anu prajāḥ paśavo bhavanti sa ya evam etam bhūtir ity upāste bhavaty eva prāṇena prajayā paśubhiḥ |
meaning: भूतिर् इति भाल्लबिनः प्राणं वा अनु प्रजाः पशवो भवन्ति स य एवम् एतम् भूतिर् इत्य् उपास्ते भवत्य् एव प्राणेन प्रजया पशुभिः ।
text: The Bhallabins [call it] 'coming into being' {bhiUi). Verily, along with breath offspring and domestic animals come into being. Whoso thus worships it as coming into being, with breath, with offspring, with domestic animals he comes into being.

sanskrit_iast: aparodho 'naparuddha iti pārṣṇaś śailanaḥ eṣa hy anyam aparuṇaddhi naitam anyaḥ eṣa ha vāsya dviṣantam bhrātṛvyam aparuṇaddhi ya evaṃ veda | dvitīye 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: अपरोधो ऽनपरुद्ध इति पार्ष्णश् शैलनः एष ह्य् अन्यम् अपरुणद्धि नैतम् अन्यः एष ह वास्य द्विषन्तम् भ्रातृव्यम् अपरुणद्धि य एवं वेद । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: Parsna Śs^ilana "calls it] 'the unexcluded exclusion.' For it excludes another, but] another [does] not [exclude] it. Verily, it excludes the hateful rival of him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: ekavīra ity āruṇeyaḥ eko hy evaiṣa vīro yat prāṇaḥ ā hāsyaiko vīro vīryavāñ jāyate ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: एकवीर इत्य् आरुणेयः एको ह्य् एवैष वीरो यत् प्राणः आ हास्यैको वीरो वीर्यवाञ् जायते य एवं वेद ।
text: Aruneya [calls it] ' sole hero.' For that, viz. breath, is sole hero. Of him a sole hero, rich in heroism, is born who knows thus. s. Śaikitaneya [calls it] ' having one son.' For that, viz. breath, is the only son.

sanskrit_iast: ekaputra iti caikitāneyaḥ eko hy evaiṣa putro yat prāṇaḥ |
meaning: एकपुत्र इति चैकितानेयः एको ह्य् एवैष पुत्रो यत् प्राणः ।
text_mt:
'Having one son,' says Caikitāneya;
for breath is the only son.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva dviputra iti dvau hi prāṇāpānau |
meaning: स उ एव द्विपुत्र इति द्वौ हि प्राणापानौ ।
text: It is also having two sons. For breath and exhalation are two.
text_mt:
'He is indeed having two sons';
for the out-breath and the downward breath are two.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva triputra iti trayo hi prāṇo 'pāno vyānaḥ |
meaning: स उ एव त्रिपुत्र इति त्रयो हि प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानः ।
text: It is also having three sons. For breath, exhalation, and vydna are three.
text_mt:
'He is indeed having three sons';
for the out-breath, downward breath, and diffused breath are three.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva catuṣputra iti catvāro hi prāṇo 'pāno vyānas samānaḥ |
meaning: स उ एव चतुष्पुत्र इति चत्वारो हि प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानस् समानः ।
text: It is also having four sons. E'er breath, exhalation, vydna, [and] samdna are four.
text_mt:
'He is indeed having four sons';
for the out-breath, downward breath, diffused breath, and equalizing breath are four.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva pañcaputra iti pañca hi prāṇo 'pāno vyānas samāno 'vānaḥ |
meaning: स उ एव पञ्चपुत्र इति पञ्च हि प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानस् समानो ऽवानः ।
text: It is also having five sons. For breath, exhalation, vydna, samdna, [and] avdna are five.
text_mt:
'He is indeed having five sons';
for the out-breath, downward breath, diffused breath, equalizing breath, and lower breath are five.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva ṣaṭputra iti ṣaḍ ḍhi prāṇo 'pāno vyānas samāno 'vāna udānaḥ |
meaning: स उ एव षट्पुत्र इति षड् ढि प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानस् समानो ऽवान उदानः ।
text: It is also having six sons. For breath, exhalation, vydna, samdna, avdna, [and] uddna are six.
text_mt:
'He is indeed having six sons';
for the out-breath, downward breath, diffused breath, equalizing breath, lower breath, and upward breath are six.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva saptaputra iti sapta hīme śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ |
meaning: स उ एव सप्तपुत्र इति सप्त हीमे शीर्षण्याः प्राणाः ।
text: It is also having seven sons. For these breaths in the head are seven.
text_mt:
'He is indeed having seven sons';
for these breaths in the head are seven.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva navaputra iti sapta hi śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇā dvāv avāñcau |
meaning: स उ एव नवपुत्र इति सप्त हि शीर्षण्याः प्राणा द्वाव् अवाञ्चौ ।
text: It is also having nine sons. For there are seven breaths in the head [and] two downward ones.
text_mt:
'He is indeed having nine sons';
for the breaths in the head are seven, and two are downward.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva daśaputra iti sapta śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇā dvāv avāñcau nābhyāṃ daśamaḥ |
meaning: स उ एव दशपुत्र इति सप्त शीर्षण्याः प्राणा द्वाव् अवाञ्चौ नाभ्यां दशमः ।
text: It is also having ten sons. For there are seven breaths in thehead, two downward ones, [and] the tenth in the navel,
text_mt:
'He is indeed having ten sons';
for the breaths in the head are seven, two are downward, and the tenth is at the navel.

sanskrit_iast: sa u eva bahuputra iti etasya hīyaṃ sarvāḥ prajāḥ |
meaning: स उ एव बहुपुत्र इति एतस्य हीयं सर्वाः प्रजाः ।
text: It is also having many sons. For this [earth] is all its offspring,
text_mt:
'He is indeed having many sons';
for all these offspring belong to this one.

sanskrit_iast: etaṃ ha sma vai tad udgīthaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ pūrve brāhmaṇāḥ kāmāgāyina āhuḥ kati te putrān āgāsyāma iti | dvitīye 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: एतं ह स्म वै तद् उद्गीथं विद्वांसः पूर्वे ब्राह्मणाः कामागायिन आहुः कति ते पुत्रान् आगास्याम इति । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः ।
text: Verily, knowing thus this udgitha, the Brahmans of old when they sang a wish [to any one] used to say: " How many sons shall we sing unto thee?"
text_mt:
Knowing this udgītha, the ancient Brahmins singing for desires used to say: 'How many sons shall we sing into being for you?'
Third khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyād ekam ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha iti vidvān ekam manasā dhyāyet eko hi prāṇaḥ eko hāsyājāyate |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयाद् एकम् म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इति विद्वान् एकम् मनसा ध्यायेत् एको हि प्राणः एको हास्याजायते ।
text: If he should say: "Sing one unto me," knowing that breath is the udgitha, he should think one with his mind. For breath is one. Truly, one is born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for one [son]”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on one.
For breath is one.
One [son] indeed is born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyād dvau ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvān dvau manasā dhyāyet dvau hi prāṇāpānau dvau haivāsyājāyete |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयाद् द्वौ म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वान् द्वौ मनसा ध्यायेत् द्वौ हि प्राणापानौ द्वौ हैवास्याजायेते ।
text: If he should say: " Sing two unto me," knowing that breath is the udg'Uha, he should think two with his mind. For breath and exhalation are two. Truly, two are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for two”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on two.
For out-breath and in-breath are two.
Two indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyāt trīn ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvāṃs trīn manasā dhyāyet trayo hi prāṇo 'pāno vyānaḥ trayo haivāsyājāyante |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयात् त्रीन् म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वांस् त्रीन् मनसा ध्यायेत् त्रयो हि प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानः त्रयो हैवास्याजायन्ते ।
text: If he should say: " Sing three unto me," knowing that breath is the udg'Uha, "he should think three with his mind. For breath, exhalation, [and] oydna are three. Truly, three are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for three”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on three.
For breath, out-breath, and diffused breath are three.
Three indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyāc caturo ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvāṃś caturo manasā dhyāyet catvāro hi prāṇo 'pāno vyānas samānaḥ catvāro haivāsyājāyante |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयाच् चतुरो म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वांश् चतुरो मनसा ध्यायेत् चत्वारो हि प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानस् समानः चत्वारो हैवास्याजायन्ते ।
text: If he should say: " Sing four unto me," knowing that breath is the udgUha, he should think four with his mind. For breath, exhalation, vydna, [and] samdna are four. Truly, four are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for four”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on four.
For breath, out-breath, diffused breath, and equalized breath are four.
Four indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyāt pañca ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvān pañca manasā dhyāyet pañca hi prāṇo 'pāno vyānas samāno 'vānaḥ pañca haivāsyājāyante |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयात् पञ्च म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वान् पञ्च मनसा ध्यायेत् पञ्च हि प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानस् समानो ऽवानः पञ्च हैवास्याजायन्ते ।
text: If he should say: "Sing five unto me," knowing that breath is the udg'Uha, he should think five with his mind. For breath, exhalation, vydna, samdna, [and] avdna are five. Truly five are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for five”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on five.
For breath, out-breath, diffused breath, equalized breath, and downward breath are five.
Five indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyāt ṣaṇ ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvān ṣaṇ manasā dhyāyet ṣaḍ ḍhi prāṇo 'pāno vyānas samāno 'vāna udānaḥ ṣaḍ ḍhaivāsyājāyante |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयात् षण् म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वान् षण् मनसा ध्यायेत् षड् ढि प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानस् समानो ऽवान उदानः षड् ढैवास्याजायन्ते ।
text: If he should say: " Sing six unto me," knowing that breath is the udgitha, he should think six with his mind. For breath, exhalation, vydna, samdna, avdna, uddna are six. Truly, six are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for six”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on six.
For breath, out-breath, diffused breath, equalized breath, downward breath, and upward breath are six.
Six indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyāt sapta ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvān sapta manasā dhyāyet sapta hīme śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ sapta haivāsyājāyante |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयात् सप्त म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वान् सप्त मनसा ध्यायेत् सप्त हीमे शीर्षण्याः प्राणाः सप्त हैवास्याजायन्ते ।
text: If he should say: " Sing seven unto me," knowing that breath is the udgitha, he should think seven with his mind. For these breaths in the head are seven. Truly, seven are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for seven”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on seven.
For these breaths in the head are seven.
Seven indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyān nava ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvān nava manasā dhyāyet sapta śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇā dvāv avāñcau nava haivāsyājāyante |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयान् नव म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वान् नव मनसा ध्यायेत् सप्त शीर्षण्याः प्राणा द्वाव् अवाञ्चौ नव हैवास्याजायन्ते ।
text: If he should say: " Sing nine unto me," knowing that breath is the udgitha, he should think nine with his mind. There are seven breaths in the head [and] two downward ones. Truly, nine are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for nine”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on nine.
Seven are the breaths in the head, two are downward.
Nine indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyād daśa ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvān daśa manasā dhyāyet sapta śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇā dvāv avāñcau nābhyāṃ daśamaḥ daśa haivāsyājāyante |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयाद् दश म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वान् दश मनसा ध्यायेत् सप्त शीर्षण्याः प्राणा द्वाव् अवाञ्चौ नाभ्यां दशमः दश हैवास्याजायन्ते ।
text: If he should say: " Sing ten unto me," knowing that breath is the udgitha, he should think ten with his mind. There are seven breaths in the head, two downward ones, [and] the tenth in the navel. Truly, ten are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for ten”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on ten.
Seven are the breaths in the head, two downward, the tenth is at the navel.
Ten indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi brūyāt sahasram ma āgāyeti prāṇa udgītha ity eva vidvān sahasram manasā dhyāyet sahasraṃ haita ādityaraśmayaḥ te 'sya putrāḥ sahasraṃ haivāsyājāyante |
meaning: स यदि ब्रूयात् सहस्रम् म आगायेति प्राण उद्गीथ इत्य् एव विद्वान् सहस्रम् मनसा ध्यायेत् सहस्रं हैत आदित्यरश्मयः ते ऽस्य पुत्राः सहस्रं हैवास्याजायन्ते ।
text: If he should say: " Sing a thousand for me," knowing that breath is the udgitha, he should think a thousand with his mind. Truly, a thousand are the rays of the sun. They are its sons. Truly, a thousand are born unto him.
text_mt:
If he should say: “Chant for me for a thousand”, knowing that breath is the udgītha, he should mentally focus on a thousand.
A thousand indeed are these rays of the sun;
they are his sons.
A thousand indeed are born to him.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ haivaitam udgītham para āṭṇāraḥ kakṣīvāṃs trasadasyur iti pūrve mahārājāś śrotriyās sahasraputram upaniṣeduḥ te ha sarva eva sahasraputrā āsuḥ |
meaning: एवं हैवैतम् उद्गीथम् पर आट्णारः कक्षीवांस् त्रसदस्युर् इति पूर्वे महाराजाश् श्रोत्रियास् सहस्रपुत्रम् उपनिषेदुः ते ह सर्व एव सहस्रपुत्रा आसुः ।
text: Para Atnara, Kaksivant, Trasadasyu, great kings of old, scholars in sacred lore, thus studied this same udgitha of a thousand sons. All of them had a thousand sons. He who knows thus, of him there come to be a thousand sons.
text_mt:
Thus indeed Para Āṭṇāra, Kakṣīvant, and Trasadasyu—these ancient great kings learned in the Veda—sat near this udgītha of a thousand sons.
They all indeed had a thousand sons.

sanskrit_iast: sa ya evaivaṃ veda sahasraṃ haivāsya putrā bhavanti | dvitīye 'nuvāke caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | dvitīyo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: स य एवैवं वेद सहस्रं हैवास्य पुत्रा भवन्ति । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके चतुर्थः खण्डः । द्वितीयो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: '6Ai. *dhe. Śb. dva. "B. ta. "Tta. '^^'fig, ^Śyad.
text_mt:
He who knows thus—a thousand sons indeed come to be his.
Fourth khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.
The second anuvāka is completed.

sanskrit_iast: śaryāto vai mānavaḥ prācyāṃ sthalyām ayajata tasmin ha bhūtāny udgīthe 'pitvam eṣire |
meaning: शर्यातो वै मानवः प्राच्यां स्थल्याम् अयजत तस्मिन् ह भूतान्य् उद्गीथे ऽपित्वम् एषिरे ।
text: 9*ryata Manava made a sacrifice on the eastern site. With him created beings sought a share in the udgītha.
text_mt:
Śaryāta Mānava sacrificed on an eastern mound.
At that, the creatures desired a share in the udgītha.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ devā bṛhaspatinodgātrā dīkṣāmahā iti purastād āgacchann ayaṃ ta udgāyatv iti bambenājadviṣeṇa pitaro dakṣiṇato 'yaṃ ta udgāyatv ity uśanasā kāvyenāsurāḥ paścād ayaṃ ta udgāyatv ity ayāsyenāṅgirasena manuṣyā uttarato 'yaṃ ta udgāyatv iti |
meaning: तं देवा बृहस्पतिनोद्गात्रा दीक्षामहा इति पुरस्ताद् आगच्छन्न् अयं त उद्गायत्व् इति बम्बेनाजद्विषेण पितरो दक्षिणतो ऽयं त उद्गायत्व् इत्य् उशनसा काव्येनासुराः पश्चाद् अयं त उद्गायत्व् इत्य् अयास्येनाङ्गिरसेन मनुष्या उत्तरतो ऽयं त उद्गायत्व् इति ।
text: Unto him the gods came from the east (front) [saying]: " Let us consecrate ourselves with Brhaspati as udgdtar. Let this one sing the udgliha for thee." With Bamba Ajadvisa the Fathers [came] from the south (right)' [saying]: " Let this one sing the udgītha for thee." With Uganas Kavya the Asuras [came] from the west (rear) [saying]: " Let this one sing the udgītha for thee." With Ayasya Angirasa men [came] from the north (left) [saying]: " Let this one sing the udgītha for thee."
text_mt:
The gods came from the east [saying], “Let us consecrate with Bṛhaspati as udgātṛ; let this one chant for you.”
The ancestors came from the south [saying], “With Bamba Ājadviṣa; let this one chant for you.”
The asuras came from the west [saying], “With Uśanas Kāvya; let this one chant for you.”
Men came from the north [saying], “With Ayāsya Āṅgirasa; let this one chant for you.”

sanskrit_iast: sa hekṣāṃ cakre hantainān pṛcchāni kiyato vā eka īśe kiyata ekaḥ kiyata eka iti |
meaning: स हेक्षां चक्रे हन्तैनान् पृच्छानि कियतो वा एक ईशे कियत एकः कियत एक इति ।
text: He considered: " Come now, I will ask them how great the power of the one is, how great the power of the other is, how great the power of the other (third) is."
text_mt: He reflected: “Come, let me ask them: Over how much does one rule? Over how much one? Over how much one?”

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca bṛhaspatiṃ yan me tvam udgāyeḥ kiṃ tatas syād iti |
meaning: स होवाच बृहस्पतिं यन् मे त्वम् उद्गायेः किं ततस् स्याद् इति ।
text: He said to Brhaspati: " If thou shouldst sing the udgītha for me, what would be the result of it?" &. He said: " Among the gods there would be fortune, among the gods dominion, and I should cause thee to go to the heavenly world."
text_mt: He said to Bṛhaspati: “If you were to chant for me, what would result from it?”

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca deveṣv eva śrīs syād deveṣv īśā svargam u tvāṃ lokaṃ gamayeyam iti |
meaning: स होवाच देवेष्व् एव श्रीस् स्याद् देवेष्व् ईशा स्वर्गम् उ त्वां लोकं गमयेयम् इति ।
text_mt: He said: “Prosperity would belong only to the gods; rule would belong to the gods; and you I would bring to the heavenly world.”

sanskrit_iast: atha hovāca bambam ājadviṣam yan me tvam udgāyeḥ kiṃ tatas syād iti |
meaning: अथ होवाच बम्बम् आजद्विषम् यन् मे त्वम् उद्गायेः किं ततस् स्याद् इति ।
text: Then he said to Bamba Ajadvisa: " If thou shouldst sing the udgītha for me, what would be the result of it?"
text_mt: Then he said to Bamba Ājadviṣa: “If you were to chant for me, what would result from it?”

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca pitṛṣv eva śrīs syāt pitṛṣv īśā svargam u tvāṃ lokaṃ gamayeyam iti |
meaning: स होवाच पितृष्व् एव श्रीस् स्यात् पितृष्व् ईशा स्वर्गम् उ त्वां लोकं गमयेयम् इति ।
text: He said: " Among the Fathers there would be fortune, among the Fathers dominion, and I should cause thee to go to the heavenly world."
text_mt: He said: “Prosperity would belong only to the ancestors; rule would belong to the ancestors; and you I would bring to the heavenly world.”

sanskrit_iast: atha hovācośanasaṃ kāvyaṃ yan me tvam udgāyeḥ kiṃ tatas syād iti |
meaning: अथ होवाचोशनसं काव्यं यन् मे त्वम् उद्गायेः किं ततस् स्याद् इति ।
text: Then he said to U9anas Kavya: "If thou shouldst sing the udgītha for me, what would be the result of it?"
text_mt: Then he said to Uśanas Kāvya: “If you were to chant for me, what would result from it?”

sanskrit_iast: sa hovācāsureṣv eva śrīs syād asureṣv īśā svargam u tvāṃ lokaṃ gamayeyam iti |
meaning: स होवाचासुरेष्व् एव श्रीस् स्याद् असुरेष्व् ईशा स्वर्गम् उ त्वां लोकं गमयेयम् इति ।
text: He said: " Among the Asuras there would be fortune, among the Asuras dominion, and I should cause thee to go to the heavenly world."
text_mt: He said: “Prosperity would belong only to the asuras; rule would belong to the asuras; and you I would bring to the heavenly world.”

sanskrit_iast: atha hovācāyāsyam āṅgirasaṃ yan me tvam udgāyeḥ kiṃ tatas syād iti |
meaning: अथ होवाचायास्यम् आङ्गिरसं यन् मे त्वम् उद्गायेः किं ततस् स्याद् इति ।
text: Then he said to Ayasya Aiigirasa: "If thou shouldst sing the udgUha forme, what would be the result of it?"
text_mt: Then he said to Ayāsya Āṅgirasa: “If you were to chant for me, what would result from it?”

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca devān eva devaloke dadhyām manuṣyān manuṣyaloke pitṝn pitṛloke nudeyāsmāl lokād asurān svargam u tvāṃ lokaṃ gamayeyam iti | tṛtīte 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स होवाच देवान् एव देवलोके दध्याम् मनुष्यान् मनुष्यलोके पितॄन् पितृलोके नुदेयास्माल् लोकाद् असुरान् स्वर्गम् उ त्वां लोकं गमयेयम् इति । तृतीते ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: He said: " I should place the gods in the world of the gods, men in the world of men, the Fathers in the world of the Fathers; I should push the Asuras away from this world; and I should cause thee to go to the heavenly world."
text_mt:
He said: “The gods I would place in the world of the gods, men in the world of men, the ancestors in the world of the ancestors; the asuras I would drive away from this world; and you I would bring to the heavenly world.”
First khaṇḍa in the third anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca tvam me bhagava udgāya ya etasya sarvasya yaśo 'sīti |
meaning: स होवाच त्वम् मे भगव उद्गाय य एतस्य सर्वस्य यशो ऽसीति ।
text: He (9.) said: " Sing thou, reverend sir, the udgītha for me, who art the glory of this all."
text_mt: He said: “Venerable sir, chant for me, you who [are] the glory of this all!”

sanskrit_iast: tasya hāyāsya evojjagau tasmād udgātā vṛta uttarato niveśanaṃ lipseta etad dha nāruddhaṃ niveśanaṃ yad uttarataḥ |
meaning: तस्य हायास्य एवोज्जगौ तस्माद् उद्गाता वृत उत्तरतो निवेशनं लिप्सेत एतद् ध नारुद्धं निवेशनं यद् उत्तरतः ।
text: Of him Ayasya sang the udgītha. Therefore an udgdtar, when chosen, should desire to take his resting-place in the north (left). For that restingplace which is in the north is not obstructed,
text_mt:
Ayāsya indeed chanted for him.
Therefore, an udgātṛ once chosen should seek a lodging to the north.
For that is an unobjectionable lodging which is to the north.

sanskrit_iast: uttarata āgato 'yāsya āṅgirasaś śaryātasya mānavasyojjagau sa prāṇena devān devaloke 'dadhād apānena manuṣyān manuṣyaloke vyānena pitṝn pitṛloke hiṅkāreṇa vajreṇāsmāl lokād asurān anudata |
meaning: उत्तरत आगतो ऽयास्य आङ्गिरसश् शर्यातस्य मानवस्योज्जगौ स प्राणेन देवान् देवलोके ऽदधाद् अपानेन मनुष्यान् मनुष्यलोके व्यानेन पितॄन् पितृलोके हिङ्कारेण वज्रेणास्माल् लोकाद् असुरान् अनुदत ।
text: Having come from the north, Ayasya Angirasa sang the udgītha of ^Śryata Manava. By breath he placed the gods in the world of the gods, by exhalation men in the world of men, by the vydna the Fathers in the world of the Fathers, by the hinkdra [as] thunderbolt he pushed the Asuras away from this world.
text_mt:
Ayāsya Āṅgirasa, having arrived from the north, chanted for Śaryāta Mānava.
With breath he placed the gods in the world of the gods, with out-breath men in the world of men, with diffused breath the ancestors in the world of the ancestors, and with the hiṅkāra as a thunderbolt he drove the asuras away from this world.

sanskrit_iast: tān hovāca dūraṃ gacchateti sa dūro ha nāma lokaḥ taṃ ha jagmuḥ ta ete 'surā asambhāvyam parābhūtāḥ |
meaning: तान् होवाच दूरं गच्छतेति स दूरो ह नाम लोकः तं ह जग्मुः त एते ऽसुरा असम्भाव्यम् पराभूताः ।
text: He said to them: " Go ye afar." That is a world named ' afar.' They went to it. These same Asuras were irretrievably defeated,
text_mt:
He said to them: “Go far away!”
Far away is indeed the name of that world;
to that they went.
These asuras were defeated beyond restoration.

sanskrit_iast: chandobhir eva vācā śaryātam mānavaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayāṃ cakāra |
meaning: छन्दोभिर् एव वाचा शर्यातम् मानवं स्वर्गं लोकं गमयां चकार ।
text: By the metres, by speech, he caused paryata Manava to go to the heavenly world.
text_mt: Through the metres, through speech alone, he made Śaryāta Mānava attain the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: te hocur asurā eta taṃ vedāma yo no 'yam ittham adhatteti tata āgacchan tam etyāpaśyan |
meaning: ते होचुर् असुरा एत तं वेदाम यो नो ऽयम् इत्थम् अधत्तेति तत आगच्छन् तम् एत्यापश्यन् ।
text: These Asuras said: " Come, let us know him who placed us thus." Thereupon they came. Having come, they saw him.

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvann ayaṃ vā āsya iti yad abruvann ayaṃ vā āsya iti tasmād ayamāsyaḥ ayamāsyo ha vai nāmaiṣaḥ tam ayāsya iti parokṣam ācakṣate |
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन्न् अयं वा आस्य इति यद् अब्रुवन्न् अयं वा आस्य इति तस्माद् अयमास्यः अयमास्यो ह वै नामैषः तम् अयास्य इति परोक्षम् आचक्षते ।
text: They said: " Verily he {ayam) is in the mouth (asya)." Because they said: " Verily he is in the mouth," therefore he is [called] Ayamasya. Ayamasya, verily, is his name. Him they call Ayasya in an occult way. "
text_mt:
They said: “This one is in the mouth (ayam āsye).”
Because they said, “This one is in the mouth”, therefore he is Ayamāsya.
Ayamāsya indeed is his name;
him they cryptically call Ayāsya.

sanskrit_iast: sa prāṇo vā ayāsyaḥ prāṇo ha vā enān sa nunude |
meaning: स प्राणो वा अयास्यः प्राणो ह वा एनान् स नुनुदे ।
text: This breath is Ayasya. Verily as breath he pushed them away.
text_mt:
Ayāsya is breath;
it was breath indeed that drove them away.

sanskrit_iast: sa ya evaṃ vidvān udgāyati prāṇenaiva devān devaloke dadhāty apānena manuṣyān manuṣyaloke vyānena pitṝn pitṛloke hiṅkāreṇaiva vajreṇāsmāl lokād dviṣantam bhrātṛvyaṃ nudate | tṛtīye 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स य एवं विद्वान् उद्गायति प्राणेनैव देवान् देवलोके दधात्य् अपानेन मनुष्यान् मनुष्यलोके व्यानेन पितॄन् पितृलोके हिङ्कारेणैव वज्रेणास्माल् लोकाद् द्विषन्तम् भ्रातृव्यं नुदते । तृतीये ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: He who knowing thus sings the udgītha places with breath the gods in the world of the gods, with exhalation men in the world of men, with the vydna the Fathers in the world of the Fathers, with the hinkdra [as] thunderbolt he pushes his hateful rival away from this world.
text_mt:
