text: He said: " Verily thrice, O householder, man is born. From his father he is born first, then from his mother, then from the sacrifice.
text_mt:
He said: "A person, O householder, is born three times.
First he is born from the father, then from the mother, then from the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: trir v eva mriyata iti sa yad dha vā enam etat pitā yonyāṃ reto bhūtaṃ siñcati | dvitīye 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: त्रिर् व् एव म्रियत इति स यद् ध वा एनम् एतत् पिता योन्यां रेतो भूतं सिञ्चति । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः ।
text: And thrice he likewise dieth. When his father emitteth him as seed thus into the womb,—
text_mt:
And three times indeed he dies.
When the father pours him into the womb as semen—
Third khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: tat prathamam mriyate |
meaning: तत् प्रथमम् म्रियते ।
text: 2. andham iva viii "— Then he dies for the first time.
text_mt: —then he dies for the first time.

sanskrit_iast: andham iva vai tamo yoniḥ lohitastoko vā vai sa tad ābhavaty apāṃ vā stokaḥ kiṃ hi sa tad ābhavati |
meaning: अन्धम् इव वै तमो योनिः लोहितस्तोको वा वै स तद् आभवत्य् अपां वा स्तोकः किं हि स तद् आभवति ।
text: Blind darkness, as it were, is the womb. He thus becomes either a drop of blood or a di'op of water. What, pray, does he thus become?
text_mt:
Blind darkness, indeed, is the womb.
A drop of blood or a drop of water he becomes then.
For what does he become then?

sanskrit_iast: sa yas tāṃ devatāṃ veda yāṃ ca sa tato 'nusambhavati yā cainaṃ tam mṛtyum ativahati sa udgātā mṛtyum ativahatīti |
meaning: स यस् तां देवतां वेद यां च स ततो ऽनुसम्भवति या चैनं तम् मृत्युम् अतिवहति स उद्गाता मृत्युम् अतिवहतीति ।
text: He who knows that divinity after which he thence comes into being and which carries him beyond this death—he as udgdtar carries beyond death.
text_mt: He who knows that deity from whom he is born thereafter, and who carries him across that death, that udgātṛ carries [the sacrificer] across death."

sanskrit_iast: atha ya enam etad dīkṣayanti tad dvitīyam mriyate vapanti keśaśmaśrūṇi nikṛntanti nakhān pratyañjanty aṅgāni pratyacaty aṅgulīḥ apavṛto 'paveṣṭita āste na juhoti na yajate na yoṣitaṃ carati amānuṣīṃ vācaṃ vadati mṛtasya vāvaiṣa tadā rūpam bhavati |
meaning: अथ य एनम् एतद् दीक्षयन्ति तद् द्वितीयम् म्रियते वपन्ति केशश्मश्रूणि निकृन्तन्ति नखान् प्रत्यञ्जन्त्य् अङ्गानि प्रत्यचत्य् अङ्गुलीः अपवृतो ऽपवेष्टित आस्ते न जुहोति न यजते न योषितं चरति अमानुषीं वाचं वदति मृतस्य वावैष तदा रूपम् भवति ।
text: And when they thus consecrate him, then he dies for the second time. They cut [his] hair and [his] beard. They trim [his] nails. They anoint his several limbs. He bends his fingers. He sits uncovered, stripped oft (?). He does not offer oblations, he does not sacrifice, he does not approach a woman, he speaks non-human speech. Verily he then has the form of one dead. 6. = a.

sanskrit_iast: sa yas tāṃ devatāṃ veda yāṃ ca sa tato 'nusambhavati yā cainaṃ tam mṛtyum ativahati sa udgātā mṛtyum ativahatīti |
meaning: स यस् तां देवतां वेद यां च स ततो ऽनुसम्भवति या चैनं तम् मृत्युम् अतिवहति स उद्गाता मृत्युम् अतिवहतीति ।
text_mt: He who knows that deity from whom he is born thereafter, and who carries him across that death, that udgātṛ carries [the sacrificer] across death."

sanskrit_iast: atha ya enam etad asmāl lokāt pretaṃ cityām ādadhati tad tṛtīyam mriyate |
meaning: अथ य एनम् एतद् अस्माल् लोकात् प्रेतं चित्याम् आदधति तद् तृतीयम् म्रियते ।
text: And when they lay him, having departed from this world, upon the funeral-pyre, then he dies for the third time. i. = s."
text_mt: "Then, when they place him, departed from this world, upon the funeral pyre, then he dies for the third time.

sanskrit_iast: sa yas tāṃ devatāṃ veda yāṃ ca sa tato 'nusambhavati yā cainaṃ tam mṛtyum ativahati sa udgātā mṛtyum ativahatīti |
meaning: स यस् तां देवतां वेद यां च स ततो ऽनुसम्भवति या चैनं तम् मृत्युम् अतिवहति स उद्गाता मृत्युम् अतिवहतीति ।
text_mt: He who knows that deity from whom he is born thereafter, and who carries him across that death, that udgātṛ carries [the sacrificer] across death."

sanskrit_iast: etāvad dhaivoktvā ratham āsthāya pradhāvayāṃ cakāra |
meaning: एतावद् धैवोक्त्वा रथम् आस्थाय प्रधावयां चकार ।
text: Having said this much, mounting the chariot, he drove off.
text_mt: Having said only this much, mounting the chariot, he drove forward.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ ha jābālam pratyetaṃ kanīyān bhrātovāca kām bhavañ chūdrako vācam avādīti hastinā gādham aiṣīr iti |
meaning: तं ह जाबालम् प्रत्येतं कनीयान् भ्रातोवाच काम् भवञ् छूद्रको वाचम् अवादीति हस्तिना गाधम् ऐषीर् इति ।
text: To this Jabala, having come back, [his] younger brother said: " Sir, what words hath the Śudra spoken? Thou hast sought a shallow with an elephant." He (the older Jabala) set that forth to him who [had said]: " How hath he spoken, sir?": " He who knows the carrying-over of the three deaths by means of the sāman, he as udgdtar carries beyond death."
text_mt:
When Jābāla returned, the younger brother said to him: "Sir, what words did the little Śūdra speak?"
"You sought a ford by means of an elephant."

sanskrit_iast: pra haivainaṃ tac chaśaṃsa yaḥ katham avocad bhagava iti yas trayāṇām mṛtyūnāṃ sāmnātivāhaṃ veda sa udgātā mṛtyum ativahatīti | dvitīye 'nuvāke caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: प्र हैवैनं तच् छशंस यः कथम् अवोचद् भगव इति यस् त्रयाणाम् मृत्यूनां साम्नातिवाहं वेद स उद्गाता मृत्युम् अतिवहतीति । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके चतुर्थः खण्डः ।
text_mt:
He openly praised him for it: "How did he speak, sir?"
"'He who knows the carrying across the three deaths by means of the sāman, that udgātṛ carries [the sacrificer] across death.'"
Fourth khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vāva bhagavas te pitodgātāram amanyateti hovāca tad u ha prācīnaśālā vidur ya eṣām ayaṃ vṛta udgātāsa tasmin ha nānuviduḥ |
meaning: तं वाव भगवस् ते पितोद्गातारम् अमन्यतेति होवाच तद् उ ह प्राचीनशाला विदुर् य एषाम् अयं वृत उद्गातास तस्मिन् ह नानुविदुः ।
text: He said: " Sir, verily, thy father thought him an udgdtar; and the Pracina9alas know it, who of them was the chosen udgdtar here." To him they did not assent (?).

sanskrit_iast: te hocur anudhāvata kāṇḍviyam iti taṃ hānusasruḥ te ha kāṇḍviyam udgātāraṃ cakrire brahmāṇam prācīnaśālim |
meaning: ते होचुर् अनुधावत काण्ड्वियम् इति तं हानुसस्रुः ते ह काण्ड्वियम् उद्गातारं चक्रिरे ब्रह्माणम् प्राचीनशालिम् ।
text: They said: "Run after Kandviya." They ran after him. They made Kandviya the udgdtar, [and] Praoina5ali the 5raAwian-priest.
text_mt:
They said: "Run after Kāṇḍviya!"
They ran after him.
They made Kāṇḍviya the udgātṛ, and Prācīnaśāli the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ hābhyavekṣyovācaivam eṣa brāhmaṇo moghāya vādāya nāglāyat sa nāṇu sāmno 'nvicchatīti ati haivainaṃ tac cakre |
meaning: तं हाभ्यवेक्ष्योवाचैवम् एष ब्राह्मणो मोघाय वादाय नाग्लायत् स नाणु साम्नो ऽन्विच्छतीति अति हैवैनं तच् चक्रे ।
text: He looking down at him said: " Thus this Brahman was not averse to idle talk. He doth not strive after the subtle of the sāman." He did this beyond him (?).
text_mt:
Looking down upon him, he said: "Thus this brāhmaṇa did not tire of idle talk.
He does not seek the fine [truth] of the sāman."
Thus he surpassed him.

sanskrit_iast: sa yad dha vā enam etat pitā yonyāṃ reto bhūtaṃ siñcaty ādityo hainaṃ tad yonyāṃ reto bhūtaṃ siñcati sa hāsya tatra mṛtyor īśe |
meaning: स यद् ध वा एनम् एतत् पिता योन्यां रेतो भूतं सिञ्चत्य् आदित्यो हैनं तद् योन्यां रेतो भूतं सिञ्चति स हास्य तत्र मृत्योर् ईशे ।
text: When the father thus emits him as seed into the womb, then the sun thus emits him as seed in the womb. He there lords over this death.
text_mt:
Now, when the father pours him into the womb as semen, Āditya pours him into the womb as semen.
He rules over his death there.

sanskrit_iast: atho yad evainam etat pitā yonyāṃ reto bhūtaṃ siñcati tad dha vāva sa tato 'nusambhavati prāṇaṃ ca yadā hy eva retas siktam prāṇa āviśaty atha tat sambhavati |
meaning: अथो यद् एवैनम् एतत् पिता योन्यां रेतो भूतं सिञ्चति तद् ध वाव स ततो ऽनुसम्भवति प्राणं च यदा ह्य् एव रेतस् सिक्तम् प्राण आविशत्य् अथ तत् सम्भवति ।
text_mt:
And when the father pours him into the womb as semen, then he is born from that and from breath;
for when breath enters the poured semen, then it comes into being.

sanskrit_iast: atho yad evainam etad dīkṣayanty agnir haivainaṃ tad yonyāṃ reto bhūtaṃ siñcati sa haivāsya tatra mṛtyor īśe |
meaning: अथो यद् एवैनम् एतद् दीक्षयन्त्य् अग्निर् हैवैनं तद् योन्यां रेतो भूतं सिञ्चति स हैवास्य तत्र मृत्योर् ईशे ।
text: And when the father thus emits him as seed into the womb, verily he thence comes into existence after that [seed] and after breath. For when breath enters the emitted seed, then it comes into being, e. And when they thus consecrate him, it is Agni who thus emits him as seed into the womb. He there lords over this death,
text_mt:
And when they consecrate him, Agni indeed pours him into the womb as semen.
He rules over his death there.

sanskrit_iast: atho yām evaitāṃ vaisarjanīyām āhutim adhvaryur juhoti tām eva sa tato 'nusambhavati chandāṃsi caiva |
meaning: अथो याम् एवैतां वैसर्जनीयाम् आहुतिम् अध्वर्युर् जुहोति ताम् एव स ततो ऽनुसम्भवति छन्दांसि चैव ।
text: Now what vdisarjana-oEev'mg the adhvaryu offers, after that he thence comes into existence and after the metres.
text_mt: And whichever vaisarjanīya oblation the adhvaryu offers, he is born from that and from the metres.

sanskrit_iast: atha ya enam etad asmāl lokāt pretaṃ cityām ādadhati candramā haivainaṃ tad yonyāṃ reto bhūtāṃ siñcati sa u haivāsya tatra mṛtyor īśe |
meaning: अथ य एनम् एतद् अस्माल् लोकात् प्रेतं चित्याम् आदधति चन्द्रमा हैवैनं तद् योन्यां रेतो भूतां सिञ्चति स उ हैवास्य तत्र मृत्योर् ईशे ।
text: And when they thus lay him, having departed from this world, on the funeral pyre, it is the moon who thus emits him as seed into the womb. He there lords over this death.
text_mt:
And when they place him, departed from this world, upon the funeral pyre, the Moon indeed pours him into the womb as semen.
And he rules over his death there.

sanskrit_iast: atho yad evainam etad asmāl lokāt pretaṃ cityām ādadhaty atho yā evaitā avokṣaṇīyā āpas tā eva sa tato 'nusambhavati prāṇam v eva prāṇo hy āpaḥ |
meaning: अथो यद् एवैनम् एतद् अस्माल् लोकात् प्रेतं चित्याम् आदधत्य् अथो या एवैता अवोक्षणीया आपस् ता एव स ततो ऽनुसम्भवति प्राणम् व् एव प्राणो ह्य् आपः ।
text: Now when they put him, having departed from this world, on the funeral pyre, now what the waters for sprinkling are, after those he thence comes into existence and after breath also. For breath is the waters.
text_mt:
And when they place him, departed from this world, upon the funeral pyre, and whatever sprinkling waters these are, he is born from them and from breath;
for breath is the waters.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ ha vā evaṃvid udgātā yajamānam om ity etenākṣareṇādityam mṛtyum ativahati vāg ity agniṃ hum iti vāyum bhā iti candramasam |
meaning: तं ह वा एवंविद् उद्गाता यजमानम् ओम् इत्य् एतेनाक्षरेणादित्यम् मृत्युम् अतिवहति वाग् इत्य् अग्निं हुम् इति वायुम् भा इति चन्द्रमसम् ।
text: Him sacrificing an udgdtar who knows thus carries beyond the sun, [i. e. beyond] death, by means of this syllable, viz. om; [saying] vac [he carries him] beyond Agni; [saying] hum, beyond Vayu; [saying] bhd, beyond the moon.
text_mt: Such a knowing udgātṛ carries that sacrificer across the death that is Āditya with the syllable 'om', across Agni with 'speech', across Vāyu with 'hum', and across the Moon with 'bhā'.

sanskrit_iast: tān vā etān mṛtyūn sāmnodgātātmānaṃ ca yajamānaṃ cātivahaty om ity etenākṣareṇa prāṇenāmunādityena |
meaning: तान् वा एतान् मृत्यून् साम्नोद्गातात्मानं च यजमानं चातिवहत्य् ओम् इत्य् एतेनाक्षरेण प्राणेनामुनादित्येन ।
text: Verily beyond these same deaths an udgdtar carries himself and the sacrificer, by means of this syllable, viz. om, by means of breath, by means of yonder sun.
text_mt: Across these deaths the udgātṛ carries himself and the sacrificer by means of the sāman, by this syllable 'om', by breath, and by that Āditya.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaiṣa śloka utaiṣāṃ jyeṣṭha uta vā kaniṣṭha utaiṣām putra uta vā pitaiṣām eko ha devo manasi praviṣṭaḥ pūrvo ha jajñe sa u garbhe 'ntar iti |
meaning: तस्यैष श्लोक उतैषां ज्येष्ठ उत वा कनिष्ठ उतैषाम् पुत्र उत वा पितैषाम् एको ह देवो मनसि प्रविष्टः पूर्वो ह जज्ञे स उ गर्भे ऽन्तर् इति ।
text: About this there is this Śloka: " Is he the oldest of them or the youngest? Is he their son, or their father? Truly one god is entered in the mind; he was born of old and he is within the womb."
text_mt:
Regarding this there is this verse:
"Both their eldest and their youngest, both their son and their father— / the one god entered into the mind; he was born first, and he is within the womb."

sanskrit_iast: tad yad eṣo 'bhyukta imam eva puruṣaṃ yo 'yam āchanno 'ntar om ity etenaivākṣareṇa prāṇenaivāmunaivādityena | dvitīye 'nuvāke pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ dvitīyo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: तद् यद् एषो ऽभ्युक्त इमम् एव पुरुषं यो ऽयम् आछन्नो ऽन्तर् ओम् इत्य् एतेनैवाक्षरेण प्राणेनैवामुनैवादित्येन । द्वितीये ऽनुवाके पञ्चमः खण्डः द्वितीयो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: In that he is spoken of, this same man who is concealed within, by just that syllable om, by breath, by yonder sun [ ].
text_mt:
As to what was referred to in verse, it is this very person who is covered within, by this very syllable om, by breath, by that sun.
Fifth khaṇḍa in the second anuvāka.
The second anuvāka is concluded.

sanskrit_iast: trir ha vai puruṣo mriyate trir jāyate |
meaning: त्रिर् ह वै पुरुषो म्रियते त्रिर् जायते ।
text: Verily, thrice man dies, thrice he is born.
text_mt: Three times indeed a man dies, three times he is born.

sanskrit_iast: sa haitad eva prathamam mriyate yad retas siktaṃ sambhūtam bhavati sa prāṇam evābhisambhavati āśām abhijāyate |
meaning: स हैतद् एव प्रथमम् म्रियते यद् रेतस् सिक्तं सम्भूतम् भवति स प्राणम् एवाभिसम्भवति आशाम् अभिजायते ।
text: Then he dies for the first time, when the seed, emitted, comes into being. He is converted into breath; he is born into space.

sanskrit_iast: athaitad dvitīyam mriyate yad dīkṣate sa chandāṃsy evābhisambhavati dakṣiṇām abhijāyate |
meaning: अथैतद् द्वितीयम् म्रियते यद् दीक्षते स छन्दांस्य् एवाभिसम्भवति दक्षिणाम् अभिजायते ।
text: Then he dies for the second time, when he consecrates himself. He is converted into the metres; lie is born unto the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: athaitat tṛtīyam mriyate yan mriyate sa śraddhām evābhisambhavati lokam abhijāyate |
meaning: अथैतत् तृतीयम् म्रियते यन् म्रियते स श्रद्धाम् एवाभिसम्भवति लोकम् अभिजायते ।
text: Then he dies for the third time, when he dies. He is converted into faith; he is born into [his] world.

sanskrit_iast: tad etat tryāvṛd gāyatraṃ gāyati tasya prathamayāvṛtemam eva lokaṃ jayati yad u cāsmiṃl loke tad etena cainam prāṇena samardhayati yam abhisambhavaty etāṃ cāsmā āśām prayacchati yām abhijāyate |
meaning: तद् एतत् त्र्यावृद् गायत्रं गायति तस्य प्रथमयावृतेमम् एव लोकं जयति यद् उ चास्मिंल् लोके तद् एतेन चैनम् प्राणेन समर्धयति यम् अभिसम्भवत्य् एतां चास्मा आशाम् प्रयच्छति याम् अभिजायते ।
text: Therefore he sings the gāyatra [-chant] in three turns (dvrt). By its first turn he conquers this world, and what there is in this world. Thus he causes him to thrive with that breath into which he is converted, and he gives him that space unto which he is born.

sanskrit_iast: atha dvitīyayāvṛtedam evāntarikṣaṃ jayati yad u cāntarikṣe tad etaiś cainaṃ chandobhis samardhayati yāny abhisambhavati etāṃ cāsmai dakṣiṇām prayacchati yām abhijāyate |
meaning: अथ द्वितीययावृतेदम् एवान्तरिक्षं जयति यद् उ चान्तरिक्षे तद् एतैश् चैनं छन्दोभिस् समर्धयति यान्य् अभिसम्भवति एतां चास्मै दक्षिणाम् प्रयच्छति याम् अभिजायते ।
text: And by its second turn he conquers this atmosphere, and what there is in the atmosphere. Thus he causes him to thrive with those metres into which he is converted, and he gives him that sacrificial gift unto which he is born.

sanskrit_iast: atha tṛtīyayāvṛtāmum eva lokam jayati yad u cāmuṣmiṃl loke tad etayā cainaṃ śraddhayā samardhayati yayaivainam etac chraddhayāgnāv abhyādadhati sam ayam ito bhaviṣyatīti etaṃ cāsmai lokam prayacchati yam abhijāyate | tṛtīye 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: अथ तृतीययावृतामुम् एव लोकम् जयति यद् उ चामुष्मिंल् लोके तद् एतया चैनं श्रद्धया समर्धयति ययैवैनम् एतच् छ्रद्धयाग्नाव् अभ्यादधति सम् अयम् इतो भविष्यतीति एतं चास्मै लोकम् प्रयच्छति यम् अभिजायते । तृतीये ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: And with the third turn he conquers yonder world, and what there is in yonder world. Thus he causes him to thrive with that faith with which faith they lay him into the fire [saying]: "This one, from here, will come to life;" and he gives him that world unto which he is born.
text_mt:
Then with the third turn, he wins that world and whatever is in that world;
thereby he enriches him with that faith with which they place him into the fire [thinking], 'He will exist whole from here,'
and bestows upon him that world into which he is born.
First khaṇḍa in the third anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: etad vai tisṛbhir āvṛdbhir imāṃś ca lokāñ jayaty etaiś cainam bhūtais samardhayati yāny abhisambhavati |
meaning: एतद् वै तिसृभिर् आवृद्भिर् इमांश् च लोकाञ् जयत्य् एतैश् चैनम् भूतैस् समर्धयति यान्य् अभिसम्भवति ।
text: Verily, thus with three turns he conquers these worlds, and he causes him to thrive with those things into which he is converted.
text_mt: Indeed, by these three turns he wins these worlds and enriches him with these beings into which he enters.

sanskrit_iast: atha vā ato hiṅkārasyaiva taṃ ha svarge loke santam mṛtyur anvety aśanayā |
meaning: अथ वा अतो हिङ्कारस्यैव तं ह स्वर्गे लोके सन्तम् मृत्युर् अन्वेत्य् अशनया ।
text: Now from here concerning the hinkdra. After him, being in the heavenly world, death goes, hunger.
text_mt:
Now then concerning the hiṅkāra alone:
when he is in the heavenly world, hunger, which is death, pursues him.

sanskrit_iast: śrīr vā eṣā prajāpatis sāmno yad dhiṅkāraḥ tam id udgātā śriyā prajāpatinā hiṅkāreṇa mṛtyum apasedhati |
meaning: श्रीर् वा एषा प्रजापतिस् साम्नो यद् धिङ्कारः तम् इद् उद्गाता श्रिया प्रजापतिना हिङ्कारेण मृत्युम् अपसेधति ।
text: The hinkdra is the fortune, Prajapati of the sāman. That death the udgdtar drives away by means of fortune, of Prajapati, of the hinkdra.
text_mt:
The hiṅkāra is prosperity, it is Prajāpati of the sāman.
With prosperity, with Prajāpati, with the hiṅkāra, the udgātṛ keeps off death from him.

sanskrit_iast: hum mety āha mātra nu gā yatraitad yajamāna iti haitat |
meaning: हुम् मेत्य् आह मात्र नु गा यत्रैतद् यजमान इति हैतत् ।
text: He says hum md: that is, " Do not now go thither, where the sacrificer now is." As, driven by a better one, a worse one trembles before hitn, even so death, evil, trembles before him.
text_mt: He says: 'hum mā'—this means: 'Do not go there now, where this sacrificer is.'

sanskrit_iast: sa yathā śreyasā siddhaḥ pāpīyān prativijata evaṃ haivāsmān mṛtyuḥ pāpmā prativijate |
meaning: स यथा श्रेयसा सिद्धः पापीयान् प्रतिविजत एवं हैवास्मान् मृत्युः पाप्मा प्रतिविजते ।
text_mt: Just as a worse person chased away by a better one shrinks back, so does evil death shrink back from him.

sanskrit_iast: yan mety āha candramā vai mā māsaḥ eṣa ha vai mā māsaḥ tasmān mety āha bhā iti haitat parokṣeṇeva yasmād v eva mety āha yad v eva mety āhaitāni trīṇi tasmān mety brūyāt | tṛtīye 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: यन् मेत्य् आह चन्द्रमा वै मा मासः एष ह वै मा मासः तस्मान् मेत्य् आह भा इति हैतत् परोक्षेणेव यस्माद् व् एव मेत्य् आह यद् व् एव मेत्य् आहैतानि त्रीणि तस्मान् मेत्य् ब्रूयात् । तृतीये ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: As for his saying md, md is the m^oon, the month. Verily, this month is md. Therefore he says md; that is bhd, in an occult way, as it were. As to why he says md—in that he says md, there are these three [meanings]. Therefore he should say md.
text_mt:
When he says 'mā': the moon indeed is 'mā', the month [māsa].
This month indeed is 'mā'.
Therefore he says 'mā'.
This is indirectly as 'bhā' [light].
And because he says 'mā', and because he says 'mā'—these three [meanings].
Therefore he should say 'mā'.
Second khaṇḍa in the third anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: hum bhā iti brahmavarcasakāmasya bhatīva hi brahmavarcasam |
meaning: हुम् भा इति ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य भतीव हि ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ।
text: Hum bhd are [the utterances] of him who desires lustre in sacred lore. For lustre in sacred lore shines (Śma), as it were.
text_mt:
'hum bhā'—for one who desires spiritual lustre;
for spiritual lustre shines [bhāti], as it were.

sanskrit_iast: hum bo iti paśukāmasya bo iti ha paśavo vāśyante |
meaning: हुम् बो इति पशुकामस्य बो इति ह पशवो वाश्यन्ते ।
text: Mum bo a.re [the utterances] of him who desires cattle. For cattle low bo.
text_mt:
'hum bo'—for one who desires cattle;
for cattle low as 'bo'.

sanskrit_iast: hum bag iti śrīkāmasya bag iti ha śriyam paṇāyanti |
meaning: हुम् बग् इति श्रीकामस्य बग् इति ह श्रियम् पणायन्ति ।
text: Hum bag are [the utterances] of him who desires fortune. For saying bag they, extol fortune.
text_mt:
'hum bag'—for one who desires prosperity;
for people praise prosperity as 'bag'.

sanskrit_iast: hum bhā ovā ity etad evopagītam |
meaning: हुम् भा ओवा इत्य् एतद् एवोपगीतम् ।
text: Ham bhd ovd, that is sung in response. " Let him sing turning about unto something great, as it were," Naka used to say; " he becomes the owner of a great village, the owner of a great resting place." That is as if, having caused to run against a post, with another or another one should go about [it],
text_mt: 'hum bhā ovā'—this is the accompanying singing.

sanskrit_iast: mahad ivābhiparivartayan gāyed iti ha smāha nāko mahāgrāmo mahāniveśo bhavatīti sa yathā sthāṇum arpayitvetareṇa vetareṇa vā pariyāyāt tādṛk tat |
meaning: महद् इवाभिपरिवर्तयन् गायेद् इति ह स्माह नाको महाग्रामो महानिवेशो भवतीति स यथा स्थाणुम् अर्पयित्वेतरेण वेतरेण वा परियायात् तादृक् तत् ।
text: [But] Śatyayani said regarding this: " For what purpose should he cause to ran against a post? Now that is sung in response. Let him pay no attention to that."
text_mt:
'One should sing bringing it around as if large,' said Nāka, 'one becomes of a great community, of a great settlement.'
That is just as if one, having fixed a post, should go around on this side or that side.

sanskrit_iast: tad u hovāca śāṭyāyaniḥ kasmai kāmāya sthāṇum arpayet athopagītam evaitat naivaitad ādriyeteti |
meaning: तद् उ होवाच शाट्यायनिः कस्मै कामाय स्थाणुम् अर्पयेत् अथोपगीतम् एवैतत् नैवैतद् आद्रियेतेति ।

sanskrit_iast: nu hiṅkārānāṃ atha vā ato nidhanam eva ovā iti dve akṣare anto vai sāmno nidhanam antas svargo lokānām anto bradhnasya viṣṭapam |
meaning: नु हिङ्कारानां अथ वा अतो निधनम् एव ओवा इति द्वे अक्षरे अन्तो वै साम्नो निधनम् अन्तस् स्वर्गो लोकानाम् अन्तो ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् ।
text: So much about the hinkdras. Henceforth regarding the nidhana. Ovd is two syllables. Verily the nidhana is the end of the sāman, heaven is the end of the worlds, the summit is the end of the ruddj one.
text_mt:
So much for the hiṅkāras.
Now then concerning the finale [nidhana] alone:
'ovā'—these are two syllables.
The finale is the end of the sāman, heaven is the end of the worlds, the highest region of the sun is the end.

sanskrit_iast: tam etad udgātā yajamānam om ity etenākṣareṇānte svarge loke dadhāti |
meaning: तम् एतद् उद्गाता यजमानम् ओम् इत्य् एतेनाक्षरेणान्ते स्वर्गे लोके दधाति ।
text: Thus the udgdtar places the sacrificer by means of this syllable om in the end in the heavenly world.
text_mt: By this syllable om, the udgātṛ places that sacrificer at the end, in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: ya u ha vā apakṣo vṛkṣāgraṃ gacchaty ava vai sa tataḥ padyate atha yad vai pakṣī vṛkṣāgre yad asidhārāyāṃ yat kṣuradhārāyām āste na vai sa tato 'vapadyate pakṣābhyāṃ hi saṃyata āste |
meaning: य उ ह वा अपक्षो वृक्षाग्रं गच्छत्य् अव वै स ततः पद्यते अथ यद् वै पक्षी वृक्षाग्रे यद् असिधारायां यत् क्षुरधारायाम् आस्ते न वै स ततो ऽवपद्यते पक्षाभ्यां हि संयत आस्ते ।
text: Verily he who without wings goes up to the top of a tree, he falls down froln it. But if one having wings sits on the top of a tree, or on the edge of a sword, or on the edge of a razor, verily he does not fall down from it. For he sits supported by his wings.

sanskrit_iast: tam etad udgātā yajamānam om ity etenākṣareṇa svarapakṣaṃ kṛtvānte svarge loke dadhāti sa yathā pakṣy abibhyad āsītaivam eva svarge loke 'bibhyad āste 'thācarati |
meaning: तम् एतद् उद्गाता यजमानम् ओम् इत्य् एतेनाक्षरेण स्वरपक्षं कृत्वान्ते स्वर्गे लोके दधाति स यथा पक्ष्य् अबिभ्यद् आसीतैवम् एव स्वर्गे लोके ऽबिभ्यद् आस्ते ऽथाचरति ।
text: Thus the udgdtar, making him, the sacrificer, by means of that syllable om, possess sound as wings, puts him in the end in the heavenly world. As one with wings would sit without fear, even so he sits without fear in the heavenly world, [andj likewise moves about.
text_mt:
By this syllable om, having given him wings of sound [svara], the udgātṛ places that sacrificer at the end, in the heavenly world.
Just as a winged [bird] would sit without fear, even so he sits without fear in the heavenly world, and then moves about.

sanskrit_iast: te ha vā ete akṣare devalokaś caiva manuṣyalokaś ca ādityaś ca ha vā ete akṣare candramāś ca |
meaning: ते ह वा एते अक्षरे देवलोकश् चैव मनुष्यलोकश् च आदित्यश् च ह वा एते अक्षरे चन्द्रमाश् च ।
text: These same two syllables are the world of the gods and the world of man. The sun these two syllables are, and the moon.
text_mt:
These two syllables are the world of the gods and the world of human beings;
and these two syllables are the sun and the moon.

sanskrit_iast: āditya eva devalokaś candramā manuṣyalokaḥ om ity ādityo vāg iti candramāḥ |
meaning: आदित्य एव देवलोकश् चन्द्रमा मनुष्यलोकः ओम् इत्य् आदित्यो वाग् इति चन्द्रमाः ।
text: The sun is the world of the gods, [and] the moon is the world of man. The sun is om, the moon is vac.
text_mt:
The sun is the world of the gods; the moon is the world of human beings.
Om is the sun; 'vāc' is the moon.

sanskrit_iast: tam etad udgātā yajamānam om ity etenākṣareṇādityaṃ devalokaṃ gamayati | tṛtīye 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तम् एतद् उद्गाता यजमानम् ओम् इत्य् एतेनाक्षरेणादित्यं देवलोकं गमयति । तृतीये ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः ।
text: Thus the udgdtar causes him, the sacrificer, to go to the heavenly world by means of this syllable
text_mt:
By this syllable om, the udgātṛ makes that sacrificer reach the sun, the world of the gods.
Third khaṇḍa in the third anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ hāgatam pṛcchati kas tvam asīti sa yo ha nāmnā vā gotreṇa vā prabrūte taṃ hāha yas te 'yam mayy ātmābhūd eṣa te sa iti |
meaning: तं हागतम् पृच्छति कस् त्वम् असीति स यो ह नाम्ना वा गोत्रेण वा प्रब्रूते तं हाह यस् ते ऽयम् मय्य् आत्माभूद् एष ते स इति ।
text: Him, having come, he asks: "Who art thou?" When he announces himself, either by his [personal] name or by his family [name], he says to him: "This self of thee that hath been in me, that same is thine."
text_mt:
He asks him when he has arrived: 'Who are you?'
If he announces himself by name or by clan [gotra], he says to him: 'This self of yours which was in me, that is yours.'

sanskrit_iast: tasmin hātman pratipat tam ṛtavas sampadāryapad gṛhītam apakarṣanti tasya hāhorātre lokam āpnutaḥ |
meaning: तस्मिन् हात्मन् प्रतिपत् तम् ऋतवस् सम्पदार्यपद् गृहीतम् अपकर्षन्ति तस्य हाहोरात्रे लोकम् आप्नुतः ।
text: In this self is the beginning {?pratipat). Him seized the seasons drag away; of him day and night obtain the world.

sanskrit_iast: tasmā u haitena prabruvīta ko 'ham asmi suvas tvam sa tvāṃ svargyaṃ svar agām iti |
meaning: तस्मा उ हैतेन प्रब्रुवीत को ऽहम् अस्मि सुवस् त्वम् स त्वां स्वर्ग्यं स्वर् अगाम् इति ।
text: To him be should answer thus: "Who (ka) am I, heaven [art] thou. As such I have gone to thee, the heavenly heaven."
text_mt:
To him he should declare with this: 'Who am I? You are heaven.
Such as I am, I have come to you, the heavenly light [svar].'

sanskrit_iast: ko ha vai prajāpatir atha haivaṃvid eva suvargaḥ sa hi suvar gacchati |
meaning: को ह वै प्रजापतिर् अथ हैवंविद् एव सुवर्गः स हि सुवर् गच्छति ।
text: "Verily Prajapati is who {ka), and he who knows thus is heaven-going; for he goes to heaven,
text_mt:
Who [Ka] indeed is Prajāpati; and one who knows thus is heavenly;
for he goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ hāha yas tvam asi so 'ham asmi yo 'ham asmi sa tvam asy ehīti |
meaning: तं हाह यस् त्वम् असि सो ऽहम् अस्मि यो ऽहम् अस्मि स त्वम् अस्य् एहीति ।
text: He says to him: "Who thou art, that one am I; who I am, that one art thou; come!"
text_mt: He says to him: 'Who you are, that am I; who I am, that are you. Come!'

sanskrit_iast: sa etam eva sukṛtarasam praviśati yad u ha vā asmiṃl loke manuṣyā yajante yat sādhu kurvanti tad eṣām ūrdhvam annādyam utsīdati tad amuṃ candramasam manuṣyalokam praviśati |
meaning: स एतम् एव सुकृतरसम् प्रविशति यद् उ ह वा अस्मिंल् लोके मनुष्या यजन्ते यत् साधु कुर्वन्ति तद् एषाम् ऊर्ध्वम् अन्नाद्यम् उत्सीदति तद् अमुं चन्द्रमसम् मनुष्यलोकम् प्रविशति ।
text: He enters this sap of good deeds. And what men in this world sacrifice, what good [deeds] they do, that of them rises upward [as] food-eating; it enters yonder moon, the world of men.

sanskrit_iast: tasyedam mānuṣanikāśanam aṇḍam udare 'ntas sambhavati tasyordhvam annādyam utsīdati stanāv abhi sa yad ājāyate 'thāsmai mātā stanam annādyam prayacchati |
meaning: तस्येदम् मानुषनिकाशनम् अण्डम् उदरे ऽन्तस् सम्भवति तस्योर्ध्वम् अन्नाद्यम् उत्सीदति स्तनाव् अभि स यद् आजायते ऽथास्मै माता स्तनम् अन्नाद्यम् प्रयच्छति ।
text: This human-like egg of him comes into being within the belly. Of it the food-eating rises upward toward the two breasts. When he is born, then the mother offers her breast to him for food-eating,

sanskrit_iast: ajāto ha vai tāvat puruṣo yāvan na yajate sa yajñenaiva jāyate sa yathāṇḍam prathamanirbhiṇṇam evam eva |
meaning: अजातो ह वै तावत् पुरुषो यावन् न यजते स यज्ञेनैव जायते स यथाण्डम् प्रथमनिर्भिण्णम् एवम् एव ।
text: Verily unborn is the man in so far as he does not sacrifice. It is through the sacrifice that he is born; just as an egg first burst.

sanskrit_iast: tadā taṃ ha vā evaṃvid udgātā yajamānam om ity etenākṣareṇādityaṃ devalokaṃ gamayati vāg ity asmā uttareṇākṣareṇa candramasam annādyam akṣitim prayacchati |
meaning: तदा तं ह वा एवंविद् उद्गाता यजमानम् ओम् इत्य् एतेनाक्षरेणादित्यं देवलोकं गमयति वाग् इत्य् अस्मा उत्तरेणाक्षरेण चन्द्रमसम् अन्नाद्यम् अक्षितिम् प्रयच्छति ।
text: Then the udgdtar knowing thus causes him, the sacrificer, through this syllable, viz. om, to enter the sun, the world of the gods. By means of the next syllable, viz. vac, he gives him the moon, food-eating, imperishableness.
text_mt:
Then indeed the udgātṛ who knows thus makes that sacrificer reach the sun, the world of the gods, by this syllable om;
by the subsequent syllable 'vāc' he bestows upon him the moon, food-essence, imperishability.

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyaitad avidvān udgāyati na haivainaṃ devalokaṃ gamayati no enam annādyena samardhayati |
meaning: अथ यस्यैतद् अविद्वान् उद्गायति न हैवैनं देवलोकं गमयति नो एनम् अन्नाद्येन समर्धयति ।
text: But whose udgītha one not knowing thus sings, verily he does not cause him to enter the world of the gods, nor to thrive through food-eating,
text_mt: Now for whomsoever an unknowing one sings the udgītha, he neither makes him reach the world of the gods nor does he enrich him with food-essence.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathāṇḍaṃ vidigdhaṃ śayītānnādyam alabhamānam evam eva vidigdhaś śete 'nnādyam alabhamānaḥ |
meaning: स यथाण्डं विदिग्धं शयीतान्नाद्यम् अलभमानम् एवम् एव विदिग्धश् शेते ऽन्नाद्यम् अलभमानः ।
text: As an egg would lie besmeared (?), not receiving any food, so he lies besmeared (?), not receiving any food.
text_mt: Just as an egg smeared [with dirt/filth] would lie without obtaining food-essence, even so he lies smeared, without obtaining food-essence.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād u haivaṃvidam evodgāpayeta evaṃvid ihaivodgātar iti hūtaḥ pratiśṛṇuyāt | tṛtīye 'nuvāke pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ tṛtīyo 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: तस्माद् उ हैवंविदम् एवोद्गापयेत एवंविद् इहैवोद्गातर् इति हूतः प्रतिशृणुयात् । तृतीये ऽनुवाके पञ्चमः खण्डः तृतीयो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: Therefore lie should cause only one knowing thus to sing the udgītha. Only one knowing thus here being addressed with "O udgdtar'''' should answer.
text_mt:
Therefore one should have only one who knows thus sing the udgītha.
Called with 'O udgātṛ who knows thus here!', he should respond.
Fifth khaṇḍa in the third anuvāka.
The third anuvāka is concluded.

sanskrit_iast: vāg iti hendro viśvāmitrāyoktham uvāca tad etad viśvāmitrā upāsate vācam eva |
meaning: वाग् इति हेन्द्रो विश्वामित्रायोक्थम् उवाच तद् एतद् विश्वामित्रा उपासते वाचम् एव ।
text: Indra said the uktha for Vi9vamitra [with] vac. That same the descendants of Vi9vamitra worship, just speech.
text_mt:
'Speech [vāc]'—thus Indra spoke the praise-hymn [uktha] to Viśvāmitra;
that very thing the Viśvāmitras revere as speech alone.

sanskrit_iast: manur ha vasiṣṭhāya brahmatvam uvāca tasmād āhur vāsiṣṭham eva brahmeti |
meaning: मनुर् ह वसिष्ठाय ब्रह्मत्वम् उवाच तस्माद् आहुर् वासिष्ठम् एव ब्रह्मेति ।
text: Manu declared to Vasistha brahman-hooA. Therefore they say: " The brahman belongs to Vasistha."
text_mt:
Manu taught the office of the brahman priest to Vasiṣṭha;
therefore they say: 'The brahman priest is indeed a descendant of Vasiṣṭha.'

sanskrit_iast: tad u vā āhur evaṃvid eva brahmā ka u evaṃvidaṃ vāsiṣṭham arhatīti |
meaning: तद् उ वा आहुर् एवंविद् एव ब्रह्मा क उ एवंविदं वासिष्ठम् अर्हतीति ।
text: This they also say: " One knowing thus is the hrahman-Śr\est; and who is equal to a Vasistha knowing thus?"
text_mt:
Moreover, they also say: 'One who knows thus is indeed the brahman priest.
And who is equal to the one who knows thus as a descendant of Vasiṣṭha?'

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prājijaniṣata sa tapo 'tapyata sa aikṣata hanta nu pratiṣṭhāṃ janayai tato yāḥ prajās srakṣye tā etad eva pratiṣṭhāsyanti nāpratiṣṭhāś carantīḥ pradaghiṣyanta iti |
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्राजिजनिषत स तपो ऽतप्यत स ऐक्षत हन्त नु प्रतिष्ठां जनयै ततो याः प्रजास् स्रक्ष्ये ता एतद् एव प्रतिष्ठास्यन्ति नाप्रतिष्ठाश् चरन्तीः प्रदघिष्यन्त इति ।
text: Prajapati was desirous to have progeny. He performed penance. He considered: " Come now, I will generate a firm footing. What oifspring I shall generate thereafter, that will thus stand firm; it will not, moving about without firm foundation, fall (?)." He generated this world, [also] the world of atmosphere [and] yonder world. Having generated these three worlds, he toiled upon [them].
text_mt:
Prajāpati desired to produce offspring.
He performed ascetic heat.
He considered: 'Come, let me generate a firm foundation; then the offspring which I shall emit will establish themselves upon it and, not wandering without a firm foundation, will not perish.'

sanskrit_iast: sa imaṃ lokam ajanayad antarikṣalokam amuṃ lokam iti tān imāṃs trīṃl lokāñ janayitvābhyaśrāmyat |
meaning: स इमं लोकम् अजनयद् अन्तरिक्षलोकम् अमुं लोकम् इति तान् इमांस् त्रींल् लोकाञ् जनयित्वाभ्यश्राम्यत् ।
text_mt:
He generated this world, the world of the intermediate space, [and] that world.
Having generated these three worlds, he exerted himself.

sanskrit_iast: tān samatapat tebhyas saṃtaptebhyas trīṇi śukrāṇy udāyann agniḥ pṛthivyā vāyur antarikṣād ādityo divaḥ |
meaning: तान् समतपत् तेभ्यस् संतप्तेभ्यस् त्रीणि शुक्राण्य् उदायन्न् अग्निः पृथिव्या वायुर् अन्तरिक्षाद् आदित्यो दिवः ।
text: He heated them together. From them being heated together three bright [bodies] went up: Agni from the earth, Vayu from the atmosphere, the sun from the sky.
text_mt:
He heated them thoroughly.
From them, when thoroughly heated, three essences went forth: Agni from the earth, Vāyu from the intermediate space, Āditya from heaven.

sanskrit_iast: sa etāni śukrāṇi punar abhy evātapat tebhyas saṃtaptebhyas trīṇy eva śukrāṇy udāyann ṛgveda evāgner yajurvedo vāyos sāmaveda ādityāt |
meaning: स एतानि शुक्राणि पुनर् अभ्य् एवातपत् तेभ्यस् संतप्तेभ्यस् त्रीण्य् एव शुक्राण्य् उदायन्न् ऋग्वेद एवाग्नेर् यजुर्वेदो वायोस् सामवेद आदित्यात् ।
text: He again heated these bright [bodies]. From them being heated together three bright [bodies] went up: the Rigveda from Agni, the Yajurveda from Vayu, the Samaveda from the sun.
text_mt:
He thoroughly heated these essences again.
From them, when thoroughly heated, three essences went forth: the Ṛgveda from Agni, the Yajurveda from Vāyu, the Sāmaveda from Āditya.

sanskrit_iast: sa etāni śukrāṇi punar abhy evātapat tebhyas saṃtaptebhyas trīṇy eva śukrāṇy udāyan bhūr ity eva rgvedād bhuva iti yajurvedāt svar iti sāmavedāt tad eva |
meaning: स एतानि शुक्राणि पुनर् अभ्य् एवातपत् तेभ्यस् संतप्तेभ्यस् त्रीण्य् एव शुक्राण्य् उदायन् भूर् इत्य् एव र्ग्वेदाद् भुव इति यजुर्वेदात् स्वर् इति सामवेदात् तद् एव ।
text: He again heated these bright [bodies]. From them being heated together three bright [bodies] went up: bhus from the liigveda, bhuvas from the Yajurveda, svar from the Samaveda, just so.
text_mt:
He thoroughly heated these essences again.
From them, when thoroughly heated, three essences went forth: bhūḥ from the Ṛgveda, bhuvaḥ from the Yajurveda, svaḥ from the Sāmaveda—just that.

sanskrit_iast: tad dha vai trayyai vidyāyai śukram etāvad idaṃ sarvam sa yo vai trayīṃ vidyāṃ viduṣo lokas so 'sya loko bhavati ya evaṃ veda | caturthe 'nuvāke prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तद् ध वै त्रय्यै विद्यायै शुक्रम् एतावद् इदं सर्वम् स यो वै त्रयीं विद्यां विदुषो लोकस् सो ऽस्य लोको भवति य एवं वेद । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके प्रथमः खण्डः ।
text: That is the brightness of the threefold knowledge. So great is this all. Verily what the world is of him who knows the threefold knowledge, that becomes the world of him who knows thus.
text_mt:
That indeed is the essence of the threefold knowledge.
This whole [universe] is just this much.
Whatever world belongs to the one who knows the threefold knowledge, that becomes his world who knows thus.
First subsection in the fourth lesson.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ vāva yajño yo 'yam pavate tasya vāk ca manaś ca vartanyau vācā ca hy eṣa etan manasā ca vartate |
meaning: अयं वाव यज्ञो यो ऽयम् पवते तस्य वाक् च मनश् च वर्तन्यौ वाचा च ह्य् एष एतन् मनसा च वर्तते ।
text: This sacrifice verily is he that cleanses here. Speech and mind are the two tracks of it. For thus it rolls along by speech and mind.
text_mt:
This one who purifies himself (the wind) is indeed the sacrifice.
Its two tracks are speech and mind.
For by speech and by mind this [sacrifice] moves along.

sanskrit_iast: tasya hotādhvaryur udgātety anyatarāṃ vācā vartaniṃ saṃskurvanti tasmāt te vācā kurvanti brahmaiva manasānyatarām tasmāt sa tūṣṇīm āste |
meaning: तस्य होताध्वर्युर् उद्गातेत्य् अन्यतरां वाचा वर्तनिं संस्कुर्वन्ति तस्मात् ते वाचा कुर्वन्ति ब्रह्मैव मनसान्यतराम् तस्मात् स तूष्णीम् आस्ते ।
text: Of it ' hotar ' adhvaryu,' ' udgdtar' arrange the one [track] by speech. Therefore they officiate with speech. The 6raAma>i-priest [arranges] the other by the mind. Therefore he sits in silence,

sanskrit_iast: sa yad dha so 'pi stūyamāne vā śasyamāne vā vāvadyamāna āsītānyatarām evāsyāpi tarhi sa vācā vartaniṃ saṃskuryāt |
meaning: स यद् ध सो ऽपि स्तूयमाने वा शस्यमाने वा वावद्यमान आसीतान्यतराम् एवास्यापि तर्हि स वाचा वर्तनिं संस्कुर्यात् ।
text: If he should sit talking aloud, while the stotra or the pastra are being uttered, then he would arrange with voice the one track of it.
text_mt: If he too were to sit talking while the praise-song is being chanted or the recitation is being recited, then he too would prepare only one track with speech.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathā puruṣa ekapād yan bhreṣann eti ratho vaikacakro vartamāna evam eva tarhi yajño bhreṣann eti |
meaning: स यथा पुरुष एकपाद् यन् भ्रेषन्न् एति रथो वैकचक्रो वर्तमान एवम् एव तर्हि यज्ञो भ्रेषन्न् एति ।
text: As a one-legged man, going, keeps on tumbling, or a one-wheeled chariot, rolling, even so the sacrifice then keeps on tumbling,
text_mt: Just as a man walking on one foot goes along stumbling, or a chariot rolling on one wheel [goes along stumbling], even so then the sacrifice goes along stumbling.

sanskrit_iast: etad dha tad vidvān brāhmaṇa uvāca brahmāṇam prātaranuvāka upākṛte vāvadyamānam āsīnam ardhaṃ vā ime tarhi yajñasyāntaragur iti ardhaṃ hi te tarhi yajñasyāntarīyuḥ |
meaning: एतद् ध तद् विद्वान् ब्राह्मण उवाच ब्रह्माणम् प्रातरनुवाक उपाकृते वावद्यमानम् आसीनम् अर्धं वा इमे तर्हि यज्ञस्यान्तरगुर् इति अर्धं हि ते तर्हि यज्ञस्यान्तरीयुः ।
text: A Brahman knowing this said this to a SraAwaw-priest who, when the prdtaranuvdka was began, sat talking aloud: " These here then have excluded half of the sacrifice." For half of the sacrifice they then did exclude.
text_mt:
Knowing this, a brahmin said to the brahman priest who was sitting talking while the morning recitation was undertaken: 'These [priests] have cut off half of the sacrifice then!'
For then they had cut off half of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād brahmā prātaranuvāka upākṛte vācaṃyama āsītāparidhānīyāyā ā vaṣaṭkārād itareṣāṃ stutaśastrāṇām evāsaṃsthāyai pavamānānām |
meaning: तस्माद् ब्रह्मा प्रातरनुवाक उपाकृते वाचंयम आसीतापरिधानीयाया आ वषट्काराद् इतरेषां स्तुतशस्त्राणाम् एवासंस्थायै पवमानानाम् ।
text: Therefore the Brahman-priest should sit in silence, when the prdtaranuvdka is begun, till the final verse, till the utterance of vasat of the other stotra and fastra, even till the completion of the libations.
text_mt: Therefore, when the morning recitation has been undertaken, the brahman priest should sit restraining his speech until the concluding verse, until the vaṣaṭ-call, until the completion of the other chants and recitations, and of the purifying chants.

sanskrit_iast: sa yathā puruṣa ubhayāpād yan bhreṣaṃ na nyeti ratho vobhayācakro vartamāna evam etarhi yajño bhreṣaṃ na nyeti | caturthe 'nuvāke dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स यथा पुरुष उभयापाद् यन् भ्रेषं न न्येति रथो वोभयाचक्रो वर्तमान एवम् एतर्हि यज्ञो भ्रेषं न न्येति । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके द्वितीयः खण्डः ।
text: As a two-legged man, going, does not take to tumbling, or a two-wheeled chariot, rolling, even so the sacrifice then does not take to tumbling.
text_mt:
Just as a man walking on both feet does not fall into stumbling, or a chariot rolling on both wheels [does not fall into stumbling], even so now the sacrifice does not fall into stumbling.
Second subsection in the fourth lesson.

sanskrit_iast: sa yadi yajña ṛkto bhreṣann iyād brahmaṇe prabrūtety āhuḥ atha yadi yajuṣṭo brahmaṇe prabrūtety āhuḥ atha yadi sāmato brahmaṇe prabrūtety āhuḥ atha yadi anupasmṛtāt kuta idam ajanīti brahmaṇe prabrūtety evāhuḥ |
meaning: स यदि यज्ञ ऋक्तो भ्रेषन्न् इयाद् ब्रह्मणे प्रब्रूतेत्य् आहुः अथ यदि यजुष्टो ब्रह्मणे प्रब्रूतेत्य् आहुः अथ यदि सामतो ब्रह्मणे प्रब्रूतेत्य् आहुः अथ यदि अनुपस्मृतात् कुत इदम् अजनीति ब्रह्मणे प्रब्रूतेत्य् एवाहुः ।
text: If that sacrifice should go tumbling from the side of the re, they say: "Tell it to the brahman-T^viesV; and if from the yajus, they say: " Tell it to the SraAmaw-priest"; and if from the sāman, they say: " Tell it to the 6raAwia«-priest"; and if from [a cause] not understood—[when they ask]: " Whence hath this arisen?"—they say: "Tell it to the 5mA»iaw-priest."
text_mt:
If the sacrifice should stumble on account of the ṛc, they say: 'Address the brahman priest!'
Then if on account of the yajus, they say: 'Address the brahman priest!'
Then if on account of the sāman, they say: 'Address the brahman priest!'
Then if from an unknown [cause, asking] 'Whence has this arisen?', they indeed say: 'Address the brahman priest!'

sanskrit_iast: sa brahmā prāṅ udetya sruveṇāgnīdhra ājyaṃ juhuyād bhūr bhuvas svar ity etābhir vyāhṛtibhiḥ |
meaning: स ब्रह्मा प्राङ् उदेत्य स्रुवेणाग्नीध्र आज्यं जुहुयाद् भूर् भुवस् स्वर् इत्य् एताभिर् व्याहृतिभिः ।
text: That SraAwaw-priest going up toward the east should offer the sacrificial butter with a ladle in the dgnidhra, with these exclamations: bhus, bhtivas, svar.
text_mt: That brahman priest, having stepped forward to the east, should offer melted butter in the Āgnīdhra fire with the dipping spoon, with these mystic utterances: 'bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ.'

sanskrit_iast: etā vai vyāhṛtayas sarvaprāyaścittayaḥ tad yathā lavaṇena suvarṇaṃ saṃdadhyāt suvarṇena rajataṃ rajatena trapu trapuṇā lohāyasaṃ lohāyasena kārṣṇāyasaṃ kārṣṇāyasena dāru dāru ca carma ca śleṣmaṇaivam evaivaṃ vidvāṃs tat sarvam bhiṣajyati |
meaning: एता वै व्याहृतयस् सर्वप्रायश्चित्तयः तद् यथा लवणेन सुवर्णं संदध्यात् सुवर्णेन रजतं रजतेन त्रपु त्रपुणा लोहायसं लोहायसेन कार्ष्णायसं कार्ष्णायसेन दारु दारु च चर्म च श्लेष्मणैवम् एवैवं विद्वांस् तत् सर्वम् भिषज्यति ।
text: For these exclamations expiate everything. As one would mend gold with salt, silver with gold, tin with silver, copper with tin, iron with copper, wood with iron, wood and leather with glue, even so one knowing thus cures everything,
text_mt:
These mystic utterances are indeed the universal atonements.
Just as one would join gold with salt-flux, silver with gold, tin with silver, lead with tin, iron with lead, wood with iron, and wood and leather with glue, even so one who knows thus heals all that.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad ahauṣīn me grahān me 'grahīd ity adhvaryave dakṣiṇā nayanty aśaṃsīn me vaṣaḍ akar ma iti hotra udagāsīn ma ity udgātre 'tha kiṃ cakruṣe brahmaṇe tūṣṇīm āsīnāya samāvatīr evetarair ṛtvigbhir dakṣiṇā nayantīti |
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् अहौषीन् मे ग्रहान् मे ऽग्रहीद् इत्य् अध्वर्यवे दक्षिणा नयन्त्य् अशंसीन् मे वषड् अकर् म इति होत्र उदगासीन् म इत्य् उद्गात्रे ऽथ किं चक्रुषे ब्रह्मणे तूष्णीम् आसीनाय समावतीर् एवेतरैर् ऋत्विग्भिर् दक्षिणा नयन्तीति ।
text: This they say: " If with the words: 'He hath offered for me, he hath dipped the dippings for me,' they lead the sacrificial gifts to the adhvaryu; if with the words: 'He hath sung the s^astra for me, he hath uttered the vasatior me,'to the hotar; if with the words: 'He hath sung 178 //. (h'M, the udgītha for me,' to the udgdtar—now then to the brahman having done what, while he sat in silence, do they lead just as large sacrificial gifts as to the other priests?"
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'They lead the sacrificial gift to the adhvaryu, [thinking] "He offered for me, he took the cups for me"; to the hotṛ, [thinking] "He recited for me, he uttered the vaṣaṭ-call for me"; to the udgātṛ, [thinking] "He chanted for me." Now, for what action do they lead to the brahman priest, who sits silently, sacrificial gifts equal to those of the other priests?'

sanskrit_iast: sa brūyād ardhabhāg gha vai sa yajñasyārdhaṃ hy eṣa yajñasya vahatīti ardhā ha sma vai purā brahmaṇe dakṣiṇā nayantīti ardhā itarebhya ṛtvigbhyaḥ |
meaning: स ब्रूयाद् अर्धभाग् घ वै स यज्ञस्यार्धं ह्य् एष यज्ञस्य वहतीति अर्धा ह स्म वै पुरा ब्रह्मणे दक्षिणा नयन्तीति अर्धा इतरेभ्य ऋत्विग्भ्यः ।
text: Let him say: " He, indeed, shareth in half of the sacrifice, for he carrieth half of the sacrifice." Indeed they formerly used to lead half of the sacrificial gifts to the JraAwaw-priest, half to the other priests,
text_mt:
He should say: 'He is indeed entitled to half of the sacrifice, for he carries half of the sacrifice.'
Formerly, indeed, they used to lead half of the sacrificial gifts to the brahman priest,
and half to the other priests.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaiṣa śloko mayīdam manye bhuvanādi sarvam mayi lokā mayi diśaś catasraḥ mayīdam manye nimiṣad yad ejati mayy āpa oṣadhayaś ca sarvā iti |
meaning: तस्यैष श्लोको मयीदम् मन्ये भुवनादि सर्वम् मयि लोका मयि दिशश् चतस्रः मयीदम् मन्ये निमिषद् यद् एजति मय्य् आप ओषधयश् च सर्वा इति ।
text: Of this there is the following ploka: " In me, I think, is this whole creation etc., in me the worlds, in me the four quarters; ill me, I think, is that twinkling thing which stirs, in me the waters and all the herbs."

sanskrit_iast: mayīdam manye bhuvanādi sarvam ity evaṃvidaṃ ha vāvedaṃ sarvam bhuvanam anvāyattam |
meaning: मयीदम् मन्ये भुवनादि सर्वम् इत्य् एवंविदं ह वावेदं सर्वम् भुवनम् अन्वायत्तम् ।
text: 'In me, I think, is the whole creation etc.:' for on one knowing thus this whole creation is dependent. 8. * In me the worlds, in me the four quarters:' for in one knowing thus are the worlds, in one knowing thus the four quarters.
text_mt: As for 'In me I think is this all, beginning with the world', this whole world is indeed dependent on the one who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: mayi lokā mayi diśaś catasra ity evaṃvidi ha vāva lokā evaṃvidi diśaś catasraḥ |
meaning: मयि लोका मयि दिशश् चतस्र इत्य् एवंविदि ह वाव लोका एवंविदि दिशश् चतस्रः ।
text_mt: As for 'In me are the worlds, in me the four quarters', in the one who knows thus are indeed the worlds; in the one who knows thus are the four quarters.

sanskrit_iast: mayīdam manye nimiṣad yad ejati mayy āpa oṣadhayaś ca sarvā ity evaṃvidi ha vāvedaṃ sarvam bhuvanam pratiṣṭhitam |
meaning: मयीदम् मन्ये निमिषद् यद् एजति मय्य् आप ओषधयश् च सर्वा इत्य् एवंविदि ह वावेदं सर्वम् भुवनम् प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
text: ' In me that twinkling thing which stirs, in me the waters and all the herbs:' for in one knowing thus this whole creation has its support,
text_mt: As for 'In me I think is this which blinks and moves; in me are the waters and all the plants', on the one who knows thus this whole world is indeed established.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād u haivaṃvidam eva brahmāṇaṃ kurvīta sa ha vāva brahmā ya evaṃ veda | caturthe 'nuvāke tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: तस्माद् उ हैवंविदम् एव ब्रह्माणं कुर्वीत स ह वाव ब्रह्मा य एवं वेद । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके तृतीयः खण्डः ।
text: And therefore one should make one knowing thus a brahman-ipnest. He indeed is a brahman-priest who knows thus.
text_mt:
Therefore one should make only one who knows thus the brahman priest.
He indeed is the brahman priest who knows thus.
Third subsection in the fourth lesson.

sanskrit_iast: atha vā atas stomabhāgānām evānumantrāḥ |
meaning: अथ वा अतस् स्तोमभागानाम् एवानुमन्त्राः ।
text: Now from here [about] the after-verses of the stomabhdgas.
text_mt: Now further, then, [are] the accompanying formulas of the share-of-praise-chants.

sanskrit_iast: tad dhaitad eke stomabhāgair evānumantrayante tat tathā na kuryāt |
meaning: तद् धैतद् एके स्तोमभागैर् एवानुमन्त्रयन्ते तत् तथा न कुर्यात् ।
text: Now some recite the after-verses just with the stomabhdgas. One should not do that.
text_mt:
In this regard, some accompany [the chants] with the shares-of-praise-chants themselves.
One should not do it in that way.

sanskrit_iast: devena savitrā prasūtaḥ prastotar devebhyo vācam iṣyety u haike 'numantrayante savitā vai devānām prasavitā savitrā prasūtā idam anumantrayāmaha iti vadantaḥ tad u tathā na kuryāt |
meaning: देवेन सवित्रा प्रसूतः प्रस्तोतर् देवेभ्यो वाचम् इष्येत्य् उ हैके ऽनुमन्त्रयन्ते सविता वै देवानाम् प्रसविता सवित्रा प्रसूता इदम् अनुमन्त्रयामह इति वदन्तः तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् ।
text: And some recite the after-verses [with this]: " Impelled by god Savitar, O prastotar, send [thy] speech to the gods," saying: " Savitar, verily, is the impeller of the gods; we recite this after-verse impelled by Savitar." One should not do that either.
text_mt:
Some accompany with: 'Impelled by the god Savitṛ, O prastotṛ, send forth speech to the gods!', saying: 'Savitṛ is indeed the impeller among the gods; impelled by Savitṛ, we accompany this.'
One should not do it in that way either.

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuvas svar ity u haike 'numantrayanta eṣā vai trayī vidyā trayyaivedaṃ vidyayānumantrayāmaha iti vadantaḥ tad u tathā no eva kuryāt |
meaning: भूर् भुवस् स्वर् इत्य् उ हैके ऽनुमन्त्रयन्त एषा वै त्रयी विद्या त्रय्यैवेदं विद्ययानुमन्त्रयामह इति वदन्तः तद् उ तथा नो एव कुर्यात् ।
text: And some recite the after-verse [with] bhUs, bhuvas, svar, saying: " Verily, this is the threefold knowledge; we now recite this after-verse with the threefold knowledge." One should not do that either,
text_mt:
And some accompany with: 'bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ', saying: 'This is indeed the threefold knowledge; with the threefold knowledge we accompany this.'
One should by no means do it in that way either.

sanskrit_iast: om ity evānumantrayeta |
meaning: ओम् इत्य् एवानुमन्त्रयेत ।
text: One should recite the after-verse [saying] only om.
text_mt: One should accompany with 'om' alone.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa vasiṣṭhasyaikastomabhāgānumantraḥ tena haitena vasiṣṭhaḥ prajātikāmo 'numantrayāṃ cakre devena savitrā prasūtaḥ prastotar devebhyo vācam iṣya bhūr bhuvas svar om iti tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata |
meaning: अथैष वसिष्ठस्यैकस्तोमभागानुमन्त्रः तेन हैतेन वसिष्ठः प्रजातिकामो ऽनुमन्त्रयां चक्रे देवेन सवित्रा प्रसूतः प्रस्तोतर् देवेभ्यो वाचम् इष्य भूर् भुवस् स्वर् ओम् इति ततो वै स बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत ।
text: Now this is Vasistha's onlj'^ stomabhdga-aiter-verse. With this same Vasistha, desirous of offspring, recited the after-verses: " Impelled by god Savitar, O prastotar, send [thy] speech to the gods; bhUs, bhuvas, svar, om,." Thereby he was greatly propagated through progeny [and] cattle.
text_mt:
Now, this is Vasiṣṭha's accompanying formula of the single share-of-the-praise-chant.
Desiring offspring, Vasiṣṭha accompanied with this: 'Impelled by the god Savitṛ, O prastotṛ, send forth speech to the gods: bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ, om!'
Thence indeed he was abundantly propagated with offspring and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: sa eva tena vasiṣṭhasyaikastomabhāgānumantreṇānumantrayeta bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate iyaṃ tv eva sthitir om ity evānumantrayeta | caturthe 'nuvāke caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ |
meaning: स एव तेन वसिष्ठस्यैकस्तोमभागानुमन्त्रेणानुमन्त्रयेत बहुर् एव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते इयं त्व् एव स्थितिर् ओम् इत्य् एवानुमन्त्रयेत । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके चतुर्थः खण्डः ।
text: Let him recite the afterverse with this one s*om«Ma^a-after-verse of Vasistha; he is greatly propagated through progeny [and] cattle. But this is the rule: let him recite the after-verse with om only.
text_mt:
If he should accompany with that single accompanying formula of the share-of-the-praise-chant belonging to Vasiṣṭha, he is abundantly propagated with offspring and cattle.
However, this settled rule is: one should accompany with 'om' alone.
Fourth subsection in the fourth lesson.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa vācā vajram udgṛhṇāti yad āha somaḥ pavata iti vopāvartadhvam iti vā vācaiva tad vāco vajraṃ vigṛhyate vācas satyenātimucyate tasmād om ity evānumantrayeta |
meaning: अथैष वाचा वज्रम् उद्गृह्णाति यद् आह सोमः पवत इति वोपावर्तध्वम् इति वा वाचैव तद् वाचो वज्रं विगृह्यते वाचस् सत्येनातिमुच्यते तस्माद् ओम् इत्य् एवानुमन्त्रयेत ।
text: Now with speech he takes up a thunderbolt. In that he says either " Soma cleanses itself " or " Turn ye hither," thereby with speech that thunderbolt of speech is taken apart (?), by the truth of speech he is released. Therefore he should recite the after-verse [saying] om only. 2, Verily the gods •with this threefold [knowledge] rich in sap ascended upwards to the heavenly world. They, being afraid lest men should come after [them], pressed the threefold knowledge (Veda).
text_mt:
Now here, he lifts up the thunderbolt with speech.
When he says, 'The soma purifies itself', or 'Turn toward [us]', that thunderbolt of speech is grasped by speech itself; it is released through the truth of speech.
Therefore one should accompany with 'om' alone.

sanskrit_iast: devā vā anayā trayyā sarasayordhvās svargaṃ lokam udakrāman te mamuṣyāṇām anvāgamād bibhyatas trayaṃ vedam apīḷayan |
meaning: देवा वा अनया त्रय्या सरसयोर्ध्वास् स्वर्गं लोकम् उदक्रामन् ते ममुष्याणाम् अन्वागमाद् बिभ्यतस् त्रयं वेदम् अपीऌअयन् ।
text_mt:
The gods, full of sap, mounted upward to the heavenly world by this threefold [knowledge].
Fearing the following after of human beings, they compressed the threefold veda.

sanskrit_iast: tasya pīḷayanta ekam evākṣaraṃ nāśaknuvan pīḷayitum om iti yad etat |
meaning: तस्य पीऌअयन्त एकम् एवाक्षरं नाशक्नुवन् पीऌअयितुम् ओम् इति यद् एतत् ।
text: Pressing it, they could not press one syllable of it; that was om.
text_mt: As they pressed it, there was just one syllable they could not crush: this one, namely om.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa u ha vāva sarasaḥ sarasā ha vā evaṃvidas trayī vidyā bhavati |
meaning: एष उ ह वाव सरसः सरसा ह वा एवंविदस् त्रयी विद्या भवति ।
text: Verily this is full of sap; full of sap becomes the threefold knowledge of one who knows thus. .■>. Verily what victory one wins, what thrift one thrives with the threefold knowledge full of sap, he wins that victory, he thrives that thrift, who knows thus.
text_mt: And that indeed possesses the essence. Possessing the essence, truly, becomes the threefold knowledge of one who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: sa yāṃ ha vai trayyā vidyayā sarasayā jitiṃ jagati yām ṛddhim ṛdhnoti jayati tāṃ jitim ṛdhnoti tām ṛddhiṃ ya evaṃ veda |
meaning: स यां ह वै त्रय्या विद्यया सरसया जितिं जगति याम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नोति जयति तां जितिम् ऋध्नोति ताम् ऋद्धिं य एवं वेद ।
text_mt: Whatever victory one wins by means of the threefold knowledge possessing the essence, whatever prosperity one attains, that victory he wins, that prosperity he attains, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: etad dha vā akṣaraṃ trayyai vidyāyai pratiṣṭhā om iti vai hotā pratiṣṭhita om ity adhvaryur om ity udgātā |
meaning: एतद् ध वा अक्षरं त्रय्यै विद्यायै प्रतिष्ठा ओम् इति वै होता प्रतिष्ठित ओम् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् ओम् इत्य् उद्गाता ।
text: Verily this same syllable is the firm stand of the threefold knowledge. [Saying] om the hotar stands firm, [saying] om the adhvaryu, [saying] om the udgdtar.
text_mt: This syllable indeed is the support of the threefold knowledge. With om the hotṛ is supported, with om the adhvaryu, with om the udgātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: etad dha vā akṣaraṃ vedānāṃ triviṣṭapam etasmin vā akṣara ṛtvijo yajamānam ādhāya svarge loke samudūhanti tasmād om ity evānumantrayeta | caturthe 'nuvāke pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ caturtho 'nuvākas samāptaḥ |
meaning: एतद् ध वा अक्षरं वेदानां त्रिविष्टपम् एतस्मिन् वा अक्षर ऋत्विजो यजमानम् आधाय स्वर्गे लोके समुदूहन्ति तस्माद् ओम् इत्य् एवानुमन्त्रयेत । चतुर्थे ऽनुवाके पञ्चमः खण्डः चतुर्थो ऽनुवाकस् समाप्तः ।
text: Verily this same syllable is the triple heaven (?) of the Vedas. The priests having placed the sacrificer in this syllable can-y him up together into the heavenly world. Therefore he should recite the afterverse [saying] om only.
text_mt: This syllable indeed is the summit of the Vedas. Placing the sacrificer in this syllable, the priests carry him up to the heavenly world. Therefore one should recite the responding chant with om alone. / Fifth khaṇḍa in the fourth anuvāka. / The fourth anuvāka is concluded.

sanskrit_iast: guhāsi devo 'sy upavāsy upa taṃ vāyasva yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ |
meaning: गुहासि देवो ऽस्य् उपवास्य् उप तं वायस्व यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः ।
text: "Thou art in secret, thou art a god, thou art onblowing; blow on him who hates us and whom we hate.
text_mt: "You are a hiding place, you are a god; you blow near; blow away him who hates us and whom we hate.

sanskrit_iast: mahināsi bahulāsi bṛhaty asi rohiṇy asy apannāsi |
meaning: महिनासि बहुलासि बृहत्य् असि रोहिण्य् अस्य् अपन्नासि ।
text: Thou art great, thou art abundant, thou art extended (brhatt), thou art ruddy, thou art not fallen,
text_mt: You are great, you are abundant, you are vast, you are ascending, you are not fallen.

sanskrit_iast: sambhūr devo 'si sam aham bhūyāsam ābhūtir asy ābhūyāsam bhūtir asi bhūyāsam |
meaning: सम्भूर् देवो ऽसि सम् अहम् भूयासम् आभूतिर् अस्य् आभूयासम् भूतिर् असि भूयासम् ।
text: Thou art a god coming into existence; may I come into existence. Thou art existence; may I exist. Thou art becoming; may I become.
text_mt: You are the deity of whole becoming; may I become whole. You are coming into being; may I come into being. You are flourishing; may I flourish.

sanskrit_iast: yās te prajā upadiṣṭā nāhaṃ tava tāḥ paryemi upa te tā diśāmi |
meaning: यास् ते प्रजा उपदिष्टा नाहं तव ताः पर्येमि उप ते ता दिशामि ।
text: What offspring of thee is declared, that [offspring] of thee I do not comprehend (?). That [offspring] of thee I declare.
text_mt: Whatever creatures of yours have been assigned, I do not bypass them of yours; I assign them to you.

sanskrit_iast: nāma me śarīram me pratiṣṭhā me tan me tvayi tan me mopahṛthā itīmām pṛthivīm avocat |
meaning: नाम मे शरीरम् मे प्रतिष्ठा मे तन् मे त्वयि तन् मे मोपहृथा इतीमाम् पृथिवीम् अवोचत् ।
text: My name, my body, my foundation: that of me is in thee. Do not take that of me unto thee," thus he said to this earth.
text_mt: My name, my body, my support—that of mine is in you; do not take that away from me," so he addressed this earth.

sanskrit_iast: tam iyam āgatam pṛthivī pratinandaty ayaṃ te bhagavo lokaḥ saha nāv ayaṃ loka iti |
meaning: तम् इयम् आगतम् पृथिवी प्रतिनन्दत्य् अयं ते भगवो लोकः सह नाव् अयं लोक इति ।
text: Him having come this earth joyfully receives [saying]: " Thine, 0 reverend sir, is this world. This world is ours in common."
text_mt: This earth welcomes him as he arrives: "This, venerable sir, is your world; this world belongs to us both together."
